notes.title: NosVersary: The Anniversary Event Server’s Coming!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/64df2f5db3966060bcd8b2698fad3609d557b0c0.jpg[/img]

We’re celebrating NosTale’s 18th anniversary with a brand-new event server! Look forward to faster progress, epic boosts and exclusive achievements. Get ready to progress at breakneck speed like never before on a NosTale server!
[list]
[*][b]NosVersary Server Starts[/b]: 24th September 2025
[*][b]NosVersary Server Ends[/b]: 5th November 2025
[/list]
[h3]What to expect on the NosVersary server:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Start out as a [b]specialist straight at level 56[/b], benefit from [b]triple EXP[/b] and more.
[*]Take part in [b]boost events and weekend specials[/b] and make the most out of the event server!
[*]Complete missions and snag some great rewards such as a server selection ticket and other handy items in the [b]new anniversary Battle Pass[/b]!
[*]Unlock cool rewards such as titles and pets via exclusive [b]event achievements[/b]!
[*][b]Free character transfer[/b] when the event server ends – migrate your new character to a regular server with the free character transfer in the Battle Pass and keep rocking your adventures there!
[*]... and much more!
[/list]
[h3]Top Anniversary Events on All Servers[/h3]

In addition to our exclusive anniversary server, we also have a ton of anniversary action lined up for you on all other servers! There’s an [b]anniversary calendar with gifts[/b], the [b]letter collecting event[/b], a [b]fan art contest[/b] with top prizes and much more to look forward to!

[h3]NosVersary FAQ[/h3]

Find out everything you need to know about the [b]NosVersary event server[/b] here!

[b]How long will NosVersary be online before I can transfer registered characters?[/b]
[list]
[*]NosVersary will be online for 6 weeks, from 24th September until 5th November 2025.
[/list]
[b]What’s special about NosVersary?[/b]
[list]
[*]Once you’ve selected a class, various character-bound items will be added to your inventory, including equipment sets 5+7, resistances, and fairies, as well as additional specialist cards 21+5.
[*]Once the event server ends, you’ll be able to transfer your character to a server of your choosing.
[*]Permanent boost events and additional special weekend boosts (which are higher than normal) will be active on the NosVersary event server. These will allow you to progress faster and easier.
[*]You’ll find copies of the most popular levelling maps on the maps themselves.
[*]You will be able to enter the Land of Death and Land of Life as usual. Instant Combat will be available on all channels.
[/list]
[b]How do I transfer my character?[/b]
[list]
[*]Characters are not transferred automatically.
[*]Only one character can be transferred per account. You will require an item which allows you to select a server. This item is available as one of the higher Battle Pass rewards.
[*]Characters which have not been registered for the transfer will not be transferred. So don’t forget to select a server to transfer to.
[/list]
[b]How do I choose a server?[/b]
[list]
[*]There will be two different items that will allow you to choose a server to transfer to. Each item will represent a different destination server.
[*]The items cannot be deleted and you will only have until the NosVersary event server closes to choose your destination server.
[/list]
[b]Where do I see which server I’ve selected?[/b]
[list]
[*]You can see the server you’ll be transferring your character to via the Consumables tab (the tab that displays your NosBazaar medals and expansions).
[/list]
[b]Can I transfer my items with my character?[/b]
[list]
[*]Any items that your character currently has equipped (in the P window), plus the regular and equipment inventories, will automatically transfer with them. In addition, costumes, specialist card inventories, and active mall items such as Inventory Expansions or NosMerchant Medals will be automatically transferred with your character.
[*]Items from the warehouse, unlocked NosMall items, and active offers in the NosBazaar will be sent to you by parcel.
[/list]
[b]Will there be a Battle Pass?[/b]
[list]
[*]Yes, there will be a [b]free Battle Pass[/b] for the NosVersary server. This Battle Pass will differ to those from earlier seasons. It will let you catch up quickly and make progressing easier.
[*]The Battle Pass unlocks the following items, as well as various others: Caligor’s Spirit, upgrade and crafting materials, completion gemstones, and transfer items.
[/list]
[b]Are there any rules for transferring?[/b]
[list]
[*]Similar transfer rules will apply as for last year’s Summer Oasis. Details will be published in a separate FAQ news post.
[/list]
[b]Which boosts will be available and when?[/b]
[list]
[*]The following boosts will be permanently active on the NosVersary server:
[*]2x EXP (3x on some weekends)
[*]2x Drops (3x on some weekends)
[*]2x Gold
[*]3x Fairy XP
[*]2x EXP for fishing, cooking, and training pets
[*]2x Family XP
[*]4x Reputation
[*]In addition, there will be special weekend boost events, such as the raid box event and upgrade events, which will give you even better benefits than usual. Some weekends may even feature multiple events.
[/list]
[b]Will there also be events on the regular servers?[/b]
[list]
[*]Yes, the regular servers will have similar events to NosVersary, though they will differ from the NosVersary events.
[/list]
[b]Can I change the name of my character on the NosVersary event server?[/b]
[list]
[*]Unfortunately this isn’t possible due to technical reasons. Please choose your character name carefully when creating your character, as you will not be able to change it later. Please note: As on all our other servers, using a name which violates our guidelines may lead to restrictions being placed on your account. Please keep this in mind while choosing your character’s name.
[/list]
Have fun,
The NosTale Team

notes.title: Events: Fairy Upgrade & Enchantment
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/b15ef62a7db6e27bf962710319cc8068b56026de.jpg[/img]

Equip your favourite fairy and give them a major boost! Between [b]12/09 (11 AM) and 15/09 (11 AM CEST)[/b], you have a [b]50% improved chance[/b] to reach higher levels when upgrading and enchanting fairies!

[h3]How Fairy Upgrades Work[/h3]
The fairy upgrade allows you to give a fairy a random effect, similar to the shells on your equipment. There are three possible outcomes of an upgrade attempt: success, failure or an overcharge.
[list][*][b]Success[/b]: Your fairy gets a random effect.[/*][*][b]Failure[/b]: The materials are consumed, but your fairy doesn't get an effect.[/*][*][b]Overcharge[/b]: Your fairy becomes overcharged. A [u]Golden Tool[/u] is needed to upgrade further.[/*][/list]
After upgrading a fairy, it is soulbound to your character. In addition to a Fairy Bead, you need a certain amount of Perfume to change its owner, depending on the fairy's upgrade level.

Please note: Fairies which cannot be traded without a Fairy Bead cannot be upgraded (regular fairies, event fairies).

[h3]How Fairy Enchantments Work[/h3]
Whenever you enchant a fairy, you can get effects for your fairy with a very high or even a very low level. The levels are divided up from S (highest) to C (lowest). While fairy enchantments cannot fail, you obviously want to get the best possible level you can. This event gives you a [b]greater chance of getting levels S, A and B[/b]!

Have fun,
The NosTale Team

notes.title: Now in the NosMall: Super Cute Mini Pets
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/3a03d074b0b832a7dfa5ce868740f2164843fbb7.jpg[/img]

Mini, mini, mini pets! Head on over to the NosMall between [b]10th September (11 AM CEST)[/b] and discover the new [b]Adorable Alien[/b] and his cute little friends in the [b]Mini Fairytale Box[/b].

[h3]Mini Fairytale Box[/h3]

Open the box and find out what’s waiting for you inside! You will receive a powerful mini pet at random from the box, who can accompany you in addition to your regular pet and support you with their powerful bonuses. Which of them will flutter into your arms, the alien, honeybee, lucky pony, or cute rainbow?
[list]
[*]Mini Pet ‘Adorable Alien’ (30 Days)
[*]Mini Pet ‘Sweet Honeybee’ (30 Days)
[*]Mini Pet ‘Lucky Pink Pony’ (30 Days)
[*]Mini Pet ‘Little Rainbow Spirit’ (30 Days)
[/list]
The Adorable Alien pet supports you with the following effects:
[list]
[*]Increases all attacks by 7%
[*]Increases all defences by 10%
[*]5% chance of additional raid tokens (including hardcore tokens)
[/list]
The Sweet Honeybee supports you with the following effects:
[list]
[*]Increases experience earned by 5%
[*]Increases champion XP earned by 3%
[*]Increases all attacks by 5%
[/list]
The Lucky Pink Pony supports you with the following effects:
[list]
[*]Increases all attacks by 3%
[*]Increases Gold earned by 10%
[*]When you get a raid box, there’s a 5% chance to receive a second one
[/list]
The Little Rainbow Spirit supports you with the following effects:
[list]
[*]Increases all attacks by 5%
[*]10% chance of an item dropping a second time when a defeated monster drops an item. This effect is only triggered when the dropped item is assigned to a player, not when it is shared in the group.
[/list]
[h3]Note[/h3]

The duration of your mini pet starts only once you have equipped it for the first time. It is tradeable only until that point. The duration of the mini pet is measured in real time, meaning it continues to count down even when you are not logged in. When it expires, your mini pet will disappear.

notes.title: Celestial Spire Catacombs: The Family Challenge Awaits
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/6bec5b0535f7ae072f2c6a1860f2c1f6a0d76e9d.jpg[/img]

It’s time for a new chapter in your destiny, as the Celestial Spire Catacombs call out to you… and this time, you will not be alone. Rally your family around you and venture into the depths together in the latest challenging group mode in NosTale from [b]10th September 2025 (11 AM CEST)[/b].

Master a tactical tower defence experience, with new maps, dangerous monsters and increasing difficulty. Join forces to protect the totem from the forces of darkness – and remember that a single mistake could spell your doom!

[h3]New: Family Mode in the Celestial Spire Catacombs[/h3]

Descend the Celestial Spire Catacombs with your family. Access to the new zone is granted via the Celestial Spire Catacombs Manager NPC in Act 9, located in Undercity. Here’s where your journey through the 20 levels of the Celestial Spire Catacombs begins.

[b]Access & Requirements[/b]
[list]
[*]Only champion level 80+ characters can participate
[*]Weekly limit: 50 entries
[*]Every family member can open levels
[*]Groups consist of 8 to 12 players, and multiple teams can enter simultaneously
[*]Only previously unlocked levels are accessible
[*]Levels 1 through 20 are unlocked in turn via family progress
[*]Monthly reset: Every month you must start your descent afresh; your progress will be reset, and the challenge starts from the beginning
[/list]
[b]Mechanics: Defend the Totem[/b]
[list]
[*]The totem is at the heart of the action; if this is destroyed, your attempt fails.
[*]Monsters will appear in increasingly difficult waves, attacking from random directions, with more monsters appearing the more companions you have.
[*]Special effects and other dangers such as meteor showers and other mechanics make each level unique.
[*]Should a player die, they can respawn on the same level using a Celestial Spire Catacombs First-Aid Kit. If they choose not to do this, or the whole team dies, then the entry is spent.
[/list]
[b]Rewards & Progress[/b]
Each successfully completed level affords:
[list]
[*]Catacomb Tokens redeemable in the new token shop for:
[*]New pets
[*]Handy consumables
[*]... and more!
[/list]
[b]Missions & Quests[/b]
Besides fame and glory, you can expect:
[list]
[*]Weekly family missions with buffs for all members (e.g. EXP bonuses)
[*]Daily and monthly family missions
[*]Personal weekly tasks
[*]Unique family quests which unlock powerful rewards upon completion
[*]Monthly rankings
[*]General quest line inspired by the Pet Trainer quests. Earn powerful rewards upon completion!
[*]Future Battle Pass missions!
[/list]
Are you ready for the ultimate family challenge? Then gear up, round up your allies, and face the greatest challenge yet. March on – step by step, level for level – to victory!

Best of luck,
The NosTale Team

notes.title: Celestial Spire Catacombs – Patch Notes
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/c1af5192621d5236ee34c10ff56f049998fbb9c5.jpg[/img]

It’s been a while, but we’re now back with the family edition of the Celestial Spire – the Celestial Spire Catacombs!

Prepare for this thrilling adventure and battle your way through all the levels with your family.

[h2]The Celestial Spire Catacombs:[/h2]
[b]General rules:[/b]
[list][*]Champion level 80+[/*][*]8–12 players[/*][*]Initial weekly limit of 50 entries[/*][*]Entry via a new NPC in Undercity[/*][*]Progress resets monthly[/*][*]New skill for entering the Celestial Spire Catacombs, similar to the Raid List (the leader must start the expedition with the NPC)[/*][/list]
[b]Combat system rules:[/b]
[list][*]Monsters get stronger each level[/*][*]Six lives with 1 totem to defend; if all your lives are used up, or the totem is destroyed, you fail to complete the level[/*][*]The more team members present, the more monsters will appear[/*][*]There are currently no squads in the Celestial Spire Catacombs[/*][*]It is possible to resurrect in a level using a special item[/*][/list]
[b]Rewards and missions:[/b] (https://nostale.comastuff.com/Celestial_Spire_Catacombs.pdf, only in english)
[list][*]Level rewards: [list][*]Random rewards for completing a level[/*][*]One-time monthly rewards for first completing a level[/*][*]Guaranteed rewards for completing a level[/*][/list][/*][*]Monthly family rewards: [list][*]Passive buffs which reset on the 1st of every month[/*][*]Passive buffs to increase damage and defence, skills for double drops, and more[/*][/list][/*][*]Unique family quests: [list][*]Quests awarding FXP[/*][*]Permanent passive buffs for reducing family expansion costs and more[/*][/list][/*][*]Daily family quests: [list][*]Daily quests awarding FXP[/*][/list][/*][*]Monthly rankings: [list][*]Families compete according to levels and time, and receive rewards based for their rank at the beginning of the month[/*][/list][/*][*]Unique weekly missions (found in the Progress Book): [list][*]Quests which provide materials and Celestial Spire Catacombs Tokens[/*][/list][/*][*]Celestial Spire Catacombs Token Shop: [list][*]You can exchange Celestial Spire Catacombs Tokens for various items such as:[/*][*]Resistances, passive skill books, new pets and more[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[b]General changes:[/b]
[list][*]Added a Celestial Spire Catacombs Team Stone to the Alchemist in Undercity[/*][*]It is no longer possible to heal the totem in the regular Celestial Spire[/*][*]Added an overview of raid team members, visible when clicking on a team in the Raid List[/*][/list]
[b]Clarifications:[/b]
[list]
[*] The entry count for the Celestial Spire Catacombs is reduced the moment the stage lever is pulled, not when you or your team fails.
[*] Celestial Spire Catacombs Level progress is individual, through the help of your family, not based on your family's highest progress.
[*] If you die, you will lay on the ground for another 60 seconds. If your team clears the level during this time, the run will also count as successful for you. If the team clears the level after 60 or more seconds since your death, it will count as a fail for you.
[*] The effect "HP is increased by x% of damage given" is deactivated inside the Celestial spire catacombs
[*] There is no MP consumption in the Celestial spire catacombs.
[/list]

notes.title: Summer Event with Pete O’Peng & Lola Lopears
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/06324a77fb22d3091e6708b341086002f67f3397.jpg[/img]

And our summer action continues with two familiar events! Look out for the fearsome pirate [b]Captain Pete O’Peng[/b] and the slippery [b]Lola Lopears[/b] and her band of bunnies! Confront them and win great rewards!

[b]Event period[/b]: 21st August (11 AM) to 17th September (11 AM CEST).

[h3]More Dangerous Than Ever: Captain Pete O’Peng![/h3]
Yo-ho-ho, Captain Pete O’Peng is back! After voyaging the seven seas, he’s returned… and he’s badder than ever before! He’ll be causing mischief again this summer and he reckons you won’t stand a chance against him this time. What do you say to that? Show that rascally freebooter what you’re made of!
[list][*]Eliminate the wicked Captain Pete O’Peng and his crew in the Pirate Raid! Pillage the raid box and snap up the [b]Navy Costume or Navy Bushi, partner Leona, the ‘Arrrrr!’ title or one of the four Pirate Bushtails[/b] amongst many other items.[/*][*]Slip on the elegant [b]Navy Costume[/b]! The Captain’s Hat provides a 2% chance of inflicting Strong Freeze on your opponent. The costume provides a 5% chance of reducing all attack damage by 80%. Both items of clothing increase your water resistance by 2%.[/*][*]The [b]Arrrrr![/b] title increases your HP by +300 and will show Captain Pete O’Peng who the real pirate is around here![/*][/list]
[h3]Give Lola’s Lopears a Boxing![/h3]
Look out, here comes Lucy’s evil sister: Lola Lopears! Confront her in the raid for 5 to 8 players – but keep your wits about you when her army of little bunnies comes hopping out of the burrow. Lola also plants a giant carrot in the ground which you must destroy as quickly as possible. Each member of your raid team needs Lola Lopears’ Raid Seal before you can start. If you manage to swing the battle in your favour, with a bit of luck you might find [b]Lucy Lopears’ Specialist Partner Card[/b] in the raid box. Equipped with the fire element, Lucy Lopears will be your loyal, powerful partner.

[b]What Else?[/b]
There are also lots of other missions that need your attention. In reward for your efforts, you can pick up the [b]Lopears[/b] title giving you 2% hit rate and 2% concentration, the cute Bunny Hairband, and a whole raft of other rewards.

The NosTale Team

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/2c6f24b10ab23dcbfde080b905c966f12a5c1934.jpg[/img]

Here’s one for all you fans of fabulous pets! Between [b]24th July (11 AM) and 26th July (11 AM CEST)[/b], you can pick up the [b]Mini Fairytale Box[/b] and the [b]Mini Friend Chest[/b] at a [b]40% discount[/b] in the NosMall. Which pet will leap into your arms?

[h3]Mini Fairytale Box[/h3]

One of three cutesy little mini pets is waiting for you in this box. They can accompany you in addition to your regular pet and support you with their powerful bonuses.

You receive one of these mini pets from this box at random:
[list]
[*]Mini Pet ‘Lucky Pink Pony’ (30 Days)

[*]Mini Pet ‘Sweet Honeybee’ (30 Days)

[h3]Mini Friend Chest[/h3]

You can choose one of five cute mini pets from this chest! It can accompany you in addition to your regular pet and support you with their powerful bonuses. Who will you pick?

notes.title: Event: Lord Melonoth’s Summer Raid
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/d9ae25b0d1d7bb8825553fd9f1e7141f015c7383.jpg[/img]

Get ready for a fruitastic challenge this summer! Battle against fruity monsters like Bananosaurus and Dragon Fruitlets, then defeat Lord Melonoth himself in the brand-new summer raid!

Rewards such as little fruit pets, an additional mini pet, the Fruity Ninja title and much more await!

[b]Running[/b]: 23rd July (11 AM) to 20th August (11 AM CEST)

[h3]The Story So Far[/h3]

Some time ago, the Mullans of Undercity started to trade with people from the surface. These new dealings gave the Mullans their first taste of fresh fruit! One tribe member, by the name of Doctor Frox, was munching down on some of this fruit from the surface, and became absolutely obsessed with the taste.

He focused all of his energies on cultivating varieties of fruit plants which would be capable of surviving in the darkness of Undercity. He set up [i]Frox’s Fruit Lab[/i] as a research institute and started a number of botanical experiments. Using a specially developed serum, Doctor Frox wanted to promote growth in his plants.
The first results were fruitful, and his plants flourished despite the total darkness. But something went wrong... the serum had some unexpected side effects. The plants mutated, outgrowing their natural size and becoming intelligent – and hostile!
The fruit monsters broke out of the laboratory and made their way to the surface, where they started to attack the surrounding settlements.

Riddled with guilt, Doctor Frox has followed them to the surface, and is now searching for help. He needs someone who is courageous and strong enough to stop these unbridled creatures, before they can plunge the surface into chaos.

[h3]Raid Info[/h3]

In order to participate in the Lord Melonoth Raid, you must first complete the Time-Space quest Lab on Alert. Only the raid leader needs Lord Melonoth’s Raid Seal to start the raid.

You also receive the Fresh Melon Rind (Event) in reward which allows you to deal double damage to the mini-bosses and the raid boss.

The Time-Space quest can be completed up to 5 times per day. The raid can be entered via Fruit Fiend Portal in NosVille.

A maximum of 15 players can participate in a raid. Players must face a platter of fruity enemies to defeat, followed by Lord Melonoth himself, before they can get the amazing rewards from his raid box.

[b]Raid Box of Lord Melonoth[/b]
The box can contain these items:
[list]
[*]10x Angel’s Feather
[*]5x Full Moon Crystal
[*]5x Prehistoric Banana (Event)
[*]1x Gleaming Melon Stone
[*]1x Advanced Fruit Research
[*]1x Watermelon Rind Hat
[*]10x Fruity Health Potion (Event)
[*]10x Fruity Mana Potion (Event)
[*]1x Small Completion Gemstone Box
[*]1x Completion Gemstone Box
[*]1x Special Fruit
[*]5x/3x Shiny Sky Blue Gemstone
[/list]
You can also loot various items from the fruity monsters during the event which can be exchanged for the following rewards from Doctor Frox:
[list]
[*]1x Minilonopus
[*]1x Mini Bananosaurus
[*]1x Mini Dapplodocus
[*]1x Mini Pitadraya
[*]1x Advanced Fruit Research
[*]1x Dragon Gem Bag
[*]3x Small Completion Gemstone Box
[*]3x Completion Gemstone Box
[*]1x Moritius Obsidian Bag
[*]1x Fairy Experience Card
[*]1x Steam Drone Fairy Experience Card
[*]3x Ice Flower Oil
[*]10x Angel’s Feather
[/list]
Grab your fruit knife and get slicing that feisty fruit into a tasty salad!

Have fun,
The NosTale Team

notes.title: Community Update – Second Half of 2025
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/e3648aefa3a44482ada06d3f3d040c565b0a52ff.jpg[/img]

Dear NosPlayers,

Summer is already here, and things are heating up in NosTale! As the days get longer and the temperatures rise, it’s time to reflect on what’s happened so far in 2025 and give you a sneak peek at what’s coming next. From major updates to blazing new servers and exciting plans for the months ahead – let’s dive in!

[h1]A Look Back: January–June 2025[/h1]
[h2]Early Game Rework & Balancing[/h2]
One of the most significant changes this year was our rework of the early game experience. Aimed at improving the onboarding process for new and returning players, this update brought a series of quality-of-life adjustments, revamped quest flows, and combat balancing tweaks to make early-level progression more fluid and enjoyable.

If you haven’t had the chance to check it out yet, we highly recommend taking a look at the [url=https://forum.nostale.gameforge.com/forum/thread/2604-game-update-maintenance-19-03-2025/?postID=6060#post6060]patch notes[/url] or diving into the [url=https://nostale.comastuff.com/Early_Game_Rework.pdf]detailed rework document[/url] to get the full picture.

[h2]NosFire Event Server[/h2]
March also saw the launch of [b]NosFire[/b], our limited-time event server filled with explosive action and intense boosts. Players jumped in to enjoy increased EXP and drop rates, unique progression opportunities, and a fast-paced environment that brought a fresh twist to the classic NosTale experience.

NosFire was a hit, and we’re thrilled to see how many of you took part. Whether it was for competitive goals or just to experience the rush, thank you for being part of the fun!

[h1]Looking Ahead: July–December 2025[/h1]
[h2]Server Merge Incoming![/h2]
As you already know by now, one of the first updates planned for the summer is the [b]merge of three major servers: INT-Valehir, DE-Alzanor, and FR-Cosmos[/b]. This merge will bring communities together, strengthen server populations, and create a more dynamic and competitive environment.

[h2]Summer Events – New Raid, New Adventures![/h2]
Our annual summer events return with a splash – not only can you enjoy our usual events to get your hands on hot and cool rewards, but this year, an original new event will also be deployed on our servers bringing a [b]brand-new raid and quests[/b] as well! Expect challenging adventures against the new raid boss, succulent rewards, and all the summer vibes you can get. Prepare your team and dive into this juicy seasonal adventure!

[h2]New Content – Family Celestial Spire[/h2]
Although we announced it for the first half of the year, we were sadly unable to release it on time. However, this time we’re happy to confirm that the Family Celestial Spire is now on track for release. Families will be put to the test with the introduction of the [b]Family Ascension of the Celestial Spire[/b] – a return to the Celestial Spire from Act 7, designed for cooperative gameplay. Climb the tower together, overcome increasingly difficult floors, and earn rewards worthy of your efforts.

[h2]Anniversary Celebrations – New Temporary Celebration Server[/h2]
To mark another year of NosTale, we’re launching a [b]special temporary anniversary server[/b] packed with unique features and limited-time bonuses. Not only will you be able to enjoy the usual birthday events early this year on all servers, but you’ll also receive even more presents on the temporary server. Like NosFire, this server will also allow you to transfer your character at the end of the event – fully prepared for the major content update coming later this year!

Because remember – Christmas is still to come… and if you’re really good, Santa might bring you a really big present.

[h2]Final Words[/h2]
As always, we’d like to thank every one of you for your continued support and feedback. Whether you’ve been here from the start, or are just beginning your journey in NosTale, your passion helps shape the future of the game.

See you in the game!
The NosTale Team

notes.title: Events: Fairy Upgrade & Enchantment
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/b15ef62a7db6e27bf962710319cc8068b56026de.jpg[/img]

Equip your favourite fairy and give them a major boost! Between [b]04/07 (11 AM) and 07/07 (11 AM CEST)[/b], you have a [b]50% improved chance[/b] to reach higher levels when upgrading and enchanting fairies!

[h3]How Fairy Upgrades Work[/h3]
The fairy upgrade allows you to give a fairy a random effect, similar to the shells on your equipment. There are three possible outcomes of an upgrade attempt: success, failure or an overcharge.
[list][*][b]Success[/b]: Your fairy gets a random effect.[/*][*][b]Failure[/b]: The materials are consumed, but your fairy doesn't get an effect.[/*][*][b]Overcharge[/b]: Your fairy becomes overcharged. A [u]Golden Tool[/u] is needed to upgrade further.[/*][/list]
After upgrading a fairy, it is soulbound to your character. In addition to a Fairy Bead, you need a certain amount of Perfume to change its owner, depending on the fairy's upgrade level.

Please note: Fairies which cannot be traded without a Fairy Bead cannot be upgraded (regular fairies, event fairies).

[h3]How Fairy Enchantments Work[/h3]
Whenever you enchant a fairy, you can get effects for your fairy with a very high or even a very low level. The levels are divided up from S (highest) to C (lowest). While fairy enchantments cannot fail, you obviously want to get the best possible level you can. This event gives you a [b]greater chance of getting levels S, A and B[/b]!

Have fun,
The NosTale Team

notes.title: Double Event Action
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/7c71b2895b4ed118411939efbbb2303ae7296604.jpg[/img]

Heroes of NosTale, get ready as the Land of Life prepares to offer twice the EXP time! Between [b]16th May (midnight) and 18th May (11:59 PM CEST)[/b] the time you can spend in the Land of Life is doubled (4 hours instead of 2 hours)!

Plus you can test your mettle twice as often in [b]NosTale’s Instant Combats[/b] during the same period!

Both events take place on the regular servers as well as NosFire.

[h2]Land of Life[/h2]
The Land of Life is the ideal place to increase your champion level. Kill monsters and bosses together with your family members to earn EXP and powerful items.

The Dragon Lord Asgobas will appear there in regular intervals. It is not possible to enter the Land of Life while he is present, but all players who entered before his appearance [b]earn 100% more experience[/b].

The Land of Life is divided into two zones: one for champion level 30–59 and one for champion level 60–90. You need to meet the respective minimum level requirement in order to enter these zones.

The Land of Life is open according to the following pattern:
[list][*]midnight–1:00 AM: open[/*][*]1:00 AM–2:00 AM: closed (Asgobas appears and all EXP earned in this period is doubled)[/*][*]2:00 AM–3:00 AM: Land of Life is open again[/*][*]... and so on[/*][/list]
[h3]Event Info[/h3]
You can spend [b]up to 4 hours[/b] per day in the Land of Life during the event. You’ll also receive about 20 minutes more to plan your entries around Asgobas’ appearance.

[h2]Instant Combat[/h2]
An Instant Combat will start on channels 1 through 4 on the hour, every hour. (Applies to regular servers as well as NosFire.)

[h3]Asgobas’ Instant Combat[/h3]
Asgobas’ Instant Combat will start on channels 5 through 7 at the following times:
11:30 AM, 12:30 PM, 4:30 PM, 5:30 PM, 8:30 PM, 9:30 PM, 10:30 PM and 11:30 PM. (Applies to regular servers as well as NosFire.)

Have fun!
The NosTale Team

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/bb53b8cf984789e6d89b4f617131d1ec95fa029a.jpg[/img]

Mini, mini, mini pets! Discover the great new contents of the mini pet boxes! Check out the [b]new Sweet Honeybee[/b], the [b]Little Rainbow Spirit[/b], and other powerful mini pets. The [b]Mini Fairytale Box[/b] and [b]Mini Friend Chest[/b] are available permanently in the NosMall from [b]7th May (11 AM CET)[/b].

[h3]Mini Fairytale Box[/h3]

Open the box and find out what’s waiting for you inside! You will receive a powerful mini pet at random from the box, who can accompany you in addition to your regular pet and support you with their powerful bonuses. Which of them will flutter into your arms, the busy little honeybee, the cute rainbow or the winged horse?
[list]
[*]Mini Pet ‘Sweet Honeybee’ (30 Days)
[*]Mini Pet ‘Little Rainbow Spirit’ (30 Days)
[*]Mini Pet ‘Lucky Pink Pony’ (30 Days)
[/list]
The Sweet Honeybee supports you with the following effects:
[list]
[*]Increases all attacks by 5%.
[*]Increases experience earned by 5%.
[*]Increases champion XP earned by 3%.
[/list]
The Little Rainbow Spirit supports you with the following effects:
[list]
[*]Increases all attacks by 5%.
[*]10% chance of an item dropping a second time when a defeated monster drops an item. This effect is only triggered when the dropped item is assigned to a player, not when it is shared in the group.

[list]
[*]Increases all attacks by 3%.
[*]Increases Gold earned by 10%.
[*]There is a 5% chance that you’ll get an additional raid box.

[h3]Mini Friend Chest[/h3]

You can choose one of five cute mini pets from this chest! It can accompany you in addition to your regular pet and support you with their powerful bonuses. Who will you pick?
[list]

[*]Mini Pet ‘Gryphon’ (30 Days)

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/a703b4ed76a811d51298d76ff6d23dfde072978d.jpg[/img]

Mysterious Sealed Vessels are circulating around the world of NosTale. Surrounded by a magical aura, only [b]parties of experienced adventurers[/b]  should dare open them, as these otherwise unremarkable vessels contain the most wicked of creatures, banished by wise mages. 

The brave – or the foolish – who nevertheless rise to the challenge to liberate and defeat the evil creature inside one of these Sealed Vessels have a chance of being rewarded with a treasure chest. These contain fantastic items from the NosMall. With a dollop of good fortune, the monsters could even drop our exclusive pet which gives you seriously powerful buffs!

[b]Event Time:[/b] Between 7th May (11 AM CEST) and 14th May (11 AM CEST).

[h3]Here’s How[/h3]
[list][*]Pick up a Sealed Vessel from the NosMall, NosWheel or NosBazaar.[/*][*]Rally your friends/family together and steel yourselves for a tough fight.[/*][*]Open the Sealed Vessel summoning one of 20 monsters.[/*][*]The higher the monster’s level, the greater the chance of collecting a treasure chest.[/*][/list]
[h3]Things to Know[/h3]
[list][*]The Sealed Vessels can be opened on any map, with the exceptions of those detailed below.[/*][*]Sealed Vessels cannot be opened in the capitals (NosVille, Port Alveus, Sunset Cliff).[/*][*]Only 11 Sealed Vessels can be active simultaneously on the following maps: NosVille Meadows, Mine Plains, Sunny Meadows, Fernon Outpost, Western Mine (all maps), Northern Mine (all maps), Fernon Temple (all maps) and Fernon’s Hideout (all maps).[/*][/list]
In addition to the treasure chest, one of the following items may drop in the displayed amount after defeating the monster:
[list]
[*]1x Death Lancer Set
[*]2x Wings of Friendship
[*]20x Huge Recovery Potion
[*]10x Cylloan Spring Water
[*]10x Guardian Angel’s Blessing
[*]1x Special Pet Food

[*]1x Fire Devil Set
[*]1x Liberator 
[*]1x Small Ice Witch 
[*]1x Ice Witch Costume Set 
[*]1x Ice Witch Costume Wings

[h3]New Pet Buffs[/h3]
The new pet can drag your enemies right up to you. Meanwhile, the buff it grants increases all attacks by 10%, and increases light resistance by 10.

Enjoy the monster hunt!
The NosTale Team

notes.title: Double Event Power at the Weekend
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/7963749dcc2597e2ddc519dbd7436b54c5acdf4c.jpg[/img]

We’ve got another exciting weekend lined up with [b]two simultaneous events[/b]! Enjoy higher chances in the [b]Partner Skill Event[/b] and get [b]double EXP time in the Land of Life[/b]!

[b]Event period[/b]: 2nd May (11 AM) to 5th May (11 AM CEST)

[h3]Partner Skill Event[/h3]

During the event, you’ll get a [b]+50%[/b] chance to reach higher levels when upgrading specialist partner skills on regular servers. The chance is even increased to 100% on [b]NosFire[/b]!

Whenever you upgrade a specialist partner skill, you can get one of any level, high or low. The levels are divided from highest to lowest into S, A, B, C, D, E and F. While this action cannot fail, you obviously want to get the best possible skill you can. This event gives you a greater chance of getting levels S, A and B!

[h3]Double EXP Time in the Land of Life[/h3]

During the event, you can spend [b]up to 4 hours in the Land of Life every day[/b]. You’ll also receive about 20 minutes more to plan your entries around Asgobas’ appearance.

[b]About the Land of Life[/b]
The Land of Life is the ideal place to increase your champion level. Kill monsters and bosses together with your family members to earn EXP and powerful items.

The Dragon Lord Asgobas will appear there in regular intervals. It is not possible to enter the Land of Life while he is present, but all players who entered before his appearance [b]earn 100% more experience[/b].

The Land of Life is divided into three zones: one for champion level 30–64, one for 60–82 and one for 80–90. You need to meet the respective minimum level requirement in order to enter these zones.

The Land of Life is open according to the following pattern:
[list]
[*]midnight–1:00 AM: open
[*]1:00 AM–2:00 AM: closed (Asgobas appears and all EXP earned in this period is doubled)
[*]2:00 AM–3:00 AM: Land of Life is open again
[*]... and so on
[/list]
Have fun!
The NosTale Team

notes.title: Cute Mythical Creatures Now on Offer
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/c95b4a95ba2046832f05a5b98e1835708ea41832.jpg[/img]

Here’s one for all you fans of fabulous pets! Between [b]1st May (11 AM) and 3rd May (11 AM CEST)[/b], you can pick up the [b]Mini Fairytale Box[/b] and the [b]Mini Friend Chest[/b] at a [b]30% discount[/b] in the NosMall. Which pet will leap into your arms?

[h3]Mini Fairytale Box[/h3]
One of three cutesy little mini pets is waiting for you in this box. They can accompany you in addition to your regular pet and support you with their powerful bonuses.

You receive one of these mini pets from this box at random:
[list][*]Mini Pet ‘Lucky Pink Pony’ (30 Days)[/*][*]Mini Pet ‘Little Rainbow Spirit’ (30 Days)[/*][*]Mini Pet ‘Lucky Blue Dragon’ (30 Days)[/*][/list]
[h3]Mini Pet Effects[/h3]
The [b]Lucky Pink Pony[/b] supports you with the following effects:
[list][*]Increases all attacks by 3%[/*][*]Increases Gold earned by 10%[/*][*]When you get a raid box, there’s a 5% chance to receive a second one[/*][/list]
The [b]Little Rainbow Spirit[/b] supports you with the following effects:
[list][*]Increase all attacks by 5%[/*][*]10% chance of an item dropping a second time when a defeated monster drops an item. This effect is only triggered when the dropped item is assigned to a player, not when it is shared in the group.[/*][/list]
The [b]Lucky Blue Dragon[/b] supports you with the following effects and skills:
[list][*]Increases all attacks by 3%[/*][*]Increases experience earned by 5%[/*][/list]
[h3]Mini Friend Chest[/h3]
You can choose one of four cute mini pets from this chest! It can accompany you in addition to your regular pet and support you with their powerful bonuses. Who will you pick?

You can choose between these four mini pets:
[list][*]Mini Pet ‘Gryphon’ (30 Days)[/*][*]Mini Pet ‘Black Dragon’ (30 Days)[/*][*]Mini Pet ‘Phoenix’ (30 Days)[/*][*]Mini Pet ‘Blue Phoenix’ (30 Days)[/*][/list]
These mini pets support you with the following effects:
[list][*]Increases all attacks by 3%[/*][*]Increases all defences by 3%[/*][/list]
[b]Please note[/b]: The duration of your mini pet starts only once you have equipped it for the first time. It is tradeable only until that point. The duration of the mini pet is measured in real time, meaning it continues to count down even when you are not logged in. When it expires, your mini pet will disappear.

Have fun!
The NosTale Team

notes.title: NosFire Event Server: Burning Hot Boosts & Action
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/55be90cfa9d48d9eb2287d3d69909cf7ff8e9864.jpg[/img]

This spring promises to be full of exciting NosTale adventures! As the Sun sends out its first warm rays of the year, we’re ready to respond with some scorching hot action. Get ready for the [b]brand-new NosFire event server[/b] where you can level up a character faster than ever before, take advantage of events and boosts, as well as lots of other great benefits!
[list]
[*][b]NosFire Event Server Starts[/b]: 15th April 2025
[*][b]NosFire Event Server Ends[/b]: 18th June 2025
[/list]
[h3]What to expect on the NosFire Event Server:[/h3]
[list]
[*]You’ll start at [b]level 80[/b] and get access to [b]double EXP, double gold drops[/b], and more!
[*]You’ll get a [b]free equipment set[/b] when you start your NosFire event server adventure!
[*]Take part in [b]boost events and weekend specials[/b] and make the most out of the event server!
[*][b]Brand new this year[/b]: The [b]Progress Book[/b]! Use it for a chance to get valuable rewards!
[*]Complete missions and snag some powerful rewards with the [b]new Battle Pass[/b]!
[*][b]When the event server ends, migrate your new character to a regular server with a free character transfer[/b] and keep rocking your adventures there!
[*]... and much more!
[/list]
[h3]FAQ[/h3]

Find out everything you need to know about the [b]NosFire event server[/b] here!

[b]How long will NosFire be online before I can transfer registered characters?[/b]
[list]
[*]NosFire will be online for 9 weeks, from 15/4 until 18/6/2025.
[/list]
[b]What’s special about NosFire?[/b]
[list]
[*]You can select a class in the character selection window and start at level 80/job level 80 right away.
[*]Once you’ve selected a class, various character-bound items will be added to your inventory, including equipment sets 5+7, resistances, and fairies, as well as additional specialist cards 50+5.
[*]Once the event server ends, you’ll be able to transfer your character to a server of your choosing.
[*]Permanent boost events and additional special weekend boosts (which are higher than normal) will be active on the NosFire event server. These will allow you to progress faster and easier.
[*][b]New[/b]: You will have access to a Progress Book that will offer you lots of valuable rewards on your journey through NosFire. It works similarly to how the Pet Book works, and will allow you to access various quests from directly within the game. You can claim your rewards directly after completing the quests.
[*]You’ll find copies of the most popular levelling maps on the maps themselves.
[*]Certain content, such as Act 8 raids, will be simplified, and the entry level for certain raids will be adjusted.
[*]Cannot craft or purchase warehouses from NPCs.
[*]Adjusted the entry level for certain Time-Spaces.
[*]Cannot earn gold from the SP 1+2 Martial Artist quest.
[*]Adjusted the entry level for Instant Combats and Rainbow Battles to level 85. Level 85+ can now access minigames.
[*]Cannot sell or trade starting equipment.
[*]You will be able to enter the Land of Death and Land of Life as usual. Instant Combat will be available on all channels.
[/list]
[b]How do I transfer my character?[/b]
[list]
[*]Characters are not transferred automatically. Only one character can be transferred per account. You will require an item which allows you to select a server. This item is available as one of the higher Battle Pass rewards. Characters which have not been registered for the transfer will not be transferred. So don’t forget to select a server to transfer to.
[/list]
[b]How do I choose a server?[/b]
[list]
[*]There will be various items that will allow you to choose a server to transfer to. Each item will represent a different destination server. The items cannot be deleted and you will only have until the NosFire event server closes to choose your destination server.
[/list]
[b]Where do I see which server I’ve selected?[/b]
[list]
[*]You can see the server you’ll be transferring your character to via the Consumables tab (the tab that displays your NosBazaar medals and expansions).
[/list]
[b]Are you planning a server merge soon?[/b]
[list]
[*]Yes, but we don’t have an exact date yet. We will inform all of you as soon as we have more details for you.
[/list]
[b]Can I take my items with me when I transfer my character?[/b]
[list]
[*]Any items that your character currently has equipped (in the P window) will automatically transfer with them. With the Battle Pass you can unlock a warehouse which allows you to transfer up to 10 additional items. In addition, costumes, specialist card inventories, and active mall items such as Inventory Expansions or NosMerchant Medals will be automatically transferred with your character. Nothing else will be transferred.
[*]Please remember to collect all your rewards from your Battle Pass, Progress Book, and from any post before your character gets transferred. These rewards will no longer be available once the transfer is complete.
[/list]
[b]Will there be a Battle Pass?[/b]
[list]
[*]Yes, there will be a [b]free Battle Pass[/b] for the NosFire server. This Battle Pass will differ to those from earlier seasons. It will let you catch up quickly and make progressing easier.
[*]The Battle Pass unlocks the following items, as well as various others: upgrade and crafting materials, completion gemstones, transfer items, and the item transfer warehouse.
[/list]
[b]Are there rules for transferring a character?[/b]
Yes. The following rules apply:
[list]
[*]You must select a server to transfer your character to before the NosFire event server is closed on 18th June 2025, otherwise you won’t be able to transfer your character. We will PM your character multiple times, reminding you to transfer your character before it is no longer possible to.
[*]Any items that your character currently has equipped (in the P window) will automatically transfer with them. With the Battle Pass you can unlock a warehouse which allows you to transfer up to 10 additional items. In addition, costumes, specialist card inventories, and active mall items such as Inventory Expansions or NosMerchant Medals will be automatically transferred with your character. Nothing else will be transferred.
[*]Families will not be transferred and the contents of family warehouses will be deleted.
[*]Gold will not be transferred (including the bank).
[*]Bazaar auctions will disappear and not be refunded.
[*]The Miniland will be transferred (NosMates and decorations) apart from the Partner’s Backpack.
[*]Your character’s progress, including quests, reputation, tattoos, skills, lifestyle class, etc., will also be transferred.
[*]If the name of your character is already taken on the destination server, you will have to change your character’s name the first time you log in after transferring.
[*]If all your character slots on the target server are full, your character will be deactivated. You can reactivate them in the standard manner via the website.
[*]Any NosMall items purchased via the website that you do not collect can be collected on the destination server.
[*]Your friends list, blacklist, and marriage will not be transferred.
[*]All parcels (post) will be deleted during the transfer.
[*]Please note: Any rewards you get from the Battle Pass or the Progress Book will not be transferred. Make sure to collect them before transferring.
[/list]
[b]Which boosts will be available and when?[/b]
[list]
[*]The following boosts will be permanently active on the NosFire server:
[*]2x XP
[*]4x Reputation (not in Act 4)
[*]2x XP for fishing, cooking, and training pets
[*]2x Fairy XP
[*]2x Gold
[*]2x Drops
[*]3x Family XP
[*]In addition, there will be special weekend boost events, such as the raid box event and upgrade events, which will give you even better benefits than usual. Some weekends may even have multiple events.
[/list]
[b]Will there also be events on the regular servers?[/b]
[list]
[*]Yes, the regular servers will have the same weekend events as the NosFire server, albeit with lower boosts.
[/list]
[b]Will there be an Easter event on every server?[/b]
[list]
[*]Yes, the Easter Event will be active on every server (starting 15th April 2025).
[/list]
[b]Will there be special server first challenges?[/b]
[list]
[*]No, there are no server first challenges planned for this event server.
[/list]
[b]Can I change the name of my character on the NosFire event server?[/b]
[list]
[*]Unfortunately this isn’t possible due to technical reasons. Please choose your character name carefully when creating your character, as you will not be able to change it later. Please note: As on all our other servers, using a name which violates our guidelines may lead to restrictions being placed on your account. Please keep this in mind while choosing your character’s name.
[/list]
Have fun,
The NosTale Team

[h3]Loyal Friends in Three Stages[/h3]

This special NosWheel has [b]three stages[/b], with each spin at stage 1 costing 25 NosDollars. There are lots of new friends and more to discover on all stages:
If you manage to collect [b]four keys[/b] in the first stage, you’ll have access to [b]stage 2 for 15 minutes[/b]. There are extra special treasures awaiting you in stage 2, and you’ll have a [b]higher chance of better prizes[/b], with each spin costing 55 NosDollars.

Collect [b]four keys[/b] in stage 2, and you’ll have the chance to try your luck in [b]stage 3[/b] of the NosWheel for [b]10 minutes[/b]. Here you’ll find the [b]best prizes with the highest chances[/b]. Each spin in stage 3 costs 110 NosDollars.

After 15 minutes in stage 2 or 10 minutes in stage 3, you’ll be sent back one stage and need to collect keys again to reach the second/third stages.

Exclusively in stages 2 and 3:

[*]Vampire Marie
[*]Gingerbread Fortune Box
[*]Santa Claws Bead
[*]... and much more!

[*]Wood Elf Archer Forga
[*]Alitus Prototype
[*]Dasher
[*]Maru’s Specialist Partner Card
[*]Mother Nature’s Rune Pack
[*]10x Fairy Booster
[*]Little Princess Venus
[*]... and much more!
[/list]
[h3]Pet: Santa Claws[/h3]

[list]
[*]Provides a 40% chance to reduce all incoming attack damage by 80%
[*]When defending, there is a 7% chance of triggering the Bag of Presents buff
[/list]

[*]Duration: 10 seconds

[*]Reduces damage taken by 20%
[/list]

[*]Cooldown: 60 seconds
[*]Increases melee attack by 400
[*]Increases the light element by 300

notes.title: Higher Starting Level and Specialist Balancing Improvements!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/7ee2b2c04099f4764493dddab96ca47e15227dbf.jpg[/img]

It’s not long to go until we release our next update with lots of exciting improvements. From [b]19th March[/b], it will be possible to start playing the game from a [b]higher level[/b]! The update also brings [b]balancing changes[/b] for a number of specialists, a raft of quality-of-life improvements, and more.

[h3]Specialist Balancing[/h3]

We’ve overhauled numerous specialists to make playing the game with them more fun and give them a sprucing up. Three specialists have had a major overhaul, while a further seven have seen a number of tweaks.

There are major changes to:
[list]
[*]Mystic Arts
[*]Sunchaser
[*]Warrior
[/list]
Plus smaller tweaks for:
[list]
[*]Assassin
[*]Scout
[*]Fire Storm
[*]Thunderer
[*]Tide Lord
[*]Archmage
[*]Voodoo Priest
[/list]
[h3]Start at Level 56[/h3]

As with every rookie hero in NosVille, you’ve taken your first steps into the world as an Adventurer, holding that wooden sword awkwardly in your hand, swinging it clumsily at your enemies. But those days are long behind you. As an experienced defender of NosVille, you know the ins and outs of adventuring, and have experienced all the challenges which new Adventurers need to face and could complete them with your eyes closed.
That’s why with the new update you will now be able to start out in the world of NosTale at level 56! In future you’ll have new options when creating a character, though of course you’ll still be able to start out fresh as a level-1 Adventurer if you prefer.

When creating your character you’ll find the following options in future:
[list]
[*]Adventurer (Level 1, just as before)
[*]Martial Artist (Level 81, only available if you already have another level-80 character)
[*]NEW – Archer (Level 56)
[*]NEW – Swordsman (Level 56)
[*]NEW – Mage (Level 56)
[/list]
If you choose to start at level 56, you’ll of course get some suitable gear so you can start playing straight away. You’ll have 4 fairies with the different elements, each with 30% energy, weapons (plus ammunition) and armour suitable to your class, plus your first specialist cards with resistances. And naturally you’ll have an array of skills already unlocked. Everything you need to dive straight into the adventure!

[h3]Quality-of-Life Improvements[/h3]

We’ve also made several changes to improve the gaming experience in the following areas:
[list]
[*]Some monster stats in the main quest line have been changed.
[*]Requirements for completing certain quests have been reduced.
[*]Party Time-Spaces can now be completed up to level 99.
[*]The minimum level for participating in SP10 Time-Spaces has been reduced to 84.
[*]The minimum level for climbing the Celestial Spire has been reduced to 84.
[/list]
We hope you have fun exploring the changes!
The NosTale Team

We’ve got an exciting weekend lined up with two events for your specialist partners! Enjoy [b]higher chances in the Partner Skill Event[/b] and get [b]50% more EXP from SP partner fusion[/b]!

[b]Event period[/b]: 14th February (11:00 AM) to 17th February (11:00 AM CET)

[h3]Improved Chances in the Partner Skill Event[/h3]
During the event, you’ll get a [b]+50%[/b] chance to reach higher levels when upgrading specialist partner skills!Whenever you upgrade a specialist partner skill, you can get one of any level, high or low. notes.title: Event: Magical Valentine’s Day
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/2139f990483ae9eb7a82f40cedbbc59474a0f9a8.jpg[/img]

We’re sure there’s someone special in NosVille you’ve always wanted to confess your love to. Valentine’s Day is the perfect time to finally take the plunge – romantic events and fantastic rewards await! Read on to find out everything you need to know!

[h2]Valentine’s Day in NosTale[/h2]
[b]From 12th February (11 AM) to 26th February (9 AM CET)[/b], there are lots of loveydovey events and promotions waiting for you in NosTale:

[h3]Event: Amora Needs Cupid’s Arrows[/h3]
[list][*]Help Amora spread the love in NosVille. To do that she’ll need some arrows.[/*][*]Talk to Amora once you reach at least level 50. She’ll explain what she needs to make them. Collect the components and bring them to her![/*][*]You’ll get the Wedding Costume Specialist Card (one per character) as a thank you.[/*][/list]
[h3]Event: Share the Love![/h3]
[list][*]Hunt monsters and collect Chocolate, Gift Boxes, and Ribbons.[/*][*]Exchange them for a Valentine’s Day Gift from Eva Energy. Then you’ll have the chance to share your love![/*][*]If your friend accepts your gift, you’ll get a Valentine’s Day Blessing that grants you extra energy and strength. This temporarily increases your attack and defence power.[/*][*]1–3 Gifts: Small Valentine’s Day Blessing[/*][*]4–9 Gifts: Valentine’s Day Blessing[/*][*]10+ Gifts: Big Valentine’s Day Blessing[/*][*]Now remember, not everyone will want to accept your gifts – but stay strong![/*][*]Don’t be shy, share your love! You can give someone a present up to 3 times each day.[/*][/list]
[h3]Event: Amora’s Missing Wings[/h3]
Love can be a double-edged sword. The tragic story of Wingless Amora and her true love will pull at your heartstrings. But you’ll soon feel all warm and cuddly again once you get your new ranged partner as a quest reward: Wingless Amora (one per character).

[h3]Discount Sale: Weddings at Bargain Prices[/h3]
Let your long-awaited dreams of the big day come true and pick up a Wedding Box at a 20% discount. Just remember not to take marriage lightly – divorce can be a painful experience. To remind you of this, the Separation Letter now costs 20% more. This offer applies during the Valentine’s Event. Don’t forget – you can also get Amora’s Specialist Partner Card in the shop.

Have fun!
The NosTale Team

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/d3d098ca98f94bb939ee07f57c56727ab6e590b0.jpg[/img]

Equip your favourite fairy and give her a major boost with the Fairy Upgrade Event! During the event the [b]chance for successful upgrades will be greatly increased[/b], while the [b]risk of failure is reduced[/b]!

[h3]How Fairy Upgrades Work[/h3]
[list]
[*]The fairy upgrade allows you to give a fairy a random effect, similar to the shells on your equipment.
[*]There are three possible outcomes of an upgrade attempt: success, failure or an overcharge.
[list][*][b]Success[/b]: Your fairy gets a random effect.
[*][b]Failure[/b]: The materials are consumed, but your fairy doesn’t get an effect.

In addition to a Fairy Bead, you need a certain amount of Perfume to change its owner, depending on the fairy’s upgrade level.
[*]Please note: Fairies which cannot be traded without a Fairy Bead cannot be upgraded (regular fairies, event fairies).
[/list]

notes.title: Community Update – First Half of 2025
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/e3648aefa3a44482ada06d3f3d040c565b0a52ff.jpg[/img]

We’re back with our community update for the first half of 2025!

First, we’d like to wish you a prosperous new year, and a joyful 2025 spent with your loved ones. On our end, we’ll continue working hard to ensure that the content we release in NosTale meets your expectations, making this year one of the most memorable in the game’s history.

Our goal for 2025 is to enhance existing content while also bringing more fun with in-game features that our players cherish, rather than focusing solely on new systems.

But before we dive into what’s coming, let’s take a look back at everything that’s happened over the past six months.

[h2]Hardcore Raids[/h2]
With the introduction of hardcore raids, we’ve released higher-difficulty content tailored to our more experienced players. These raids offer new challenges by presenting multiple harder versions of existing raids.

We’re delighted with how this update has performed and the positive reception from the community. As always, we’ll continue to listen to your feedback and make adjustments where possible to ensure you have an engaging and challenging experience while playing them.

[h2]International Server Merge and Summer Oasis Server[/h2]
In August, we launched a new server designed to improve upon the usual new server you get in summer. Our goal was to provide better levelling and progression, numerous events, extra boosts, and establish INT-Valehir as the destination server to help address depopulation issues.

Initially, there was some confusion, as players expected this server to resemble the NosFire event server introduced a few months earlier. To address this, we made changes by expanding the destination servers and enhancing exclusive features on the Summer Oasis server to better align it with the NosFire experience. These adjustments clearly increased interest in the server, but also discouraged some players from transferring to INT-Valehir.

We’ve taken note of these outcomes, and you can read below to see what we have planned for the near future.

[h2]Act 4 Revamp[/h2]
The most anticipated update we had in store for you this year was the Act 4 overhaul and we hope you’re enjoying the changes we’ve made.Our goal was to revitalise this content, making it more engaging for both PvE and PvP players alike.

We’ll be closely monitoring your feedback over the coming weeks to identify any adjustments that need to be made to ensure this update provides the best possible experience.

[h1]What’s to Come in 2025[/h1]
[h2]Balance Update and Quality of Life Adjustments[/h2]
We regularly hear your requests for more balance updates, and we’re excited to deliver!

With the next balance update, we are planning to focus on the Mystic Arts, Warrior and Sunchaser specialists.

Additionally, we are going to bring some nice quality-of-life improvements inspired by your suggestions on our Discord server. These include individual skill bars and an improved tutorial for new players, which we believe will greatly enhance the experience for beginners.

[h2]New NosFire Servers[/h2]
With the NosFire servers in 2024, we received a lot of positive feedback about this kind of boosted server that made it possible for players to jump right into the higher-level experience, instead of starting from scratch.

Building on that feedback, we’re excited to announce plans for a similar server in the first half of 2025. We’ll be making some adjustments to make it even more enjoyable, so stay tuned for more updates!

[h2]Family Celestial Spire[/h2]
One of the most engaging and unique pieces of content we released in recent years was Act 7’s Celestial Spire. In 2025, we want to explore this concept further, which is why we’re thrilled to announce a new version of the Celestial Spire designed for you to enjoy with your family. 

The specifics of this update are still being finalised, so keep an eye out for more details!

[h2]Summer Raid[/h2]
For some time now, we’ve been hearing your feedback about wanting new seasonal content beyond our regular events for Easter, Summer, Halloween, and others. With this in mind, we have planned with Entwell to work on new concepts for seasonal content in 2025.

You’ll get to experience it this summer with an exciting new event raid. We’ll keep you posted!

[h2]Server Merges[/h2]
We are fully aware of the concerns raised by INT-Valehir players regarding the server’s decreased population. While we’ve tried various methods to attract more players to the server, we recognise that the wait has been long enough. As a result, we will proceed with the much-requested INT-Valehir merge. This server will join the second international cluster alongside DE-Alzanor and FR-Cosmos.

The merge will create a server comparable in size to EU-Dragonveil, ensuring a stable population in the long term. This will provide players worldwide with two optimised servers for a better gameplay experience.

Large servers come with significant technical challenges, which is why we’re taking the time to prepare thoroughly. Once the merge date approaches, we will provide you with all the details.

We hope you’re as excited about this year’s updates as we are! Be sure to share your feedback with us on our usual platforms.Thank you all for making 2024 such an incredible year, and we can’t wait to see you in 2025!

The NosTale Team

notes.title: Winter in NosTale
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/499b1ac9d9c6d7efc71a3866c108caaa673d4d76.jpg[/img]

As you know, winter can get very cold and dreary. But not in your favourite game! In NosTale, you can expect lots of exciting events that you can hugely benefit from. Between, [b]10th December and 22nd January[/b], you can look forward to a number of events such as our winter raids, special quests, awesome gifts and much more!

[h2]Winter Raids[/h2]

[h3]Maru the Millennial Tiger Raid[/h3]

Challenge Maru and his followers in the raid! Just use Maru’s Raid Seal to take him on. If you beat the raid, you’ll be rewarded with his special Tiger Chest, which might contain the ‘Doppelgänger’ title as well as the Completion Gemstone Random Box.

Note: You can neither make yourself invisible, nor summon miniatures as Jajamaru in this raid.

[h3]Snowman Raid[/h3]

Take revenge on the snow monster for the Vikings – grab your friends and bring the heat to the wicked snowman! In reward for beating this exciting raid, you’ll earn a raid box containing specialist partner cards, the ‘Sleepy Head’ title and other wintry event items.

[h2]Winter Quests[/h2]

[h3]Daily Quests[/h3]
[list]
[*]Searching for the Siblings’ Mother
[*]Save the Siblings
[*]Need Sesame Oil
[/list]
You can earn Maru’s Raid Seal and Brass Coins as your reward for completing the daily quests.

[h3]Event Quest[/h3]

In these quests you can talk to the Wanderer NPC to exchange Brass Coins for the Wanderer’s Chest and the wonderful items hidden inside.

[h3]Red Bean Rice Cakes and Sesame Oil
[/h3]
Collect Red Bean Rice Cakes and Sesame Oil by hunting monsters, then exchange the items for a reward or use them yourself. The cakes restore you and your NosMate’s HP and MP, while the Sesame Oil is useful in the raid.

[h3]Daily Quests from Six NPCs in NosVille[/h3]

Meet good and evil reindeer, let the bells ring out, watch how scarves are made from magical wool and knitting needles, and much more. Collect colourful stockings for completing quests and exchange them for a Christmas Gift Box.

[h3]Happy New Year… Literally![/h3]

Collect golden letters (H, A, P, Y) and white letters (N, E, W, Y, A, R) that are dropped by monsters. Once you have enough to spell the words [b]HAPPY NEW YEAR[/b], you can exchange them for a Happy New Year Box and/or a Happy New Year Golden Box. If you’re lucky, you’ll find a Movement Scroll, fancy costumes, or a variety of fireworks inside.

[h2]Winter Surprises[/h2]

[h3]Magic Sleigh with Red-nosed Reindeer[/h3]

Santa Claus has something very special in store for you. In exchange for a Red-nosed Reindeer Bead (available from quests and the Winter Event raids) and a sleigh, Santa Claus will build a super-fast Magic Sleigh with Red-Nosed Reindeer for you.

[h3]Specialist Partners[/h3]

With Maru’s Specialist Partner Card you can transform Tom and Kliff into the Millennial Tiger.
With the second Specialist Partner Card ‘Maru in Mother’s Fur’, you can transform Tom and Kliff into a tiger disguised as the siblings’ caring mother. As a tiger, each partner has three razor-sharp skills: Hi-yah!, Spin Up, and Tiger Power.

[h3]Holiday Offers in the NosMall[/h3]
Winter items and Christmassy surprises await you in the NosMall – grab the [b]Christmas Tree Pack[/b] full of wonderful items for the holidays!

[h3]Advent Calendar in Daily Loyalty Bonus[/h3]

Many festive doors are waiting to be opened by you! Between [b]1st December (11 AM) and 25th December (11 AM CET)[/b] you can look forward to special gifts in the daily loyalty bonus. Get into the festive Christmas spirit and pick up presents!

[b]How It Works:[/b]
[list]
[*]Log in daily, open a field in the NosMall and find out which surprise is waiting for you today!
[*]During the time frame, you can get [b]special gifts[/b] on weekends as well as one [b]super surprise[/b] on Christmas Eve.
[*]Remember to log in every day to get your hands on as many special gifts as you can.
[*]Please not that the usual daily loyalty bonus gifts will not be given out during this time.
[/list]
Wishing you a wonderful winter season!
The NosTale Team

notes.title: Act 4: The Frozen Crown – The Legend Reborn!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/15330b25b4bb09a0362e3fa4d05a3738c5a7ee5f.jpg[/img]

Christmastime heralds a frosty comeback, as [b]Act 4[/b] returns in new glory! With thrilling new content and tasty challenges, it is time to break the ice and conquer the Frozen Crown. Monstrous opponents and legendary treasures await!

[h2]Act 4: The Legend Reawakens[/h2]
Board a ship in [b]Port Alveus[/b] and travel to Glacernon to rediscover Act 4!
[list][*][b]PvP Combat:[/b] Fight for supremacy in epic battles and claim unique rewards.[/*][*][b]New Challenges:[/b] Defeat terrifying monsters and take on the [b]revamped Act 4 raids[/b] which will challenge even the most accomplished of heroes.[/*][/list]
[h3]New PvP Contribution Points[/h3]
You can earn contribution points by defeating players of the enemy faction. These contribution points can then be spent to participate in Act 4 raids. To keep things frosty, the points will be reset every month.

You can only earn contribution points from players who have:
[list][*]the same champion level as you[/*][*]a higher champion level than you[/*][*]a maximum of 20 champion levels below you[/*][/list]
Players who are 21 champion levels or more below you aren’t worth any points. If you don’t have a champion level, then you are considered to have a champion level of 0. However, if you have a champion level of 1 or above, you won’t earn points from players with champion level 0. Similarly, champion level 0 players cannot earn points from players with champion level 1+.

The ranking rewards include temporary titles and items for Act 4 which are valid for 30 days. None of the titles can be traded, sold or deleted.

[h3]Revamped Act 4 Raids[/h3]
Steel yourselves for the return of the challenging and rewarding raid adventures from Act 4! Here’s what to look forward to:
[list][*]Revamped Raids: We’re bringing you newly tuned versions of well-known raids. The monsters and bosses will be familiar, but their stats have been adjusted.[/*][/list]
[b]Possible rewards:[/b]
[list][*]Simple boxes or even rarity 7/8 boxes[/*][*]Materials for crafting Fernon fairies[/*][*]Materials for the new shell upgrade system[/*][*]The chance to get champion level gear[/*][*]Perfection stones[/*][/list]
[h3]New World Boss: Frostbite Amarok[/h3]
This gigantic beast challenges you in time-limited battles. Only those who can defeat him within an hour can claim victory. Successful players will earn valuable PvP rewards.

Frostbite Amarok can be found on the map Amarok’s Hideout. The portal to the world boss opens on Mondays to Fridays at 12:30 PM, 6:30 PM, 8:30 PM and 10:30 PM CE(S)T.

When you enter the portal, all of your pets and partners will automatically be returned to your Miniland. If the boss is not defeated within 1 hour, all portals will close and there are no rewards.

The rewards consist of raid boxes containing items which mostly improve your PvP stats.

Depending on which faction deals the most damage to the boss, it will advance the progress towards opening an Act 4 raid by 25%.

[h3]The Shell Upgrade System[/h3]
The new shell upgrade system brings improvements for your weapons and armour:
[list][*][b]Collect Materials:[/b] Dismantle old shells into powder or collect Shell Stabilisers in Act 4 raids.[/*][*][b]Flexible Upgrading:[/b] Improve the effects of shells over multiple levels![/*][*][b]New Premium Items:[/b] Manage your upgrades with exclusive tools.[/*][/list]
A detailed overview of the changes can be found in the patch notes. Get ready for the Frozen Crown!
The NosTale Team

notes.title: Double Event Power at the Weekend
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/e7a612da91fc214cfc455763877c178b1cd05a56.jpg[/img]

Seize this opportunity to get rolling with some serious upgrades! Between [b]29th November (11 AM) and 2nd December (11 AM CET)[/b], you get a [b]+50%[/b] chance to reach the higher levels when upgrading specialist partner skills, plus [b]+50%[/b] when changing the rarity level of weapons and equipment items!

[h3]+50% Upgrading Specialist Partner Skills[/h3]
During the event, you’ll get a [b]+50%[/b] chance to reach higher levels when upgrading specialist partner skills!
Whenever you acquire a specialist partner skill, you can get one of any level, high or low. The levels are divided from highest to lowest into S, A, B, C, D, E and F. While this action cannot fail, you obviously want to get the best possible skill you can. This event gives you a greater chance of getting levels S and A!

[h3]+50% Changing Rarity Levels[/h3]
Want to get the most out of your gear? The moment has come for even greater success at improving it, as the chance is increased by [b]50%[/b] during the event!
An increased chance to change a weapon or equipment item’s rarity level up to max. level 7 (or level 8 for champion gear). This reduces the risk of the item being destroyed when changing the rarity level.

Have fun,
The NosTale Team

notes.title: NosTale Bonus Time
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/28a4a1521297984ec50817cf9a0db9b9cc65d3e3.jpg[/img]

NosTale Bonus Time

Make some room in your inventory and get ready for an amazing Bonus Time in the NosMall! notes.title: Event: Fairy Upgrade & Job Boost
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/d3d098ca98f94bb939ee07f57c56727ab6e590b0.jpg[/img]

Between [b]15th November (11 AM) and 18th November (11:00 AM CET)[/b] you can get a whopping [b]100% more job EXP[/b]! As if that weren’t enough, the [b]chance to successfully upgrade your fairy is greatly increased[/b] while the risk of failure is reduced!

[h3]Fairy Upgrade[/h3]
[list]
[*]The fairy upgrade allows you to give a fairy a random effect, similar to the shells on your equipment.
[*]There are three possible outcomes of an upgrade attempt: success, failure or an overcharge.
[*][b]Success[/b]: Your fairy gets a random effect.
[*][b]Failure[/b]: The materials are consumed, but your fairy doesn’t get an effect.
[*][b]Overcharge[/b]: Your fairy becomes overcharged. A Golden Tool is needed to upgrade further.
[*]After upgrading a fairy, it is soulbound to your character. In addition to a Fairy Bead, you need a certain amount of Perfume to change its owner, depending on the fairy’s upgrade level.
[*]Please note: Fairies which can be traded without a Fairy Bead cannot be upgraded (regular fairies, event fairies).
[*][b]Event:[/b] During the event the chance for successful fairy upgrades will be greatly increased, while the risk of failure is reduced!
[/list]

[h3]More EXP for Fishing, Cooking & Pet Trainers[/h3]
In this event, you can get a massive [b]100% more experience[/b] for successful Angler, Cook and Pet Trainer activities!

Have fun,
The NosTale Team

notes.title: Fangtastic Events in NosTale!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/aaf01c57252db2aabe43c0ef31a30cfd81f7bf82.jpg[/img]

Get ready: [b]from 23rd October until 11th November[/b], NosVille and Port Alveus will be decked out in eerie Halloween decorations and the mad Professor Macavity, Foxy and Jack O’Lantern will be causing all sorts of creepy mayhem in NosTale! An [b]additional quest[/b] and a [b]title with powerful effects[/b] are also waiting for you!

[h1]Event Raids[/h1]
[h3]Jack O’Lantern and His Minions[/h3]
Defeat the evil pumpkin Jack O’Lantern in the raid! He’s supported by his Pumpkin Bushi and Pumpkin Bomb minions. In reward for victory, you can claim a Halloween raid box.Amongst others you can pick up a Glowing Pumpkin Hat and creepy Tarot Cards from the raid box in this event.

[h3]Foxy and Her Brood[/h3]
Challenge Foxy and her sneaky brood in the raid! Use Foxy’s Raid Seal to confront her. If you’re successful, you’ll earn her Wonder Chest in reward. With a little luck it might contain Foxy’s Specialist Partner Card!Foxy is a raid boss with super skills, as well as being a powerful partner. Tame her and she’ll be your loyal companion forever!

The raid seals can be picked up in daily quests. Plus you can earn more rewards by collecting flasks.

[h3]Mad Professor Macavity[/h3]
The mad genius feline is back! Rally seven players around you and start the raid. Two of the eight players will be transformed into Professor Macavity and the Test Subject. Let the hunt begin![b]Full details on the raid:[/b]
[list][*]Mad Professor Macavity’s Raid Seal drops in Foxy and Jack O’Lantern’s raids.[/*][*]The raid can only be attempted 5 times per day. There are however reset tickets.[/*][*]Exactly 8 players are needed to start the raid.[/*][*]Players who want to play must bring a pet.[/*][*]Professor Macavity can drag the Test Subject to him. Both need to work together to capture enemies.[/*][*]Only the hunted players can open boxes during the raid and receive handy items for the chase.[/*][*]Hunters can freeze opponents for a short time.[/*][*]Before hunted players can leave the raid, they must find a key in one of the boxes.[/*][*]The hunters must prevent the hunted from leaving the raid. For each player caught, the hunters earn a raid box. Caught players leave the raid without a box.[/*][*]If a hunted player leaves the raid successfully, they earn a raid box.[/*][*]White Witch Laurena’s Wand appears if the hunted player with the wand is caught.[/*][/list]
[h3]Reward: Titles with Powerful Effects[/h3]
In reward for each of the three Halloween raids there is one of these titles in the raid box:
[list][*]Test Subject: Increases resistance to Fatal Bleeding and other Bleeding by 1%.[/*][*]Sly Dog: Increases max. MP by 300.[/*][*]Horror: Deals greater damage to low-level undead monsters by 3%.[/*][/list]
[h1]Daily Quests[/h1]
[h3]The Cursed 13[/h3]
Talk to Mary in NosVille to start the quest and earn yourself a title by successfully completing all three Halloween raids 13 times! The ‘Monstrous’ title gives you a 2% chance of triggering Horror when you attack.

[h3]Daily Quests from NosVille NPCs[/h3]
Talk to Eric, Eva Energy, Malcolm Mix and Teoman Topp and pick up handy items in the Trick or Treat Quests! For example, you can get Yellow and Black Pumpkin Sweets, the Halloween Blessing, a Glowing Pumpkin Hat or a Halloween Costume Scroll. Playing the quests will also get you Bags of Sweets which can be exchanged for Jack O’Lantern’s raid seal.
[list][*]Defeating monsters causes them to drop goodies like Yellow and Black Pumpkin Sweets. You can either gobble them down, or exchange them for a Halloween Costume Scroll or a raid seal for Jack O’Lantern.[/*][*]Don your Glowing Pumpkin Hat! You’ll be sure to set a new trend in the village! You can get the deadly smart headgear from the Halloween Horror Box or the raid box.[/*][*]Halloween Costume Scroll: Transform into 10 different creepy critters which you know from the game. The costume gives you 4x attack power and 2x defence power.[/*][/list]
Wishing you tons of spooky fun,
The NosTale Team

notes.title: Double Decker Events: Boosts for Equipment and Jobs
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/c177063012cf6193bbde3b8930aa0b43669c104c.jpg[/img]

We’re ramping up the excitement this weekend with [b]two simultaneous events[/b]! Take advantage of more chances when [b]changing equipment rarity[/b], plus [b]100% more EXP[/b] for your [b]Angler, Cook[/b] and [b]Pet Trainer[/b] job specialisations between [b]11th October (11 AM) and 14th October (11 AM CEST)[/b].

[h2]More EXP for Fishing, Cooking & Pet Trainers[/h2]
Go fishing and land a whopper, prepare a delicious meal from what you’ve caught and then train your most talented pets! All three of these activities give you 100% more EXP during the event!

[h3]Big Fishing[/h3]
Here’s one for all you avid anglers – don’t miss a great chance to earn additional experience while fishing. Prepare your hooks, cast your lines, and land the biggest catch you can!
Each time you carry out a fishing activity, you’ll earn additional experience. The experience you earn depends on the rarity of the fish you catch. Each fish caught earns you [b]100% more experience[/b].

[h3]Bon Appétit[/h3]
With the Chef specialist card you can become a wizard in the kitchen, preparing top-class delicacies. During this event you earn [b]100% more experience[/b] for your successful cooking adventures.
Your meals provide buffs, and the higher your EXP, the greater the level of your specialist card. The more cooking experience you earn, the rarer the meals you prepare.

[h3]Pawfessional Trainer[/h3]
Activate the Pet Trainer specialist card, assemble your best pets and prove your skill! During the event you will be rewarded with bonus experience.
Each time you successfully extract Pet Essences or tame a pet you’ll gain an [b]additional 100% EXP[/b]!

[h2]Higher Rarity Success[/h2]
Want to polish up your gear? Now’s your chance to make it even better!
During the event, you can benefit from a [b]50% higher chance to successfully change the rarity[/b]. This increases the chance to change a weapon or equipment item’s rarity level up to max. level 7 (or level 8 for champion gear) and reduces the risk of the item being destroyed on a failed upgrade attempt.

Have fun,
The NosTale Team
