notes.title: 17 Years: Happy Birthday, NosTale!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/3ef447297246a08956b8b51d6e4bd619837b03d0.jpg[/img]

Put on your party hats and light the candles: NosTale is celebrating its [b]17th birthday[/b]! Starting on [b]30th September[/b], we have a whole range of exciting events, a community competition, and a free mount lined up for you in celebration of this special anniversary. Read on to discover what awaits.

[h3]Collectors’ Event[/h3]

Between [b]30th September (11 AM) and 23rd October (11 AM CEST)[/b], you can find certain event items throughout the world of NosTale. Defeat various monsters to collect the following event items: 17, NosYears. These can be exchanged for the following:
[list][*]A medal with beneficial effects (once per account)[/*][*]Grants a buff for 15 days that increases the [b]EXP[/b] (for characters, pets and partners), as well as your [b]attack[/b] and [b]defence[/b] by [b]10%[/b].[/*][*]Basic specialist points[/*][*]A buff that temporarily increases HP and MP[/*][*]The event items can also be used as recovery items: they regenerate HP and MP.[/*][/list]
[h3]Great Community Competition[/h3]

We’re looking for a new background for the character selection screen. Get your creative juices flowing and design some backgrounds which suit the themes of autumn and winter. Please remember that there must be space for the characters in the middle of the image (see below for more details).

The best 10 artworks (5 for the autumn theme, 5 for winter) will win an [b]exclusive XXL NosTale Mousepad[/b].
The best artwork of all will even be added to the game and can be admired by all NosPlayers.

[b]Competition Details[/b]
[list][*]Create a digital image in the resolution 1024 x 768[/*][*]Using AI tools is not allowed and will lead to disqualification[/*][*]Submit your work to anniversaryevent@nostale.co.uk, with your nickname and your server[/*][*]Deadline for submissions: 15th October 2024[/*][*]You can find the Terms and Conditions at https://agbserver.gameforge.com/files/pdf/en_GB/terms_raffles_and_competitions.pdf[/*][*]Please note that there must be space for the characters in the centre of the image, as illustrated in this example:[/*][/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/515893226664566a7a4307899c8fd096f60273b1.jpg[/img]

[h3]Daily Birthday Calendar[/h3]

Don’t forget to log in every day because we’ve prepared a birthday calendar for you. The calendar runs from [b]1st October to 18th October[/b] and has great rewards in store for you, including various exclusive items and more.

[h3]Free Mount[/h3]
Pick up the free [b]Motorbike[/b] mount from the NosMall between [b]30th September (11 AM) and 14th October (11 AM CEST)[/b], hit the road and cruise to the NosTale party in style!

[h3]Even More Action[/h3]

Have you had enough of celebrating and want to get into some serious fighting action? Then slip into your best armour and enter your favourite raids in hardcore mode! Learn more in this news post: https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/550470/view/4676515207785627664?l=english

Have fun with the anniversary events!
The NosTale Team

notes.title: Hardcore Raids & Family Expansion - Patch notes
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/fa99097d7abbaf7943821e49b54024aa7eb00199.jpg[/img]

Hello everyone!

A new update has arrived which you’ve all been waiting so long far. We always try to make sure that we release each update to the highest possible quality, which is why it can sometimes take longer than you might prefer.In this update, we’re introducing hardcore versions of existing raids, an expansion to the family system, plus numerous other changes. 

There are hardcore versions for the following raids:

[table][tr][th]Act 1–3 (champion level 30+)[/th][th]Act 5 (champion level 50+)[/th][th]Act 6 (champion level 65+)[/th][th]Act 7 (champion level 80+)[/th][th]Act 8 (champion level 80+)[/th][/tr][tr][td]Mother Cuby[/td][td]Ibrahim[/td][td]Zenas[/td][td]Twisted Spirit King Kirollas[/td][td]Zombie Dragon Valehir[/td][/tr][tr][td]Ginseng[/td][td]Kertos the Demon Dog[/td][td]Erenia[/td][td]Twisted Beast King Carno[/td][td]Ice Dragon Alzanor[/td][/tr][tr][td]Dark Castra[/td][td]Valakus King of Fire[/td][td][/td][td]Demon God Belial[/td][td]Weak Asgobas[/td][/tr][tr][td]Giant Black Spider[/td][td]Fire God Grenigas[/td][td][/td][td]Evil Overlord Paimon[/td][td][/td][/tr][tr][td]Massive Slade[/td][td]Lord Draco[/td][td][/td][td]Revenant Paimon[/td][td][/td][/tr][tr][td][/td][td]Glacerus the Ice Cold[/td][td][/td][td][/td][td][/td][/tr][/table]

Event raids and other temporary raids are not factored into this change, as this would mean players have fewer opportunities to collect the rewards from the current reward system. Similarly, the raids from Act 9 are not in the list as we feel that they are still new enough and do not need a special hardcore version. We may introduce these at a later juncture.

These raids have been chosen so that players have the option of playing older content in a more updated form, and are no longer forced to focus on just 1 or 2 sets of raids.

As with every update, we endeavour to make the gaming experience the best it can possibly be, but we’re also reliant on your feedback. In this update, we’ve added a new feature which will allow us to change the strength of monsters in hardcore raids on the fly, so that we can guarantee a smoother experience for you. 

This means that if certain monsters turn out to be too strong in a raid, we’ll be able to tweak their strength. We’ll take your feedback into account, as well as monitor players’ performance in the game, to make sure the raids remain both challenging and fair.

[b]Hardcore Raids[/b]
[list][*]You earn hardcore raid seals by completing the normal versions of the raids. [/*][*]At the moment there are no restrictions for entering hardcore raids beyond the minimum champion level. [/*][*]Hardcore raids can only be started with a complete team.[/*][*]All hardcore raids have a daily limit.[/*][*]The entry portals are the same as for the regular raids.[/*][*]The raids in Acts 1–3 require champion level 30+, raids in Act 5 champion level 50+, raids in Act 6 champion level 65+, raids in Act 7 champion level 80+, and raids in Act 8 likewise champion level 80+.[/*][*]Raid tokens open up a crafting window where you can craft rewards such as mini-pet versions of the raid bosses, resistances, act-specific materials and more. Mini-pets deal more damage in both the regular and hardcore versions of their raids.[/*][*]In all the major towns like NosVille, Dragonveil and Undercity, there will be a Raid Token Manager who can craft certain items for you like passive medals, perfection stone bags and more. [/*][*]The raid list will display the average champion level of the hardcore raid team.[/*][*]You receive a notification when you’ve inflicted enough damage to receive the rewards.[/*][/list]
[b]The following things change in hardcore raids[/b]
[list][*]Monsters are stronger, depending on the strength of the team.[/*][*]There are 5/8/10 lives depending on the number of raid participants. [/*][*]You only have one life in hardcore raids; if you die twice, you’ll be ejected from the raid.[/*][*]Gold and reputation are awarded depending on the difficulty of the raid, with the gold added directly to your inventory.[/*][*]An additional hardcore token is awarded upon completing a hardcore raid.[/*][*]There is a greater chance to get raid boxes of rarity levels 7 and 8.[/*][*]After completing a raid, the damage statistics of the top three players who inflicted the most damage to the boss will be displayed. The stats are currently only available in hardcore raids, but may be added to normal raids in the future.[/*][*]You must deal a certain amount of damage to the raid boss in order to receive gold, reputation and the hardcore tokens. The raid box however is a guaranteed reward. Since it is more difficult for lower-level players to deal damage, the amount of damage they must inflict is lower than for higher-level players.[/*][*]Raid boxes, special items like Alzanor’s Horn, and big item drops are the same as in normal raids.[/*][/list]
[b]Family Expansion[/b]
[list][*]The family system has been expanded to level 30, bringing new rewards with each level.[/*][*]There are new unique achievements awarding FXP and new passive buffs.[/*][*]There are new daily missions relating to hardcore raids which award FXP.[/*][*]The FXP requirements for levels 1–20 have been reduced by 20%.[/*][/list]
[b]Other Changes[/b]
[list][*]The seals in Acts 1–3 can now be crafted without entering a Time-Space (as on NosFire).[/*][*]The Ginseng Pot now takes percentage damage per hit.[/*][*]Dark Castra now appears in the boss room without a delay.[/*][*]The ‘Damage from critical hits is increased by 300%’ effect has been removed from Massive Slade.[/*][*]The raid monster Slade now has magic defence.[/*][*]The Protection Blessing buff from Ibrahim no longer applies.[/*][*]There is a greater chance to get raid boxes of rarity levels 7 and 8 in Alzanor and Valehir.[/*][*]The gold drops in the Alzanor and Valehir raids have been increased from 30x 40,000 Gold to 60x 30,000 Gold.[/*][*]Several changes to the daily quests in Act 8 which provide more experience and act-related materials.[/*][*]Several changes to the daily quests in Act 9.1 which provide more experience and act-related materials: https://nostale.comastuff.com/HCRaids_Act_8_+_9_Changes.pdf[/*][*]Increased the chance of dropping Techron’s research books, Fairy Affinity (2), Mullan Tools and Polluted Lightning Conductors.[/*][*]The number of items for the 17th anniversary have been reduced to 2, to save space in your inventory. As with other events, they now count as snacks and potions.[/*][*]You can no longer fill your basic SP from the anniversary event.[/*][*]Added a limit of 15,000 damage to the Sudden Twist buff.[/*][*]The duration of Erenia’s Curse has been reduced from 60 to 15 seconds.[/*][*]The Crusader Commander in Erenia’s raid now suffers percentage damage per hit.[/*][*]The cooldown of Zenas’ healing and monster spawn skills has been increased.[/*][*]Priestess Kelly of the Second Squad in Zenas’ raid now suffers percentage damage per hit.[/*][*]The waiting time in Zenas’ raid has been reduced from 3 minutes to 1 minute.[/*][/list]
[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list][*]Fixed an issue which could cause dance timers to be overwritten by others.[/*][*]Fixed an issue where the mini-bosses in the Paimon raids wouldn’t spawn under certain circumstances.[/*][/list]

notes.title: Live Soon: Hardcore Raids & Higher Family Levels
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/fa99097d7abbaf7943821e49b54024aa7eb00199.jpg[/img]

Get ready, as on [b]30th September (11 AM CEST)[/b] we’re launch challenging [b]hardcore raids[/b] full of terrifying monsters and powerful bosses! Plus set out on new adventures with your family and reach [b]higher family levels[/b].

[h3]Hardcore Raids[/h3]

Are you ready to take the next level of challenges? The hardcore raids have increased difficulty and are available in almost all Acts of the game on all servers. Only the most talented of heroes will be able to succeed in them and snatch the precious loot!

[b]Raids with Hardcore Mode[/b]

[table][tr][th]Act 1–3 (champion level 30+)[/th][th]Act 5 (champion level 50+)[/th][th]Act 6 (champion level 65+)[/th][th]Act 7 (champion level 80+)[/th][th]Act 8 (champion level 80+)[/th][/tr][tr][td]Mother Cuby[/td][td]Ibrahim[/td][td]Zenas[/td][td]Twisted Spirit King Kirollas[/td][td]Zombie Dragon Valehir[/td][/tr][tr][td]Ginseng[/td][td]Kertos the Demon Dog[/td][td]Erenia[/td][td]Twisted Beast King Carno[/td][td]Ice Dragon Alzanor[/td][/tr][tr][td]Dark Castra[/td][td]Valakus King of Fire[/td][td][/td][td]Demon God Belial[/td][td]Weak Asgobas[/td][/tr][tr][td]Giant Black Spider[/td][td]Fire God Grenigas[/td][td][/td][td]Evil Overlord Paimon[/td][td][/td][/tr][tr][td]Massive Slade[/td][td]Lord Draco[/td][td][/td][td]Revenant Paimon[/td][td][/td][/tr][tr][td][/td][td]Glacerus the Ice Cold[/td][td][/td][td][/td][td][/td][/tr][/table]

In order to enter the new hardcore raids, you’ll need to have the matching hardcore raid seal. Hardcore raid seals can be acquired by completing the respective raid in normal mode. These can be traded and sold.

Hardcore raids can only be entered with a full team, where the size of the team is the same as for the normal difficulty.

[b]Monsters and Bosses[/b]
The monsters and bosses in hardcore raids up the ante, and have the following elevated stats:
[list][*]HP[/*][*]Min./max. damage[/*][*]Attack and defence levels[/*][*]All three defence types[/*][*]Hit rate[/*][*]All four resistance types[/*][/list]
[b]Life Limits[/b]
In normal mode, you have a certain number of lives (depending on the number of players), but in hardcore mode, these will be reduced to 5, 8 or 10 lives.

[b]Better Rewards[/b]
[list][*]Raid Token Shop – Players can earn new raid-specific tokens which can be exchanged for special items, pets and more in the Raid Token Shop. The tokens cannot be traded or sold, but can be used to craft items like a pet or new titles. They can also be used to craft act tokens which can be used for act-related items.[/*][*]Increased Drop Rates – The item drop rate at the end of a raid remains unchanged, but the chance of dropping reputation, gold or a box of rarity 7/8 increases depending on the difficulty of the raid.[/*][/list]
[b]Additional Features[/b]
Damage Gauge in Hardcore Raids – The three players who inflict the most damage in the boss room will be displayed.

[h3]Family Level Expansion[/h3]

Take your family to the next level and tighten the bonds between you! Families can now progress to level 30, with new missions and unique achievements available, waiting to be discovered.

[b]Family levels 20–30[/b]

Have fun,
The NosTale Team

notes.title: Event: Fairy Upgrade
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/d3d098ca98f94bb939ee07f57c56727ab6e590b0.jpg[/img]

Equip your favourite fairy and give her a major boost with the Fairy Upgrade Event! During the event the [b]chance for successful upgrades will be greatly increased[/b], while the [b]risk of failure is reduced[/b]!

[b]Event period[/b]: 27th September (11 AM) to 30th September (11 AM CEST)

[h3]How Fairy Upgrades Work[/h3]
[list]
[*]The fairy upgrade allows you to give a fairy a random effect, similar to the shells on your equipment.
[*]There are three possible outcomes of an upgrade attempt: success, failure or an overcharge.
[*][b]Success[/b]: Your fairy gets a random effect.
[*][b]Failure[/b]: The materials are consumed, but your fairy doesn’t get an effect.
[*][b]Overcharge[/b]: Your fairy becomes overcharged. A [i]Golden Tool[/i] is needed to upgrade further.
[*]After upgrading a fairy, it is soulbound to your character. In addition to a Fairy Bead, you need a certain amount of Perfume to change its owner, depending on the fairy’s upgrade level.
[*]Please note: Fairies which cannot be traded without a Fairy Bead cannot be upgraded (regular fairies, event fairies).
[/list]

notes.title: End of the Summer Oasis & Server Merge
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/0ee3a6d0b1e6f2595a03b2e3d19de456ef768d75.jpg[/img]

As the summer draws to a close, it’s time to bid farewell to our Summer Oasis server. As previously announced when we launched the server, there will be a server merge on [b]Wednesday, 25th September 2024[/b]. All characters will by default be transferred to the Valehir server, though it is possible to choose a different server using an item.

In order to answer some of your most important questions in advance, here’s our list of [b]server merge FAQs[/b].

[h2]Server Merge FAQ[/h2]

[b]Where can I see which server I have selected?[/b]
[list][*]You can see your chosen server in the Consumables tab (where your NosBazaar medals and expansions are shown).[/*][/list]
[b]Can I transfer my items with my character?[/b]
[list][*]All items will be automatically transferred.[/*][*]The contents of family warehouses will be sent per parcel to the family heads.[/*][*]The contents of regular warehouses will be sent per parcel to the characters with the highest level.[/*][*]Bazaar contents will be sent per parcel to the characters with the highest level, and gold from already sold items will be sent to the character.[/*][*]As per normal, there is a gold limit of 2,000,000,000 gold on the merged server. If you have more than this before the merge, it will be reduced to the limit. If you lose gold during the merge, please contact our Support team.[/*][/list]
[b]How can I transfer my character?[/b]
[list][*]All characters will be automatically transferred to the server Valehir.[/*][*]In order to choose a different destination server, you need the item which can be acquired from the Battle Pass reward (level 13).[/*][*]Characters who have chosen a different destination server will be transferred to their chosen server along with all other Summer Oasis characters on the same account.[/*][/list]
[b]How can I choose my destination server?[/b]
[list][*]There will be five different items, each representing a different destination server, which allow you to choose your server. The items cannot be deleted and you have time until the Summer Oasis server closes to choose your destination server.[/*][*][b]Please note[/b]: The item for the locked server Jotunheim still exists, but if you choose this item, you will be transferred to [b]Valehir[/b].[/*][/list]
[b]Are there any rules for transferring?[/b]
Certainly! The following rules apply:
[list][*]You must select a destination server before the Summer Oasis server goes offline, otherwise your character will be transferred to Valehir by default.[/*][*]All items in your regular inventory will be transferred automatically.[/*][*]Families will not be transferred. The contents of family warehouses will be sent per parcel to the family heads.[/*][*]Gold will be transferred (including the bank).[/*][*]Bazaar auctions will be ended and sent to characters per parcel.[/*][*]The Miniland will be transferred (NosMates and decorations) including the Partner’s Backpack.[/*][*]Your character’s progress including quests, reputation, tattoos, skills, lifestyle class etc. will also be transferred.[/*][*]If the name of your character is already taken on the destination server, you will have to change your character’s name the next time you log in after transferring.[/*][*]If all your character slots on the target server are full, your character will be deactivated and you can activate them in the standard manner via the website.[/*][*]Uncollected NosMall items can be collected on the destination server.[/*][*]Friends list, blacklist and marriage will not be transferred.[/*][*]All parcels will be transferred.[/*][/list]

notes.title: Increased Chance in the Perfection Event
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/c0dc515df0ab94d3f22f80fe702258df9423d013.jpg[/img]

[h3]Previously, in NosTale…[/h3]

During our Pet Taming Event between 26th August and 1st September, players were able to earn points for the community by taming pets. Every 100,000 points earned together by the community increased the perfection chance in the upcoming event by 1%, up to a maximum of 75% (normal server) /150% (Oasis server).

[h3]Just Rewards[/h3]
Did you do all you could to help the community in the Pet Taming Event? Excellent! Then enough suspense, it’s time to reveal the results <drum roll>:

notes.title: Double Event Power at the Weekend
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/93141110ec58c940476c615d7f95c40f2a5134c6.jpg[/img]

We’ve got another exciting weekend lined up with [b]two simultaneous events[/b]! Enjoy higher chances in the [b]Partner Skill Event[/b] and get [b]double EXP time in the Land of Life[/b]!

[b]Event period[/b]: 23rd August (11 AM) to 26th August (11 AM CEST).

[h3]Partner Skill Event[/h3]

During the event, you’ll get a [b]+60%[/b] chance to reach higher levels when upgrading specialist partner skills on regular servers. The chance is even increased by 121% on the Summer Oasis server!

Whenever you acquire a specialist partner skill, you can get one of any level, high or low. The levels are divided from highest to lowest into S, A, B, C, D, E and F. While this action cannot fail, you obviously want to get the best possible skill you can. This event gives you a greater chance of getting skills of levels S, A and B!

[h3]Double EXP Time in the Land of Life[/h3]

During the event, you can spend [b]up to 4 hours in the Land of Life every day[/b]. You’ll also receive about 20 minutes more to plan your entries around Asgobas’ appearance.

[b]About the Land of Life[/b]The Land of Life is the ideal place to increase your champion level. Kill monsters and bosses together with your family members to earn EXP and powerful items.

The Dragon Lord Asgobas will appear there in regular intervals. It is not possible to enter the Land of Life while he is present, but all players who entered before his appearance [b]earn 100% more experience[/b].

The Land of Life is divided into three zones: one for champion level 30–64, one for 60–82 and one for 80–90. You need to meet the respective minimum level requirement in order to enter these zones.

The Land of Life is open according to the following pattern:
[list][*]midnight–1:00 AM: open[/*][*]1:00 AM–2:00 AM: closed (Asgobas appears and all EXP earned in this period is doubled)[/*][*]2:00 AM–3:00 AM: Land of Life is open again[/*][*]... and so on[/*][/list]
Have fun!
The NosTale Team

notes.title: Event: Exclusive Pet in Sealed Vessels
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/a703b4ed76a811d51298d76ff6d23dfde072978d.jpg[/img]

Mysterious Sealed Vessels are circulating around the world of NosTale. Surrounded by a magical aura, only [b]parties of experienced adventurers[/b]  should dare open them, as these otherwise unremarkable vessels contain the most wicked of creatures, banished by wise mages. 

The brave – or the foolish – who nevertheless rise to the challenge to liberate and defeat the evil creature inside one of these Sealed Vessels have a chance of being rewarded with a treasure chest. These contain fantastic items from the NosMall. With a dollop of good fortune, the monsters could even drop our exclusive pet which gives you seriously powerful buffs!

[b]Event Time:[/b] Between 9th August (11 AM CEST) and 16th August (11 AM CEST).

[h3]Here’s How[/h3]
[list][*]Pick up a Sealed Vessel from the NosMall, NosWheel or NosBazaar.[/*][*]Rally your friends/family together and steel yourselves for a tough fight.[/*][*]Open the Sealed Vessel summoning one of 20 monsters.[/*][*]The higher the monster’s level, the greater the chance of collecting a treasure chest.[/*][/list]
[h3]Things to Know[/h3]
[list][*]The Sealed Vessels can be opened on any map, with the exceptions of those detailed below.[/*][*]Sealed Vessels cannot be opened in the capitals (NosVille, Port Alveus, Sunset Cliff).[/*][*]Only 11 Sealed Vessels can be active simultaneously on the following maps: NosVille Meadows, Mine Plains, Sunny Meadows, Fernon Outpost, Western Mine (all maps), Northern Mine (all maps), Fernon Temple (all maps) and Fernon’s Hideout (all maps).[/*][/list]
In addition to the treasure chest, one of the following items may drop in the displayed amount after defeating the monster:
[list]
[*]1x Death Lancer Set
[*]2x Wings of Friendship
[*]20x Huge Recovery Potion
[*]10x Cylloan Spring Water
[*]10x Guardian Angel’s Blessing
[*]1x Special Pet Food
[*]1x Tame Raccoon Bird 
[*]1x Fire Devil Set
[*]1x Liberator 
[*]1x Small Ice Witch 
[*]1x Ice Witch Costume Set 
[*]1x Ice Witch Costume Wings
[*]1x Death Lancer 
[*]1x Death Lancer Murderwings
[*]1x Fire Devil Costume Wings (Permanent) 
[*]1x Mini Fire Devil
[*]1x Golden Equipment Protection Scroll
[*]1x Rune of Fortune Scroll
[*]1x Eagle Eyes
[*]1x Legendary Hero
[/list]
[h3]New Pet Buffs[/h3]
The new pet can drag your enemies right up to you. Meanwhile, the buff it grants increases all attacks by 10%, and increases light resistance by 10.

Enjoy the monster hunt!
The NosTale Team

notes.title: Summer Oasis Server Starts Today!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/7f48d48b3bcb0022ec77e13307525d7bed8766ac.jpg[/img]

Have you packed your suitcases for this magical break? Today sees the launch of the [b]Summer Oasis server[/b] and the start of the [b]summer adventure in NosTale[/b]!

As already mentioned in our [url=https://gameforge.com/play/nostale/news/c5402d4a-7ba2-49ff-8dcb-544e507ed5c7]first announcement[/url] , on this special international server you’ll benefit from [b]permanent boosts, special weekend events[/b], a [b]free Battle Pass[/b] and much more. At the end of the server, it will be merged into the Valehir server.

[list]
[*][b]Summer Oasis server starts[/b]: 7th August 2024
[*][b]Summer Oasis server ends[/b]: 25th September 2024
[/list]
[h3]Boosts, Events & Achievements[/h3]
Here are all the details on the boosts, events and achievements to look forward to on the Summer Oasis server!

[b]Permanent Boosts[/b]
These boosts are permanently active on the server:
[list]
[*]2x EXP
[*]2x Gold
[*]2x Drops
[*]4x Reputation (exc. Act 4)
[*]2x Fairy EXP
[*]2x Family EXP
[*]2x XP for fishing, cooking and training pets
[/list]
[b]Events[/b]
[list]
[*]The [b]Battle Pass[/b] is available for free! Complete exciting missions to earn useful items for your adventures.
[*]In a few days, the [b]Sealed Vessel Event[/b] will begin! Are you ready to open the vessels and take on the enemies who pop out of them? Victorious fighters can look forward to awesome treasure chests!
[/list]
[b]Achievements[/b]

During the Summer Oasis, you’ll find a special website at https://nostale.comastuff.com/OasisAchievements/Achievements.php?lang=en, where you can see a list of all the achievements which can be unlocked. Click on an achievement to see the reward in the top right, and below that, a list of players who’ve already unlocked it.
Each achievement is limited to a maximum of 5 or 10 players (excluding achievements for raid parties, which are for the fastest group).
Please note that only the things you do on the Summer Oasis server count towards these achievements.

Achievements are divided into four categories:
[list]
[*][b]Solo Achievements[/b]: You can complete these individually.
[*][b]Raid Party Achievements[/b]: For these, you’ll need to be in a raid party.
[*][b]Server Achievements[/b]: These include all achievements which can be completed server-wide.
[*][b]Completed Achievements[/b]: Here you’ll see all the achievements which have already been completed.
[/list]
In addition to the achievements listed on the website, there are also [b]three special achievements[/b]:
[list]
[*]Reach a top 10 ranking for the highest reputation (excluding Act 4) by 28th August.
[*]Reach a top 10 ranking for the most points in Act 4 by 28th August.
[*]Reach a top 10 ranking for the most victories in the Arena of Talents/Arena of Masters by 28th August.
[/list]
[b]Please note[/b] that the website will be updated at regular intervals, and it may take some time before unlocked achievements appear as ‘completed’.

Once you unlock an achievement, you’ll receive various [b]rewards[/b] such as great titles or prized tame pets! Please be aware however that while our little delivery bushi will be working hard to deliver all the rewards, it may take a couple of days before your receive your items.


[h3]Server Merge[/h3]
On 25th September 2024, the Summer Oasis server will come to an end, and all characters, together with all of the content they’ve unlocked, will be transferred to the international server Valehir. More details will be released shortly before the server merge.


Enjoy the summer!
The NosTale Team

notes.title: Summer Event with Lola Lopears
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/cb030dc1bdf399e24b02f32be9348e5582f001d3.jpg[/img]

Ears up, adventurer! Our summer event series continues with part 2, where you’ll have to play it by ear against a wily band of bunnies in the hunt for wonderful rewards. Join the fun!

[b]Event period[/b]: 7th August (11 AM) to 28th August (11 AM CEST).

[h3]Give Lola’s Lopears a Boxing![/h3]
Look out, here comes Lucy’s evil sister: Lola Lopears! Confront her in the raid for 5 to 8 players – but keep your wits about you when her army of little bunnies comes hopping out of the burrow. Lola also plants a giant carrot in the ground which you must destroy as quickly as possible. Each member of your raid team needs Lola Lopears’ Raid Seal before you can start. If you manage to swing the battle in your favour, with a bit of luck you might find [b]Lucy Lopears’ Specialist Partner Card[/b] in the raid box. Equipped with the fire element, Lucy Lopears will be your loyal, powerful partner.

[b]What Else?[/b]
There are also lots of other missions that need your attention. In reward for your efforts, you can pick up the ‘Lopears’ title giving you 2% hit rate and 2% concentration, the cute Bunny Hairband, and a whole raft of other rewards.

The NosTale Team

notes.title: Summer Oasis Server: Magical Break
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/7f48d48b3bcb0022ec77e13307525d7bed8766ac.jpg[/img]

Are the sun’s rays beating down on your back? Does the ice cream no longer cool you down? Yet you’re still looking for more action and excitement? Then get ready for a [b]summer of adventure in NosTale[/b], as the [b]Summer Oasis[/b] will soon open its gates!

On this special server, you’ll benefit from [b]permanent boosts, special weekend events[/b], a [b]free Battle Pass[/b] and much more. At the end of the server, it will be merged into the Valehir server.
[list][*][b]Summer Oasis server starts[/b]: 7th August 2024[/*][*][b]Summer Oasis server ends[/b]: 25th September 2024[/*][/list]
[h3]The Summer Oasis[/h3]

Dive in and enjoy a paradise of action! Look forward to the following highlights:

[b]Boosts & Weekend Events[/b]
During the entire Summer Oasis, you can look forward to increased experience points, more gold, and other permanent boosts.Each weekend there are exclusive events with higher drop and enchantment chances, which will make your heroic journey even more exciting and worthwhile.

[b]Free Battle Pass[/b]
Complete missions in the free Battle Pass to earn items which will support you on your adventures and accelerate your progress.

[b]Special Achievements[/b]
For the most dedicated adventurers, the Summer Oasis offers additional challenges and achievements. These can be completed either alone or in a group, and reward you with exclusive items and titles.In addition there are server-wide challenges for the entire community. Work together to complete these to unlock even better boosts during the weekend events!

[b]Your Summer Bootcamp[/b]
Use the Summer Oasis to prepare for the new content coming later this year – the challenging hardcore mode for raids! We’ll be releasing more details at a later date... but you can already start preparing now!

[h3]Summer Oasis Server FAQ[/h3]

Here’s a short FAQ about the Summer Oasis server:

[b]What’s special about the Summer Oasis?[/b]
[list][*]The Summer Oasis is an international server with special events that will be merged into the international server Valehir after one and a half months.[/*][*]The server will offer permanent boosts, as well as two additional weekend boosts which are higher than usual, making it possible for you to progress faster and easier.[/*][*]There will be a free Battle Pass on the Summer Oasis server which rewards you with in-game items based on the missions completed. These rewards include amulets, consumables, lifestyle specialist items, costumes and more.[/*][*]On top of all that, there will be specific challenges and achievements on the Summer Oasis to reward the most loyal and motivated adventurers with exclusive items. The achievements can be individual or group-based (players being rewarded with titles and all manner of other great items), and there will even be server-wide challenges! For example, if the server manages to master a certain challenge, then all players will enjoy higher boosts during the weekend event. The more you achieve, the greater the rewards for everyone![/*][/list]
[b]What boosts will be available and when?[/b]
The following boosts will be permanently active during the Summer Oasis:
[list][*]2x EXP[/*][*]2x Gold[/*][*]2x Drops[/*][*]4x Reputation (exc. Act 4)[/*][*]2x Fairy EXP[/*][*]2x Family EXP[/*][*]2x XP for fishing, cooking and training petsIn addition there will be special weekend boost events, such as the raid box and upgrade events, which are even better than usual. There will also be weekends when more than one event is active.[/*][/list]
[b]Will there be special achievements?[/b]
Yes, the more players on the server achieve, the better you will all be rewarded! Details on the achievements and rewards will be revealed shortly before the server launches.

[b]When will the Summer Oasis server be merged with Valehir?[/b]
The Summer Oasis will be merged into Valehir on 25th September 2024.

[b]What will happen to my characters? Will I lose anything?[/b]
No, all characters on the Summer Oasis server, including their items and progress, will be transferred to Valehir. There are no restrictions as to the number of characters. Please check our previous Valehir server merge as the same rules will apply in this case: https://forum.nostale.gameforge.com/forum/thread/1056-server-merge-valehir-jotunheim/

[b]Can I select my destination server at the end like with the NosFire server?[/b]
No, all characters will be transferred to Valehir by default.

[b]Can I change my character name on the Summer Oasis server?[/b]
Yes, you can do exactly the same things you can do on all other servers.

[b]Will events still be taking place on the other servers?[/b]
Yes, the other servers will have the same weekend events as Summer Oasis, but with lower percentage increases.

Enjoy the summer!
The NosTale Team

notes.title: Community Update – Second Half of 2024
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/e3648aefa3a44482ada06d3f3d040c565b0a52ff.jpg[/img]

Welcome once again to the mid-year community update!

[h1]First Half of 2024: A Review[/h1]

Before sharing what’s coming in the second half of 2024, we would like to discuss our experience with the content launched in recent months. We know that communication is very important to you, a topic we’ve discussed extensively on platforms like Discord. Therefore, we want to expand these biannual updates with more information about our most relevant projects.

[h2]Act 9[/h2]

Shortly before this year began, [b]Act 9 Part 1 – Secrets of the Undercity[/b] arrived, introducing new quests, levels, an underground world with new maps and monsters, two challenging raids, fresh gear, and an enhanced fairy system. With each new act, our goal is to continue expanding the wonderful world of NosTale and provide a new dose of fun, exploration, and exciting battles.

However, areas, instances, and enemies are not the only things we have worked on this first half of the year. In June, we released [b]Act 9 Part 2 – Heroes of the Undercity[/b], which brought a new generation of specialist cards with innovative mechanics and a new raid boss which will test your preparation for the end-game.

[h3]Quality of Life Changes[/h3]

With the latest update, we have implemented several modifications to various aspects and systems of the game. These include adjustments to Pollutus and Giant Arma’s mechanics, and better rewards in raid boxes from Act 8 and 9 raids. We have also increased the drop rates of several items such as Mystic Power Crystals and Moritius Obsidian, as well as upping the gold limit in the NosBazaar and player inventory, among other changes.

Many quality-of-life changes have been introduced with this release. Some updates contain more noticeable changes than others, but this remains an important aspect of every addition to the game, so we appreciate you continuing to send us your suggestions and ideas via Discord.

[h2]NosFire Event Servers[/h2]

This Easter we introduced a new kind of event – the NosFire temporary event server. This event server was designed to help returning and new players quickly catch up with end-game content. Thanks to your motivation, the first edition was an amazing success, and we greatly appreciate all your positive feedback about it. We will evolve it based on your comments for a future edition, also adding some more surprises to spice things up.

[h2]International Servers[/h2]

Recently, we also merged the two international servers to ensure a balanced population across all servers, although some might have preferred different plans.

While a mega-server with all communities might seem appealing, it would likely lead to overcrowding and a worse experience. Rest assured, the other servers remain well-populated, and we will continue to monitor server numbers closely.

[h1]Second Half of 2024: What to Expect[/h1]

For the second half of this year, you will notice some familiar content, some expected changes, as well as a few surprises. We want to ensure that the content we release meets both your expectations and our own high standards, so we won’t provide specific dates, just an overview. As we approach each release date, we will share more detailed information, so stay tuned to our channels!

NosTale is more alive than ever and will continue to receive updates actively. With all that said, here’s what’s coming in 2024!

[h2]Hardcore Raids[/h2]

The main novelty for the second half of this year will be Hardcore Raids, new content designed to test the skills of the most advanced players. The current game raids will have a version with increased difficulty, which will require special conditions to access.

Additionally, this update will include a series of changes to systems closely related to raids, such as an increased family level, new family achievements, and a renewed token shop with exciting rewards.

[h2]Summer Oasis[/h2]

Speaking of servers and merges, we can already inform you that this summer, a new special server will be available to welcome adventurers and help them progress faster. It will combine elements from NosFire, such as double events during weekends and the extra boosts that you enjoyed, along with a planned merge after a set period! This ensures that fresh characters are swiftly prepared for the hardcore raids, new specialists, and end-game challenges. More information will be provided as we approach the server launch.

[h2]Rework of Act 4[/h2]

We know how eager you were for the Act 4 update, so it is especially satisfying for us to announce its arrival in 2024. There are still many details to be finalised about the definitive content, so at the moment, we cannot offer you a preview of what it will entail. What we can tell you is that our goal with this update is to revitalise the act’s content, making it relevant again for players in both PvE and PvP.

[h2]Quality of Life Improvements[/h2]

As mentioned earlier, we greatly appreciate all the suggestions you send us on Discord. They are a valuable source of information about the state of the game and which content is most important for us to update and improve. Thanks to this feedback, we have prepared a series of quality-of-life improvements focused on some of the most relevant suggestions you have conveyed to us via the platform.

[h2]Seasonal Events[/h2]

And of course, we will continue to have our regular seasonal content, including Summer, Anniversary, Halloween, and Christmas events.

As always, we appreciate all the comments you share about the community updates, and we look forward to reading your impressions on Discord, Reddit, and the forums. All feedback is welcome!

The NosTale Team

notes.title: Event: Fairy Upgrade
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/d3d098ca98f94bb939ee07f57c56727ab6e590b0.jpg[/img]

Equip your favourite fairy and give her a major boost with the Fairy Upgrade Event! During the event the [b]chance for successful upgrades will be greatly increased[/b], while the [b]risk of failure is reduced[/b]!

[b]Event period[/b]: 28th June (11 AM) to 1st July (11 AM CEST)

[h3]How Fairy Upgrades Work[/h3]
[list]
[*]The fairy upgrade allows you to give a fairy a random effect, similar to the shells on your equipment.
[*]There are three possible outcomes of an upgrade attempt: success, failure or an overcharge.
[*][b]Success[/b]: Your fairy gets a random effect.
[*][b]Failure[/b]: The materials are consumed, but your fairy doesn’t get an effect.
[*][b]Overcharge[/b]: Your fairy becomes overcharged. A [i]Golden Tool[/i] is needed to upgrade further.
[*]After upgrading a fairy, it is soulbound to your character. In addition to a Fairy Bead, you need a certain amount of Perfume to change its owner, depending on the fairy’s upgrade level.
[*]Please note: Fairies which cannot be traded without a Fairy Bead cannot be upgraded (regular fairies, event fairies).
[/list]

notes.title: Act 9.2 – Heroes of the Undercity
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/abceb897c16391a8d949b1634bb8353a66c8ad87.jpg[/img]

The wait is over – Act 9.2 is finally here! Make way for the debut of the new specialists – Stone Breaker, Fog Hunter, Fire Storm and Thunderer – who are here to show what they’re made of! Play the new update today and meet the new specialists, conquer a new raid, and explore more exciting contents!

[h2]Act 9.2 – Heroes of the Undercity[/h2]

New adventures await you in the Undercity and its surroundings! An unremarkable little robot by the name of Techron needs your help. Solve the mystery of the secret energy source and unlock the new specialists with their powerful skills! The new quest line starts on Sunny Meadows.

[h3]Four New Specialists[/h3]

[b]For Swordsmen: Stone Breaker[/b]Smash even the toughest rocks with the powerful hammer-drill this specialist wields!

[b]For Archers: Fog Hunter[/b]Surprise your enemies with sniper attacks from concealment!

[b]For Mages: Fire Storm[/b]Unleash attacks of fire and flame and leave nothing but ashes on the battlefield!

[b]For Martial Artists: Thunderer[/b]Attack your enemies with a brand-new shock cannon which can be used in melee and ranged combat.

[b]Plus[/b]: New token system for improving the new specialists’ skills

[h3]New Ultimate Giant Arma Raid[/h3]

At the start of this raid your team will be split into two zones. Once you’ve defeated all the monsters, you must face off against the Ultimate Giant Arma. This robot will come at you with machine guns, missiles and laser beams. Gear up for battle... and watch out for his repair mode!
[list][*]Up to 12 players[/*][*]Only for characters from champion level 80[/*][*]Entrance: To the Secret Hut[/*][*]Entry item: Ultimate Giant Arma Raid Seal[/*][*]Better loot: Materials for the new specialists and more[/*][*]Increased chance of higher rarity levels in raid boxes[/*][/list]
[h3]More Improvements[/h3]

We’ve added a number of additional improvements to make the game even better:
[list][*][b]More Items[/b]: Certain item drop chances have been increased for Act 8 and Act 9[/*][*][b]Raid Power[/b]: Better rewards can now be looted in Act 8 and Act 9 raids. In addition, various adjustments have been made to make the raids easier to complete.[/*][*][b]Improved[/b]: Specialist partners now require fewer identical specialist cards to be able to fuse them together.[/*][*][b]More Gold[/b]: The gold cap in your inventory has been doubled.[/*][/list]
[h2]Patch Notes[/h2]

You can find full details on the update in our exhaustive [url=https://gameforge.com/play/nostale/news/1882fab7-79c4-4e2e-b1d2-b570fc3cf272]patch notes[/url].

Have fun,
The NosTale Team

notes.title: New International Forum
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/e3648aefa3a44482ada06d3f3d040c565b0a52ff.jpg[/img]

NosTale is moving to a new forum!

In recent years, the platforms used by the community to interact with each other have been changing organically, according to the new needs of users and advancing technical possibilities and innovations. In addition, the global nature of the internet has led us to connect with people beyond our borders, making it common for almost any online community to be made up of people from different countries and languages.

These facts have led to forums, as they were conceived years ago, losing activity in favour of other more accessible or international platforms like Discord and Reddit. However, we know that forums remain an important tool with regards to informative content, so we want to update their functionality so that they continue to be relevant today.

That’s why we’ve decided to open a new forum for NosTale, focused on those aspects where forums still bring great value and in which they are hard to replace.

[h2]What to Expect from This New Forum[/h2]

To start with, the new NosTale forum will bring together seven of our communities: [b]International, Czech, French, Italian, Polish, Spanish and Turkish[/b]. This means that these communities’ old forums will be put into read-only mode and it will not be possible to register new accounts, create new threads or reply to them. This status of the old forums will last some time until the influx of users has been channelled to the new forum and some of the information stored there has been transferred to the new forum. Once this process is complete, the old forums will be closed and will no longer be accessible.

As mentioned above, the focus of the new forum will be on informative content. On the one hand, all news will continue to be published in all languages as before, and this will also be the RSS source for Discord announcements. On the other hand, we want to make the guides section a place where people regularly go to get useful information about the game and how our different platforms work.

But that’s not all. The ability to express oneself openly is fundamental on any internet platform, so while some categories that existed in the old forums will no longer be there (such as bug reports, suggestions, family search or business, which have a greater reach on Discord with other departments involved), other categories such as help, discussions, creative content and off-topic will continue to have their place, so players can continue to interact and share their opinions and passions with others.

It’s also worth giving special mention to the artistic content, such as fan art and creative writing. [b]You have the possibility to move your drawings and stories from the old forums to the new one[/b], while they are still accessible in read-only mode. We highly appreciate the content which the community has contributed to the game over all these years, and we would like at least part of its history to accompany us on this new journey. If you need help from the forum team to carry this out, don’t hesitate to contact us through the [url=https://nostale.support.gameforge.com/index.php?fld=en]support system[/url].

With all that said... the new forum is now open! You can access it via the following link: https://forum.nostale.gameforge.com/. We invite you to register and share your feedback about the current structure, any changes or improvements you would make, and most importantly, participate in the way you enjoy the most.

Enjoy your new home!
The NosTale Team

notes.title: Event: Exclusive Pet in Sealed Vessels
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/a703b4ed76a811d51298d76ff6d23dfde072978d.jpg[/img]

Mysterious Sealed Vessels are circulating around the world of NosTale. Surrounded by a magical aura, only [b]parties of experienced adventurers[/b]  should dare open them, as these otherwise unremarkable vessels contain the most wicked of creatures, banished by wise mages. 

The brave – or the foolish – who nevertheless rise to the challenge to liberate and defeat the evil creature inside one of these Sealed Vessels have a chance of being rewarded with a treasure chest. These contain fantastic items from the NosMall. With a dollop of good fortune, the monsters could even drop our exclusive pet which gives you seriously powerful buffs!

[b]Event Time:[/b] Between 17th May (11 AM CEST) and 24th May (11 AM CEST).

[h3]Here’s How[/h3]
[list][*]Pick up a Sealed Vessel from the NosMall, NosWheel or NosBazaar.[/*][*]Rally your friends/family together and steel yourselves for a tough fight.[/*][*]Open the Sealed Vessel summoning one of 20 monsters.[/*][*]The higher the monster’s level, the greater the chance of collecting a treasure chest.[/*][/list]
[h3]Things to Know[/h3]
[list][*]The Sealed Vessels can be opened on any map, with the exceptions of those detailed below.[/*][*]Sealed Vessels cannot be opened in the capitals (NosVille, Port Alveus, Sunset Cliff).[/*][*]Only 11 Sealed Vessels can be active simultaneously on the following maps: NosVille Meadows, Mine Plains, Sunny Meadows, Fernon Outpost, Western Mine (all maps), Northern Mine (all maps), Fernon Temple (all maps) and Fernon’s Hideout (all maps).[/*][/list]
In addition to the treasure chest, one of the following items may drop in the displayed amount after defeating the monster:
[list][*]1x Death Lancer Set[/*][*]2x Wings of Friendship[/*][*]1x Tarot Card Game[/*][*]5x Fairy Experience Potion[/*][*]20x Perfume[/*][*]20x Huge Recovery Potion[/*][*]10x Cylloan Spring Water[/*][*]40x Seed of Power[/*][*]10x Guardian Angel’s Blessing[/*][*]1x Special Pet Food[/*][*]1x Tame Raccoon Bird [/*][*]1x Fire Devil Set[/*][*]1x Liberator [/*][*]1x Small Ice Witch [/*][*]1x Ice Witch Costume Set [/*][*]1x Ice Witch Costume Wings[/*][*]1x Death Lancer [/*][*]1x Death Lancer Murderwings[/*][*]1x Fire Devil Costume Wings (Permanent) [/*][*]1x Mini Fire Devil[/*][/list]
[h3]New Pet Buffs[/h3]
The new pet can drag your enemies right up to you. Meanwhile, the buff it grants increases all attacks by 10%, and increases light resistance by 10.

Enjoy the monster hunt!
The NosTale Team

notes.title: Events: Imp Raid & Improved Land of Life
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/66662d46e6b00f9a86e022a5192b33146cb00ea6.jpg[/img]

Things are as hot as Hades in the [b]Imp Raid[/b], plus earn some serious champion level experience in the improved [b]Land of Life[/b]! Don’t miss out on the amazing action!


[h2]Imp Raid[/h2]

Feel the heat in NosTale as we unleash the demons! NosVille isn’t safe while they’re still at large. Are you hero enough to put a stop to their antics?

[b]Event period[/b]: 6th May (11 AM) to 3rd June (11 AM CEST)

[h3][/h3]Get a Specialist Partner

You must take on the imps Hongbi and Cheongbi in their [b]raid[/b]. The two of them summon little clones of themselves to make your life hell. Put paid to these monsters and pick up the specialist partner cards from the raid box!

In the ‘Creepy Imp’ [b]quest[/b] you need to send the little devils packing – but that’s easier said than done!

Tip: Regular monsters will drop the handy ‘Cure’ potion during this event.

[h3]Raid Box[/h3]

The Hongbi & Cheongbi raid box may contain the [b]Evil Twin[/b] title, as well as eight different gemstones of completion:
[list]
[*]Blue Founder Hat (7 Days)
[*]Ayam (7 Days)
[*]Summer Hanbok (7 Days)
[*]Rose Hanbok (7 Days)
[*]Cellon (Level 8)
[*]Ancelloan’s Blessing
[*]Angel’s Feather
[*]Mysterious Hair Dye
[*]Small Ruby of Completion
[*]Small Sapphire of Completion
[*]Small Obsidian of Completion
[*]Small Topaz of Completion
[*]Ruby of Completion
[*]Sapphire of Completion
[*]Obsidian of Completion
[*]Topaz of Completion
[*]Hongbi’s Specialist Partner Card
[*]Cheongbi’s Specialist Partner Card
[*]Evil Twin
[/list]
[h2]Land of Life Improvements[/h2]
The Land of Life now has even more to offer! Continue reading to learn about what we’ve improved.

[b]New[/b]
[list]
[*]The Land of Life is [b]now divided into three zones[/b]: one for champion level [b]30–64[/b], one for champion level [b]60–82[/b], and a new zone for champion level [b]80–90[/b]. You need to meet the respective minimum level requirement in order to enter these zones.
[/list][list]
[*]The new zone can be entered from [b]Undercity[/b], the other two still from Dragonveil.
[/list][list]
[*]We’ve also made numerous small improvements to all zones of the Land of Life. Learn more about them in the server maintenance patch notes.
[/list]
[b]How It Works[/b]
The Land of Life is the ideal place to increase your champion level. Kill monsters and bosses together with your family members to earn EXP and powerful items.

The Dragon Lord Asgobas will appear there in regular intervals. It is not possible to enter the Land of Life while he is present, but all players who entered before his appearance [b]earn 100% more experience[/b].

The Land of Life is open according to the following pattern:
[list]
[*]midnight–1:00 AM: open
[*]1:00 AM–2:00 AM: closed (Asgobas appears and all EXP earned in this period is doubled)
[*]2:00 AM–3:00 AM: Land of Life is open again
[*]... and so on
[/list]

notes.title: Event: Fairy Upgrade
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/d3d098ca98f94bb939ee07f57c56727ab6e590b0.jpg[/img]

Equip your favourite fairy and give her a major boost with the Fairy Upgrade Event! During the event the [b]chance for successful upgrades will be greatly increased[/b], while the [b]risk of failure is reduced[/b]!

[b]Event period[/b]: 22nd March (11 AM) to 25th March (11 AM CET)

[h3]How Fairy Upgrades Work[/h3]
[list]
[*]The fairy upgrade allows you to give a fairy a random effect, similar to the shells on your equipment.
[*]There are three possible outcomes of an upgrade attempt: success, failure or an overcharge.
[*][b]Success[/b]: Your fairy gets a random effect.
[*][b]Failure[/b]: The materials are consumed, but your fairy doesn’t get an effect.
[*][b]Overcharge[/b]: Your fairy becomes overcharged. A [i]Golden Tool[/i] is needed to upgrade further.
[*]After upgrading a fairy, it is soulbound to your character. In addition to a Fairy Bead, you need a certain amount of Perfume to change its owner, depending on the fairy’s upgrade level.
[*]Please note: Fairies which cannot be traded without a Fairy Bead cannot be upgraded (regular fairies, event fairies).
[/list]

notes.title: NosFire Event Server FAQ
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/ce64626128920a7864c52384d78a6b206beeff98.jpg[/img]

Find out everything you need to know about the [b]NosFire event server[/b] here!

[b]How long will NosFire be online before registered characters can be transferred?[/b]
[list]
[*]NosFire will be online for 9 weeks, between 25th March and 28th May 2024.
[/list]
[b]What is special about NosFire?[/b]
[list]
[*]All characters start at level 80/job level 20, with quest progress starting in Act 4.
[*]When you select a class, you automatically reach job level 80.
[*]Once you’ve selected a class, various items will be added to your inventory. These include equipment sets 5+7, resistances and fairies all bound to your character, as well as additional specialist cards 50+5.
[*]You can transfer a character to a chosen destination server at the end of the event server.
[*]Permanent boost events and additional special weekend boosts which are higher than normal will be active on the NosFire event server. These allow you to progress faster and easier.
[*]There will be copies of the most popular levelling maps on the same map.
[*]Certain content such as Act 8 raids will be simplified, and the entry level for certain raids will be adjusted.
[*]You can immediately craft low-level raid seals without completing Time-Spaces.
[*]The Arena of Talents will be disabled on NosFire.
[*]You cannot craft or purchase warehouses from NPCs.
[*]The entry level for certain Time-Spaces will be adjusted.
[*]You cannot earn gold from the SP 1+2 Martial Artist quest.
[*]The entry level for Instant Combats and Rainbow Battles has been changed to level 85.
[*]The sales value of starting equipment has been reduced to a minimum.
[*]The Land of Death and Land of Life will be available to enter as usual. Instant Combats will be available on all channels.
[/list]
[b]How can I transfer my character?[/b]
[list]
[*]Characters are not transferred automatically. Only one character can be transferred per account. This requires an item available as a higher Battle Pass reward which allows you to select your target server. Characters which have not been registered for the transfer will not be transferred.
[/list]
[b]How can I choose my destination server?[/b]
[list]
[*]There will be five different items, each representing a different destination server, which allow you to choose your server. The items cannot be deleted and you have time until the NosFire event server closes to choose your destination server.
[/list]
[b]Where can I see which server I have selected?[/b]
[list]
[*]You can see your chosen server in the Consumables tab (where your NosBazaar medals and expansions are shown).
[/list]
[b]Are any server merges planned soon?[/b]
[list]
[*]Yes, a short while after the end of the NosFire event server, the INT-Valehir and INT-Jotunheim servers are going to be merged (currently slated for June 2024). We will inform you in due course if there are any changes to the plan, and announce the specific date.
[/list]
[b]Can I transfer my items with my character?[/b]
[list]
[*]All items that you character currently has equipped (in the P window) will be automatically transferred. In the Battle Pass you can unlock a warehouse which allows you to transfer up to 10 additional items. In addition costumes, specialist card inventories, and active mall items such as Inventory Expansions or NosMerchant Medals will be automatically transferred with your character. Everything else will not be transferred.
[/list]
[b]Will there be a Battle Pass?[/b]
[list]
[*]Yes, there will be a [b]free Battle Pass[/b] for the NosFire server. This Battle Pass will differ to earlier seasons, giving you a chance to quickly catch up and make progress easier.
[*]You can unlock the following items amongst others in the Battle Pass: Caligor’s Spirit, upgrade and crafting materials, completion gemstones, transfer items and the item transfer warehouse.
[/list]
[b]Are there any rules for transferring?[/b]
Certainly! The following rules apply:
[list]
[*]Until the end of the NosFire event server on 28th May 2024 you must have chosen a destination server, otherwise you character cannot be transferred. We will send several private messages to your character to remind you of the transfer in good time.
[*]All items that you character currently has equipped (in the P window) will be automatically transferred. In the Battle Pass you can unlock a warehouse which allows you to transfer up to 10 additional items. In addition costumes, specialist card inventories, and active mall items such as Inventory Expansions or NosMerchant Medals will be automatically transferred with your character. Everything else will not be transferred.
[*]Families will not be transferred and the contents of family warehouses will be deleted.
[*]Gold will not be transferred (including the bank).
[*]Bazaar auctions will disappear and not be refunded.
[*]The Miniland will be transferred (NosMates and decorations) with exception of the Partner’s Backpack.
[*]Your character’s progress including quests, reputation, tattoos, skills, lifestyle class etc. will also be transferred.
[*]If the name of your character is already taken on the destination server, you will have to change your character’s name the next time you log in after transferring.
[*]If all your character slots on the target server are full, your character will be deactivated and you can activate them in the standard manner via the website.
[*]Uncollected NosMall items purchased via the website can be collected on the destination server.
[*]Friends list, blacklist and marriage will not be transferred.
[*]All parcels (post) will be deleted during the transfer.
[/list]
[b]What boosts will be available and when?[/b]
[list]
[*]The following boosts will be permanently active on the NosFire server:
[*]2x EXP
[*]4x Reputation (exc. Act 4)
[*]2x XP for fishing, cooking and training pets
[*]2x Fairy XP
[*]2x Gold
[*]2x Drops
[*]4x Family XP
[*]In addition there will be special weekend boost events, such as the raid box event and upgrade events, bringing even better benefits than usual. Some weekends may even feature multiple events.
[/list]
[b]Will there also be events on the regular servers?[/b]
[list]
[*]Yes, the regular servers will have the same weekend events as the NosFire server, albeit with lower boosts.
[/list]
[b]Will there be an Easter event on all servers?[/b]
[list]
[*]Yes, the Easter Event will be active on all servers (starting 25th March 2024).
[/list]
[b]Will there be special server first challenges?[/b]
[list]
[*]No, there are no server first challenges planned for this event server.
[/list]
[b]Can I change the name of my character on the NosFire event server?[/b]
[list]
[*]Unfortunately this isn’t possible for technical reasons. Please choose your character name carefully when creating your character, as you will not be able to change it later. Please note: As on all our other servers, using a name which violates our guidelines may lead to your account being restricted.
[/list]
[b]Can I create characters on both event servers with the same account and transfer them both to regular servers at the end?[/b]
[list]
[*]No, unfortunately no. The character transfer can only be received as a Battle Pass reward, and is only available for one character per account.
[/list]
[b]Info & Patch notes[/b]
More information and detailed patch notes will be published shortly.

notes.content:

Heroes of NosTale, get ready as the Land of Life prepares to offer twice the EXP time! Between [b]23rd February (midnight) to 26th February (11:59 PM CET)[/b] the time you can spend in the Land of Life is doubled (4 hours instead of 2 hours)!

[h3]Land of Life[/h3]
The Land of Life is the ideal place to increase your champion level. Kill monsters and bosses together with your family members to earn EXP and powerful items. 

The Dragon Lord Asgobas will appear there in regular intervals. It is not possible to enter the Land of Life while he is present, but all players who entered before his appearance [b]earn 100% more experience[/b].

The Land of Life is divided into two zones: one for champion level 30–59 and one for champion level 60–90. You need to meet the respective minimum level requirement in order to enter these zones.

The Land of Life is open according to the following pattern:
[list][*]midnight–1:00 AM: open[/*][*]1:00 AM–2:00 AM: closed (Asgobas appears and all EXP earned in this period is doubled)[/*][*]2:00 AM–3:00 AM: Land of Life is open again[/*][*]... and so on[/*][/list]
[h3]Event Info[/h3]
You can spend [b]up to 4 hours[/b] per day in the Land of Life during the event. You’ll also receive about 20 minutes more to plan your entries around Asgobas’ appearance. 

Have fun!
The NosTale Team

notes.title: Event: Battle Pass with Updates
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/4c157cdbed30bfa05d165973f3a94bf8338da317.jpg[/img]

A [b]new Battle Pass Season[/b] is about to kick off in NosTale! Enjoy many benefits and unlock extra rewards with the Premium Battle Pass! The current Battle Pass season runs from [b]21st February (midnight) to 19th March 2024 (midnight, CET)[/b], this time bringing some new changes (see below).


[h3]This Is the NosTale Battle Pass[/h3]
With NosTale’s Battle Pass, you complete weekly and seasonal challenges that earn you Battle Points. You can then collect rewards for the points you’ve earned. And everyone can benefit: Battle Pass activities and rewards are free for all players!

All rewards can be collected until [b]25/03/2024 at 09:00 (CET)[/b]. 

[b]Rewards[/b] 
You can earn the following rewards:

[list]
[*]New exclusive pet: Tame Slime Lizard Baby 
[*]Pollutus Core
[*]Giant Arma’s Power Source
[*]Champion Blessing Amulet
[*]Akashic Record
[*]... and many more prizes!
[/list]
[b]Tame Slime Lizard Baby effects[/b] 
[list]
[*]Companion buff: Increases all attacks by 10%. Increases maximum HP by 5%.
[*]When attacked, it has a 5% chance to apply the Groovy Beach Vibes buff to allies within 5 spaces.
[*]55% chance to reduce all incoming attack damage by 80%.
[*]Max. HP (Level 99): 36,890
[*]Resistances: 60% fire, 80% water, 70% light, 70% shadow
[/list]

[h3]Premium Battle Pass[/h3]
If you decide to purchase the Premium Battle Pass, you can look forward to more and higher-value rewards. This feature is perfect for you if you want to get the most from the Battle Pass activities!

The Premium Battle Pass for the current season costs 250 NosDollars.

[b]Premium Rewards[/b]
You can earn the following premium rewards:

[list]
[*]New exclusive title: [Player Name] Is in Love
[*]Dragon Card Protection Scroll (Premium)
[*]Golden Equipment Protection Scroll
[*]Pet Trainer Bead
[*]Ticket of the Elemental Journey Through Time
[*]... and many more prizes!
[/list]
[b]‘Is in Love’ title buff[/b]
When attacking, there is a 10% chance of summoning a shadow clone to carry out an additional attack.


[h3]Additional Changes[/h3]
We’ve made the following changes for this season:

[list]
[*]The Premium Battle Pass is tradeable.
[*]There are no missions requiring a daily login. You now always have multiple days to complete missions.
[*]Premium Battle Pass Coins cannot be used.
[*]The season will last for 4 weeks. The rewards you unlock can still be collected for x  days after the end.
[/list]

notes.title: Event: Magical Valentine’s Day
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/2139f990483ae9eb7a82f40cedbbc59474a0f9a8.jpg[/img]

We’re sure there’s someone special in NosVille you’ve always wanted to confess your love to. Valentine’s Day is the perfect time to finally take the plunge – romantic events and fantastic rewards await! Read on to find out everything you need to know!

[h1]Valentine’s Day in NosTale[/h1]

[b]From 13th February (11 AM) to 28th February (9 AM CET)[/b], there are lots of loveydovey events and promotions waiting for you in NosTale:

[h3]Event: Amora Needs Cupid’s Arrows[/h3]
[list]
[*]Help Amora spread the love in NosVille. To do that she’ll need some arrows.
[*]Talk to Amora once you reach at least level 50. She’ll explain what she needs to make them. Collect the components and bring them to her!
[*]You’ll get the Wedding Costume Specialist Card (one per character) as a thank you.
[/list]
[h3]Event: Show Your Feelings[/h3]
[list]
[*]Hunt monsters and collect Chocolate, Gift Boxes, and Ribbons.
[*]Exchange them for a Valentine’s Day Gift from Eva Energy. Then you’ll have the chance to share your love!
[*]If your friend accepts your gift, you’ll get a Valentine’s Day Blessing that grants you extra energy and strength. This temporarily increases your attack and defence power.
[*]1–3 Gifts: Small Valentine’s Day Blessing
[*]4–9 Gifts: Valentine’s Day Blessing
[*]10+ Gifts: Big Valentine’s Day Blessing
[*]Now remember, not everyone will want to accept your gifts – but stay strong!
[*]Don’t be shy, share your love! You can give someone a present up to 3 times each day.
[/list]
[h3]Event: Amora’s Missing Wings[/h3]
Love can be a double-edged sword. The tragic story of Wingless Amora and her true love will pull at your heartstrings. But you’ll soon feel all warm and cuddly again once you get your new ranged partner as a quest reward: Wingless Amora (one per character).

[h3]Discount Sale: Weddings at Bargain Prices[/h3]
Let your long-awaited dreams of the big day come true and pick up a Wedding Box at a 20% discount. Just remember not to take marriage lightly – divorce can be a painful experience. To remind you of this, the Separation Letter now costs 20% more. This offer applies during the Valentine’s Event. Don’t forget – you can also get Amora’s Specialist Partner Card in the shop.


Have fun!
The NosTale Team

notes.title: Community Update – First Half of 2024
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/e3648aefa3a44482ada06d3f3d040c565b0a52ff.jpg[/img]

Dear NosPlayers,

Welcome to our latest Community Update!

As we have been doing for several years, we are going to share with you our plans for the game for the first half of 2024. Please note that the individual points are not sorted according to their planned release date and, while our goal is to bring you all of these updates by June at the latest, they may have to be postponed to a later date if any unforeseen problems arise. However, we are optimistic about our current schedule and hope that the next six months will be as exciting as they appear.

[h3]Act 9, Part 2[/h3]
We already gave you a little preview of this in the Act 9 livestream; the Undercity will see its content expanded in 2024, with a second part bringing some important additions, such as a new raid boss, new specialist cards for all classes, plus an update to the Land of Life which will provide a new space for levelling up to champion level 90.

[h3]Server Merges[/h3]
Merging servers is a topic that some of you broach with us quite regularly, and we understand your concerns on this matter, so we will be monitoring server activity and data over the coming months to decide on how to approach this, and which servers should be involved.

[h3]Seasonal Events[/h3]
The content we have mentioned will come in addition to our seasonal events, which will provide you with playable content throughout the year on a regular basis. We have already started with the Lunar New Year Event, which will be followed by events for Valentine’s Day and Easter.

[h3]Quality of Life Improvements[/h3]
We still pay close attention to the suggestions you send us via Discord, with all the feedback on the current balance between the various specialist cards. We understand that in addition to great content, even the little details help to make the game even better, so we already have in mind some updates of this kind which we plan to release over the coming months.

[h3]New Community Forum[/h3]
Although Discord is currently the most important hub of activity for the community, the forums still play an important role as a place for looking up information about the game: news, guides, discussions, help, among other things. For this reason, we are going to have a new forum in NosTale for the International, Czech, French, Italian, Polish, Spanish, and Turkish communities, which we will focus on as an information resource with updated guides and all relevant news.

We’d love to hear your thoughts on what’s to come, and we invite you to share your first impressions with us on our [url=https://discord.gg/nostaleofficial]Discord server[/url] or our [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/nostale/]subreddit[/url]!

The NosTale Team

notes.title: Act 9 – Secrets of the Undercity
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/b7bad622a11205360c4675d3e97709f8883ff793.jpg[/img]

The time has come – a new adventure has begun! In [b]Act 9 – Secrets of the Undercity[/b], NosTale’s heroes will venture deep into the underground world of a mysterious race of people. Look forward to a host of new content, including quests, maps, raids, Time-Spaces, equipment, new opponents, NPCs, an improved fairy system and much more!


[h3]The Story[/h3]
The Mine Plains near NosVille have suddenly come under attack by a mysterious army. According to reports, the frog-like Mullans have unexpectedly emerged from the depths of the earth. The guards are barely managing to keep the army at bay, and the threat is far from over... 

Now it is up to you! Will you venture into the menacing caverns to uncover the secrets of this subterranean people? Unravel the mysteries, complete more than 100 newly added quests and defeat new enemies!


[h3]Two New Raids[/h3]
Put your skills to the test in the new raids, defeating menacing monsters to loot powerful equipment!

[b]Giant Arma Raid[/b]
[list]
[*]For up to 12 players
[*]Requires champion level 80+
[*]Location: Secret Lab
[*]Entry: Requires Giant Arma’s Raid Seal
[/list]
[b]Pollutus Raid[/b]
[list]
[*]For up to 8 players
[*]Requires champion level 80+
[*]Location: Polluted Area 2
[*]Entry: Requires Moss Giant Pollutus’ Raid Seal
[/list]
[h3]New Equipment[/h3]
Having the right gear can make all the difference between victory and defeat. In Act 9 you can finally get your hands on some shiny new equipment, with a new set of weapons and armour available for every class! You can also loot other items such as helmets, boots, gloves and various accessories.


[h3]Improved Fairy System[/h3]
Your fairies get a sizeable boost in this update, allowing you to upgrade them from level 0 to 9! Each upgrade gives them an additional random effect (Level C to S). Plus you can use fairy betting (random) to level up or change existing effects.


[h3]Patch Notes[/h3]
That’s not all that Act 9 has to offer. You can find full details on the update in our exhaustive [url=https://board.en.nostale.gameforge.com/index.php?thread/12698-game-update-maintenance-11-12-2023/]patch notes .[/url]


Enjoy the new content!
The NosTale Team

notes.title: Fangtastic Events in NosTale!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/5b925cb8a05fafb960c716ea3c840bffbd68eb6e.jpg[/img]

Get ready: [b]from 25th October until 8th November[/b], NosVille and Port Alveus will be decked out in eerie Halloween decorations and the mad Professor Macavity, Foxy and Jack O’Lantern will be causing all sorts of creepy mayhem in NosTale! An [b]additional quest[/b], a [b]Halloween costume[/b] and a [b]title with powerful effects[/b] are also waiting for you!

[h1]Event Raids[/h1]

[h2]Jack O’Lantern and His Minions[/h2]

Defeat the evil pumpkin Jack O’Lantern in the raid! He’s supported by his Pumpkin Bushi and Pumpkin Bomb minions. In reward for victory, you can claim a Halloween raid box.
Amongst others you can pick up a Glowing Pumpkin Hat and creepy Tarot Cards from the raid box in this event.

[h2]Foxy and Her Brood[/h2]

Challenge Foxy and her sneaky brood in the raid! Use Foxy’s Raid Seal to confront her. If you’re successful, you’ll earn her Wonder Chest in reward. With a little luck it might contain Foxy’s Specialist Partner Card!
Foxy is a raid boss with super skills, as well as being a powerful partner. Tame her and she’ll be your loyal companion forever!

The raid seals can be picked up in daily quests. Plus you can earn more rewards by collecting flasks.

[h2]Mad Professor Macavity[/h2]

The mad genius feline is back! Rally seven players around you and start the raid. Two of the eight players will be transformed into Professor Macavity and the Test Subject. Let the hunt begin!
[b]Full details on the raid:[/b]
[list][*]Mad Professor Macavity’s Raid Seal drops in Foxy and Jack O’Lantern’s raids.[/*][*]The raid can only be attempted 5 times per day. There are however reset tickets.[/*][*]Exactly 8 players are needed to start the raid.[/*][*]Players who want to play must bring a pet.[/*][*]Professor Macavity can drag the Test Subject to him. Both need to work together to capture enemies.[/*][*]Only the hunted players can open boxes during the raid and receive handy items for the chase.[/*][*]Hunters can freeze opponents for a short time. [/*][*]Before hunted players can leave the raid, they must find a key in one of the boxes.[/*][*]The hunters must prevent the hunted from leaving the raid. For each player caught, the hunters earn a raid box. Caught players leave the raid without a box.[/*][*]If a hunted player leaves the raid successfully, they earn a raid box.[/*][*]White Witch Laurena’s Wand appears if the hunted player with the wand is caught.[/*][/list]
[h2]Reward: Titles with Powerful Effects[/h2]

In reward for each of the three Halloween raids there is one of these titles in the raid box:
[list][*]Test Subject: Increases resistance to Fatal Bleeding and other Bleeding by 1%.[/*][*]Sly Dog: Increases max. MP by 300.[/*][*]Horror: Deals greater damage to low-level undead monsters by 3%.[/*][/list]
[h1]Daily Quests[/h1]

[h2]The Cursed 13[/h2]

Talk to Mary in NosVille to start the quest and earn yourself a title by successfully completing all three Halloween raids 13 times! The ‘Monstrous’ title gives you a 2% chance of triggering Horror when you attack.

[h2]Daily Quests from NosVille NPCs[/h2]

Talk to Eric, Eva Energy, Malcolm Mix and Teoman Topp and pick up handy items in the Trick or Treat Quests! For example, you can get Yellow and Black Pumpkin Sweets, the Halloween Blessing, a Glowing Pumpkin Hat or a Halloween Costume Scroll. Playing the quests will also get you Bags of Sweets which can be exchanged for Jack O’Lantern’s raid seal.
[list][*]Defeating monsters causes them to drop goodies like Yellow and Black Pumpkin Sweets. You can either gobble them down, or exchange them for a Halloween Costume Scroll or a raid seal for Jack O’Lantern.[/*][*]Don your Glowing Pumpkin Hat! You’ll be sure to set a new trend in the village! You can get the deadly smart headgear from the Halloween Horror Box or the raid box.[/*][*]Halloween Costume Scroll: Transform into 10 different creepy critters which you know from the game. The costume gives you 4x attack power and 2x defence power.[/*][/list]
[h1]NosMall Offers[/h1]

Pick your favourite monstrous costume and give enemies a good scare: in a few days, our Halloween offers will be available in the NosMall. The costumes grant you positive effects that are even more powerful in the set. Check back regularly – you can get a first look in the video!

[b]Costume effects:[/b]
[list][*]With a 25% probability, incoming light attack damage is reduced by 15%.[/*][*]Increases all attacks by 7%[/*][*]Movement speed +1[/*][/list]
[b]Headgear effects:[/b]
[list][*]With a 25% probability, incoming shadow attack damage is reduced by 15%.[/*][*]Increases all attacks by 5%[/*][/list]
[b]Set effects:[/b]
[list][*]Movement speed +1[/*][*]Increases champion XP by 55%[/*][*]2% probability of triggering ‘Slight Horror’ on the opponent when attacking[/*][/list]
Wishing you tons of spooky fun,
The NosTale Team
