notes.title: Game Rules Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/e3648aefa3a44482ada06d3f3d040c565b0a52ff.jpg[/img]

Dear players,

On 1st November, [b]game rules will be updated[/b]. Despite the adjustments are not many, it's worth to read them to keep them fresh and to be aware of a few new procedures that will start to apply on that date. You can read the new rules following the links below:
[list][*][url=https://board.en.nostale.gameforge.com/index.php?thread/12524-update-to-the-game-rules/&postID=126591#post126591]English[/url][/*][*][url=https://forum.de.nostale.gameforge.com/forum/thread/14722-updates-zu-den-spielregeln/?postID=184360#post184360]German[/url][/*][*][url=https://board.fr.nostale.gameforge.com/index.php?thread/60117-nouveau-r%C3%A8glement-du-jeu-01-11-2023/&postID=1024662#post1024662]French[/url][/*][*][url=https://board.en.nostale.gameforge.com/index.php?thread/12525-actualizaci%C3%B3n-de-las-normas-del-juego/&postID=126593#post126593]Spanish[/url][/*][*][url=https://board.it.nostale.gameforge.com/index.php?thread/104723-modifiche-al-regolamento-di-gioco/&postID=853480#post853480]Italian[/url][/*][*][url=https://board.en.nostale.gameforge.com/index.php?thread/12522-zasady-gry-od-1-11-2023/&postID=126588#post126588]Polish[/url][/*][*][url=https://board.en.nostale.gameforge.com/index.php?thread/12526-nov%C3%A1-pravidla-hry/&postID=126596#post126596]Czech[/url][/*][*][url=https://board.en.nostale.gameforge.com/index.php?thread/12527-oyun-kurallarinda-g%C3%BCncelleme/&postID=126598#post126598]Turkish[/url][/*][/list]
[b]PLEASE NOTE[/b]: After 1st November, [b]quests will no longer be removed at the player's will[/b], only for bugs or issues. The only exception to this will be those Valhalla quests that were not updated with the last Quality of Life adjustments, which can be deleted or instead, the team can provide you the necessary items until you reach the current requirement for the quest - you will need to provide a screenshot to the team showing the active quest so they can verify it's the outdated version.

The NosTale Team

Put on your party hats and light the candles: NosTale celebrates its [b]16th birthday[/b]! From [b]11th October at 11:00 until 25th October at 9:00 AM CEST[/b], we have a whole range of exciting events and rewards lined up for you to celebrate this special anniversary.

[h3]Great Collectors’ Event[/h3]

All throughout the world of NosTale you can find certain letters. Collect them all and pick up your rewards!

[b]How it Works:[/b]
Defeat various monsters to collect the following event letters ‘N’, ‘O’, ‘S’, ‘16’, ‘Y’, ‘E’, ‘A’, ‘R’. These letters can be exchanged for the following:
[list][*]A medal with beneficial effects (once per account)[list][*]Grants a buff for 15 days that increases the [b]EXP[/b] (for characters, pets and partners), as well as your [b]attack[/b] and [b]defence[/b] by [b]10%[/b].[/*][/list][/*][*]Basic specialist points[/*][*]A buff that temporarily increases HP and MP[/*][*]The letters can also be used as recovery items: they regenerate HP, MP and SP.[/*][/list]
[h3]Daily Birthday Calendar[/h3]

Don’t forget to log in every day because we’ve prepared a birthday calendar for you. This calendar has great rewards in store for you, including various exclusive items and more. You can find more details about the calendar in the [url=https://gameforge.com/play/nostale/news/c2e63b17-1157-4dc0-a946-8ede083621b2]shop news[/url], so keep your eyes peeled!

[h3]Strong Experience Boost[/h3]

From [b]13th October to 16th October[/b], the experience points received are additionally increased by +100%! Make the most of the EXP boost and level up your characters!

We hope you’ll enjoy the events!
The NosTale Team

The price for the auctioned items will drop continuously over the 30 minutes, but each item only has limited stock. So consider well whether to grab the items straight away, or wait a bit for the price to fall – are you an early bird or do you trust your nerves of steel?

notes.title: Gear Up with the Battle Pass!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/b9405847c675ee5c47b7a443363371b8526efc5f.jpg[/img]

Enjoy all the benefits of our brand-new Battle Pass on the new international NosTale server Jotunheim! Find out all the details about your favourite game’s newest feature in this post.

[h3]What Is the Battle Pass?[/h3]

The NosTale Battle Pass gives you lots of daily, weekly, and seasonal challenges to master, and you’ll earn Battle Points by completing them. The points you earn can then be exchanged for some amazing items. And everyone can benefit: Battle Pass activities and rewards are free for all players!

Each Battle Pass season lasts for about 6 weeks (but this isn’t a hard and fast rule). But even if you miss a few missions from the current season, you’ll still have the chance to earn enough Battle Points for the final reward from the remaining activities. 

[b]Rewards:[/b] Battle Pass rewards include a wide variety of cool items, including the NosMerchant Medal (7 Days), Equipment Protection Scroll, a new exclusive title, 20x Perfume and more!

[h3]Don’t Miss Out on Premium Rewards![/h3]

If you decide to purchase the Premium Battle Pass, you can look forward to more and higher-value rewards. This feature is perfect for those players who want to get the most from the Battle Pass activities!

For just 250 NosDollars, you can pick up the Premium Battle Pass which is valid for one season.For those who don’t have much time on their hands, there’s also the Premium Battle Pass Coin in the NosMall, which you can use to skip ahead and earn yourself 50 Battle Points. The coin is available from season week 3.

[b]Rewards:[/b] Among the premium-level rewards, you can find such goodies as the NosMerchant Medal (30 Days), 2x Golden Equipment Protection Scroll, 80x Perfume, the exclusive Tamed Jellyfish pet and many more high-quality prizes!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/5cea85507007a121f9c78a9f152d71be8b392e93.jpg[/img]

Ears up, adventurer! Our summer event series continues with part 2, where you’ll have to play it by ear against a wily band of bunnies in the hunt for wonderful rewards. Join the fun!

[b]Event period:[/b] From 9th August (11 AM) to 30th August (11 AM CEST)

[h3]Give Lola’s Lopears a Boxing![/h3]
Look out, here comes Lucy’s evil sister: Lola Lopears! Confront her in the raid for 5 to 8 players – but keep your wits about you when her army of little bunnies comes hopping out of the burrow. Lola also plants a giant carrot in the ground which you must destroy as quickly as possible. Each member of your raid team needs Lola Lopears’ Raid Seal before you can start. If you manage to swing the battle in your favour, with a bit of luck you might find [b]Lucy Lopears’ Specialist Partner Card[/b] in the raid box. Equipped with the fire element, Lucy Lopears will be your loyal, powerful partner.

[b]What Else?[/b]
There are also lots of other missions that need your attention. In reward for your efforts, you can pick up the ‘Lopears’ title giving you 2% hit rate and 2% concentration, the cute Bunny Hairband, and a whole raft of other rewards.

notes.title: New International Server and Battle Pass – Get Ready for Summer in NosTale!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/6b06d3d1a8a7ef40c4a4ece8a2cf0614f9a17356.jpg[/img]

Dear player,

We hope you’re ready for a new place to run around in and even more action: NosTale will have a new international server!

The launch of the server also marks the start of the Battle Pass season. For six weeks, you will receive special rewards for completing tasks and earning Battle Points – and even more with the Premium Battle Pass!

The new international server won’t have any language region restrictions. That means you can make an exciting new start, and experience everything in your own language, thanks to the multi-language client.

In case you haven’t heard about our multi-language client or the Battle Pass yet, here are some FAQs that will explain everything you need to know:


[h2]International Server and Battle Pass FAQ[/h2]

[h3]What language will the new server support?[/h3]

Everyone playing on the international server will have the ability to play in their own language. Nevertheless, we’ll be keeping an eye on things, and may choose to establish a chat language at a later date.

[h3]What language will ticket support be in?[/h3]

The international server's ticket support will be available in the same languages as on the EU-Dragonveil server.

[h3]Where can I go to discuss server-related things?[/h3]

We’ll have separate channels for the new server on our Discord. And, if there’s demand for it, we’ll also consider opening an extra category on the forum.

[h3]Are you planning anything special for the server launch?[/h3]

Yes, the Battle Pass mentioned above will only be available on this server. The new pet and title inside the Battle Pass are therefore only available on the new server.

[h3]Do I have to buy the Premium Battle Pass to get Battle Pass rewards?[/h3]

The Battle Pass also includes free rewards, but with the Premium Battle Pass you will, of course, receive more and more valuable rewards.

[h3]I’m still not sure. Can I also buy the Premium Battle Pass later?[/h3]

Of course. You will retroactively receive all rewards that you have unlocked with your Battle Points.

[h3]Do I have to complete every single task to get the main prize?[/h3]

No, your Battle Points should be enough even if skip a mission or two.

[h3]But my Battle Points are not enough! What now?[/h3]

If you don’t have enough time or some missions are too difficult, you can buy the Premium Battle Pass Coin using NosDollars to increase your Battle Points. The coin will be available three weeks after the beginning of the season.

[h3]What if the Battle Pass season ends but I don’t have time to collect my rewards?[/h3]

Don’t worry! After the end of the season, you’ll have another two weeks to collect your rewards.

notes.title: Community Update – Second half of 2023
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/e3648aefa3a44482ada06d3f3d040c565b0a52ff.jpg[/img]

Greetings, NosPlayers!

Summer has arrived and, as every year around this time, we’d like to share with you a new edition of the community update!

During this first half of the year, we have implemented several quality-of-life adjustments, balance adjustments for some specialist cards, merged Cylloan with the international servers (finally!), revived the NosTale subreddit (r/nostale 😉) and launched the Pet Trainer SP, which is undoubtedly the biggest update so far in 2023. However, our roadmap doesn’t end here, and there are still big things coming up until 2024. Want to know more? Then read on!

In addition to the above, one of the more subtle but useful changes we’ve made is the Discord feedback process, which helps us to find out what you as a community really want from the game and get that feedback to the company more quickly. This has allowed us to work on more and better quality-of-life adjustments that we have planned for the coming months.

But these quality-of-life tweaks are not the only ones! Another of your most frequent requests is for [b]balance adjustments[/b] to the specialist cards. Unfortunately, we cannot confirm which SPs will be adjusted next, as some SPs will see more significant changes than others, and choosing which ones to go with first will depend on other content we are releasing at the same time. However, we are confident that the next round of balance changes will meet your expectations.

And those tweaks aren’t the only thing we’re bringing back – the [b]Battle Pass[/b] is also making a return! In the coming weeks, we will be kicking off a new season, which will be the start of a very busy end of 2023! We also have more Battle Passes planned for the rest of the year, which should cover most of the period from July to December, giving you useful rewards and exclusive items.
One of these Battle Passes will be launched together with a [b]new international server[/b] at the end of the summer. This will be a great incentive for those players who want to make a strong start on this new server, in addition to the special events we will be organising to reward the most daring adventurers.

As we have done in the first half of the year, we will continue to [b]improve the rewards of the seasonal events[/b] to meet the current needs of our players.. Speaking of events, we would like to highlight the [b]Anniversary event[/b] that will take place in October. It will be the biggest event of the year and will be accompanied by a new community contest – after all, how could we not go all out in celebrating NosTale’s 16th birthday!

And what better way to close out this community update than with [b]new content![/b] The fairy system has been intact for a couple of years now, and we’ve had several suggestions for changes to reignite your interest in it, so we thought it was time to show our little fairies some love with an update we’re sure you’ll love. Stay tuned for more updates!

Wow… with everything we’ve just told you, it feels like Christmas has come early! Speaking of which, if you’re on your best behaviour, Santa Claus might bring you a huge present this year...

See you next time!
The NosTale Team

notes.title: Game Update: Become an Expert Pet Trainer!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/b0738846590b28dcb7cf7ae361e01073916bd40d.jpg[/img]

Get ready for the [b]new update on 23rd May 2023[/b]! Train your pets and become the best Pet Trainer in all of NosVille! Collect pets in your Pet Book, evolve them and receive unique rewards! Get started right away and visit [b]Pet Trainer Lucy in NosVille[/b]. Her Pet Trainer quest line will guide you through the first steps as a Pet Trainer. (You need to have reached at least level 80.)

[h3]New Lifestyle Specialist Card: Pet Trainer[/h3]

With the new specialist card, you can tame monsters and train them as pets in your Miniland to make them even stronger. Here’s how it works:
[list][*]Tame a monster or buy a pet.[/*][*]Summon various Sparring Monsters to train your pets.[/*][*]Depending on its training level, the pet has certain skills.[/*][*]When a pet has reached the maximum training level, you can increase its star rating with the Evolve skill (from 1 to 6 stars).[/*][*]To increase the star rating, you need the corresponding Pet Essence. (Example: If you want to upgrade a 2-star pet, you’ll need the Pet Essences of a 2-star pet.)[/*][*]To get Pet Essences, you need to tame and train another pet with the same star rating until it has reached its maximum training level.[/*][*]Extract the Pet Essence from the pet. (The pet is released in the process.)[/*][*]Now you can use the extracted Pet Essences and some gold to increase the star rating of the first pet.[/*][*]When you increase a pet’s star rating, it will forget all of its skills and the training level will be reset to 1, but at the same time its maximum training level will be increased.[/*][/list]
[h3]Tame Pets[/h3]
[list][*]Pet Trainers have two skills they can use to catch animals: ‘Tame’ and ‘Advanced Tame’. [/*][*]You can only tame 1 and 2-star creatures with skills. The Tame skill can be used for 1-star animals, while Advanced Tame is needed for 2-star animals.[/*][*]Advanced Tame needs a particular item for you to use it: Lure.[/*][*]Bring the necessary ingredients to Lucy in NosVille and she’ll craft Lure.[/*][/list]
[h3]Train Pets[/h3]
[list][*]To train your pets, you need to summon one of three various Sparring Monsters. For this you need a Sparring Monster Cage, which you can buy from Lucy.[/*][*]The first Sparring Monster trains your pets to level 20, the second to level 40 and the third to level 60.[/*][*]When a pet’s training level increases, its HP, attack power, defence, hit rate and all resistances increase as well. Plus at certain levels it can learn special skills.[/*][*]A pet can have a maximum of two additional skills. Any skills it has already learned can be upgraded at random.[/*][*]At training levels 10 and 20, the pet learns one new skill each. At further training levels (30, 35, 40, 45, 50, 55, 60), a skill that has already been learned is upgraded at random.[/*][/list]
[h3]Star Rating & Training Level[/h3]
[list][*]Every pet can evolve from 1 to 6 stars. Your training level depends on this (maximum training level = star rating x 10).[/*][*]You get a fixed stat per training level (e.g. defence, HP, attack, etc.)[/*][/list]
[h3]Pet Book[/h3]
[list][*]Here you can see which pets there are and which ones you have already collected and trained. [/*][*]In addition, there are missions that you can complete to receive special rewards. You can also complete daily quests here.[/*][/list]
[h3]Rewards[/h3]
[list][*]Titles: You will receive various titles for completing some of the quests from the Pet Book.[/*][*]Passive skill books: Some quests from the Pet Book reward you with passive skill books.[/*][/list]
[h3]Patch Notes[/h3]

Learn all about the content of the update in [url=https://board.en.nostale.gameforge.com/index.php?thread/11982-game-update-maintenance-23-05-2023/&postID=124968#post124968]our patch notes[/url]!

Best of luck on your way to becoming an expert trainer!
The NosTale Team

notes.title: Server Merge
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/b42ce0597b0f8ac8d0971a8cb9acb09bba46f464.jpg[/img]

Dear players,

Your enjoyment playing NosTale is at the heart of everything we do. That’s why we’ve decided to merge some English-language servers together – including the US server.

If you have any burning questions, we’ve done our best to answer them in the Merge FAQ below.

[b]We've merged the following servers together:[/b]
[list]
[*] EN2 (US-Cylloan)
[*]EN 4 (INT-Valehir)
[*]EN 5 (INT-Asgobas)
[/list][b]→ EN 4 (INT-Valehir)[/b]

No changes have been made to any servers not mentioned.

[h2]Server Merge FAQ[/h2]

[h3]How did you decide which servers to merge together?[/h3]
We conducted extensive analysis of the servers and are merging them in such a way that we can ensure a balanced population and activity levels on all servers after the merge.

[h3]What languages can I use on the server INT-Valehir, and what language will Support use?[/h3]
You can keep using the languages you want to use on the entire server. Support will only be available in english.

[h3]What happens if I have characters on multiple servers which are being transferred onto the same one?[/h3]
You have a total of four available character slots. If you have more characters than that, the four highest-ranking characters will be transferred to the target server. But! You won’t lose the remaining characters. They’ll just be deactivated. On the website you’ll be able to activate/deactivate your characters as you wish. 

Please note that you only have one active slot for Martial Artists. 

Here are the various situations which can arise, and how they will be resolved (the ‘original’ classes mentioned here refer to Swordsman, Archer, and Mage):

[b]Situation 1[/b]: Three original classes and no Martial Artists
Three slots will be occupied by your original class characters, and the fourth slot remains empty until you create another character.

[b]Situation 2[/b]: Four original class characters and no Martial Artists
All four slots will be occupied by your characters. 

[b]Situation 3[/b]: More than three original class characters and no Martial Artists
If you don’t have any Martial Artists, all four slots will be occupied by your highest-ranking characters. Your remaining characters will be deactivated but can be reactivated via the website.

[b]Situation 4[/b]: More than four original class characters and at least one Martial Artist
Three slots will be occupied by your highest-ranking original class characters. The fourth will be occupied by your highest-ranking Martial Artist. Your remaining characters will be deactivated but can be reactivated via the website.

[b]Situation 5[/b]: Less than three original class characters and at least one Martial Artist
The slots will be occupied by your original class characters, the remaining slots will remain empty until you create more original class characters. The fourth will be occupied by your highest-ranking Martial Artist. Your remaining Martial Artists will be deactivated but can be reactivated via the website.

[h3]How do I activate/deactivate my characters?[/h3]
Follow these simple steps to activate/deactivate a character:
[list]
[*]Open the Gameforge Client and select NosTale.
[*]Click on Settings to open your game account settings containing region and language settings and a list of all your game accounts.
[*]Ensure you have selected English [GB] as your game language and click on settings next to your game account name. This will take you to the relevant NosTale webpage where you can check your character list.
[*]If you have more than four characters and would like to play with one of your deactivated characters, select an active character and click on the character you’d like to play with. This will swap the two characters.
[*]Please note that you only have 1 active slot for Martial Artists. 
[/list]
You can change your active characters on the website at any time.

[h3]What’s happening to families?[/h3]
Active families will be transferred to the appropriate target server. Note that families whose members have been inactive for the last 180 days, or families with fewer than 4 members and a family level below 4 will be deleted.

[h3]What’s happening to the family warehouse?[/h3]
Items from the family warehouse will be sent to the Family Head by parcel. 

[h3]What if two or more characters have the same name?[/h3]
The first criterion for choosing who keeps the name is whichever character was online in the last 90 days. The others will be renamed.

If multiple characters were online in the last 90 days, then the character which is (at least) 10 levels higher than the others keeps the name.

Should there be a tie even after taking both of these criteria into account, then the older character (according to creation date) will keep their name.
If you want to rename an automatically renamed character, select the character after the merge and a window will pop up that allows you to change it.

[h3]What happens when two or more families have the same name?[/h3]
If multiple families have the same name on the target server, the older family will keep the name. Newer families are automatically renamed as follows: ‘merge_number’. Please contact [url=https://nostale.support.gameforge.com/index.php?fld=en]the Support team[/url] to change the family name manually.

[h3]What if I have more than 1,000,000,000 Gold after the merge?[/h3]
As is standard, the merged servers limit the amount of Gold you can have to 1,000,000,000. If you are over this limit before the merge, you will be capped at this maximum once you are moved to the new server. If you lose Gold because of the merge, please contact [url=https://nostale.support.gameforge.com/index.php?fld=en]the Support team[/url].

[h3]What happens to items in the warehouse?[/h3]
Your items in the warehouse will be sent by parcel to your highest-level character.

[h3]What happens to items in the NosMall which aren’t claimed?[/h3]
Any unclaimed items in the NosMall will be sent by parcel to your highest-level active character. 

[h3]What happens to active auctions in the NosBazaar?[/h3]
All active offers in the NosBazaar will be cancelled before the merge and then sent to the respective characters by parcel.

[h3]What happens to friend lists and spouses?[/h3]
As far as possible, friend lists and spouses will be merged on the target servers.

[h3]Will the rankings be reset?[/h3]
No, all player ranks on the target servers will be newly calculated and adjusted.

[h3]What happens to the blacklist?[/h3]
The blacklist will be deleted during the merge.

[h3]My character/account is deleted. Will the data be transferred anyway?[/h3]
Yes, even deleted characters/accounts will be transferred. It will still be possible to restore your data if you want to after the merge. 

[h3]Do I have to delete or select the characters I want to be activated on the new server before the server merge?[/h3]
No, your characters will be activated automatically.

[h3]What happens to my Gold and the items in my inventory?[/h3]
Both your Gold and the items in your inventory will be transferred to the target server.

[h3]Do I need to reinstall the game after the server merge?[/h3]
No, you can launch the game just the same as before.

[h3]Will my login details get changed by the merge?[/h3]
No, you can log in as usual with your credentials. If you have more than 4 characters in total, the four highest-ranking characters will be transferred to the target server. But! You won’t lose the remaining characters. They’ll just be deactivated. On the website you’ll be able to activate/deactivate your characters as you wish. 


If you have any further questions, [url=https://nostale.support.gameforge.com/index.php?fld=en]our Support team[/url] will be happy to help. 

Have fun on the new servers!
The NosTale Team

Easter in NosTale is more than colourful eggs: you can look forward to two thrilling Spring raids and cute bunny costumes!

[h2]The Mad March Hare[/h2]
The Mad March Hare is causing headaches in NosTale! You and your friends are the only ones who can stop him!

[b]How it Works:[/b]
[list][*]By defeating monsters you can pick up the Mad March Hare Raid Seal which you allows you to enter the raid.[/*][*]Enter the raid from the Chicken Farm Path and join other adventurers in combat against the Mad March Hare.[/*][*]The boss has an array of eggs in his arsenal. Dodge them and watch out for Rotten Egg Bombs, Eggy Bombs and Crazy Egg Bombs – you’ll need to interact with some of them![/*][*]Give the Mad March Hare a boot down the burrow. Then you can pick up some juicy rewards![/*][/list]
[h3]Reward[/h3]
As soon as you’ve completed the raid, you’ll receive an Easter raid box which may contain the following items amongst others:
[list][*]Mad March Hare Specialist Partner Card (for ranged partners)[/*][*]Easter Bunny Hat + Easter Bunny Costume (3 Days/7 Days). The permanent version of the costume is available in the NosMall.[/*][*]Egg-Shaped Chest[/*][*]And more Easter items![/*][/list]

[list][*]Easter Bunny Party Hat + Easter Bunny Party Costume (3 Days/7 Days). The permanent version of the costume is available in the NosMall.[/*][*]3x Mad March Hare Raid Seal[/*][/list]

Complete the additional Easter Quest and collect Cleansed and Rotten Eggs. You can exchange them for valuable items.

The Chicken Queen is causing problems again! Defeat her in the Chicken Queen Raid and you can get a pet [b]Creepy Imp[/b] and other rewards! This imp is devilishly ingenious, as it has two levels of development! 

By the way, in this raid you have the chance to pick up the ‘BBQ King’ title.

notes.title: Update: Balancing for Specialist Cards
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/64e16e69ca7f645076651dfdccb5d1abcbd989a1.jpg[/img]

Heads up, NosHero! The next update arrives on 15th March 2023 – and along with it loads of exciting content: discover the new balancing for several specialist cards as well as a bunch of improved game features! Read on to find out everything you need to know.


[h1]Balancing for Specialist Cards[/h1]

Get ready for exciting battles, because the following specialist cards will receive improved balancing with the upcoming update:

[b]Master Wolf[/b]
The way his ultimate abilities work has been fundamentally changed so that each of them now serves an individual purpose. From now on, you collect points for each skill hit and receive the ‘Ultimate Aura’ by activating the ultimate skills. At the highest level, you can use your ‘Ultimate Tri-Combo’ to destroy your opponents!

[b]Holy Mage[/b]
The healing of the Holy Mage now scales with his own maximum HP: the stronger you are, the more you can heal your allies! In addition, some of his skills have been reworked to offer even more support in the fight against raid bosses.

[b]Crusader[/b]
The damage the Crusader receives from his Triple Charging has been slightly reduced. In return, his basic skill has been accelerated and turned into an area attack that can hurt several enemies at once. Additionally, his healing and the ‘Growing Shield’ skill have been reworked.

[b]Assassin[/b]
The Assassin can now deal critical damage to his opponents with his daggers for a longer period of time. In return, his burst damage has been slightly reduced.

[b]Dragon Knight[/b]
The Dragon Knight now heals when enemies attack his ‘Draconium Shield’ skill.

[b]Blaster[/b]
The buff duration of several skills has been slightly increased. In addition, his ‘Dragon’s Breath’ skill now triggers a buff for the player instead of debuffing the opponent.

[b]Gravity[/b]
The damage reduction of his mana shield has been slightly improved.

[b]Hydraulic Fist[/b]
The Hydraulic Fist now regains mana when enemies attack into his ‘Frontal Block’ skill.

[b]Archmage[/b]
The Archmage now heals himself only half as much as his allies.

[b]Scout[/b] 
The Scout now reduces less critical damage of incoming attacks.

[b]Seer[/b] 
The cooldown of the ‘Mind Sink’ skill has been increased. Additionally, the damage reduction of his mana shield has been weakened.

[b]Dark Gunner[/b]
The damage reduction of his mana shield has been significantly reduced.

[b]Berserker:[/b] 
The ‘Break Armour’ skill now reduces the enemy’s defence level by 5 instead of 7 levels.


[h1]Improved Game Features[/h1]

As already announced, this update also includes some more of the longed-for ‘Quality of Life’ improvements that should make your adventures in NosTale a little more enjoyable. The following improvements will be made to the game:

[list]
[*]The Asgobas raid has been revised: the difficulty of the antechambers has been reduced and you now have to defeat significantly fewer monsters in the raid.
[*]The Revenant Paimon raid has been revised: you can now no longer use mounts in the raid and some monsters can see invisible players. In return, you are now guaranteed an SP9 Perfection Stone after every raid.
[*]Raid entries are now only consumed when the respective raid has been successfully completed.
[*]Raid reward chests are now stacked in the inventory (instead of occupying one inventory slot per item). From them you get items with a random rare-level between R0 and R6. This does not affect particularly rare R7 and R8 chests: they remain as separate items.
[*]The cost of scrolls and resistances from the Act 8 raid token shop has been reduced.
[*]You can find the complete list of changes in the patch notes.
[/list]
Have fun, 
The NosTale Team

notes.title: Events: Valentine’s Day and Battle Pass
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/6bf57ce2ab9b61bfe61780d7e82cf17cfb581ecf.jpg[/img]

We’re sure there’s someone special in NosVille you’ve always wanted to confess your love to. Valentine’s Day is the perfect time to get hitched! You can look forward to romantic events and a brand new Battle Pass season with great rewards up for grabs, even if you don’t own the Premium expansion. Read on to find out everything you need to know!

[h1]Valentine’s Day in NosTale[/h1]

[b]From 13th February (11 AM) to 22nd February (9 AM CET)[/b], there are lots of loveydovey events and promotions waiting for you in NosTale:

[h3]Event: Amora Needs Cupid’s Arrows[/h3]
[list]
[*]Help Amora spread the love in NosVille. To do that she’ll need some arrows.
[*]Talk to Amora once you reach at least level 50. She’ll explain what she needs to make them. Collect the components and bring them to her!
[*]You’ll get the Wedding Costume Specialist Card (one per character) as a thank you.
[/list]
[h3]Event: Show Your Feelings[/h3]
[list]
[*]Hunt monsters and collect Chocolate, Gift Boxes, and Ribbons.
[*]Exchange them for a Valentine’s Day Gift from Eva Energy. Then you’ll have the chance to share your love!
[*]If your friend accepts your gift, you’ll get a Valentine’s Day Blessing that grants you extra energy and strength. This temporarily increases your attack and defence power.
[*]1–3 Gifts: Small Valentine’s Day Blessing
[*]4–9 Gifts: Valentine’s Day Blessing
[*]10+ Gifts: Big Valentine’s Day Blessing
[*]Now remember, not everyone will want to accept your gifts – but stay strong!
[*]Don’t be shy, share your love! You can give someone a present up to 3 times each day.
[/list]
[h3]Event: Amora’s Missing Wings[/h3]
Love can be a double-edged sword. The tragic story of Wingless Amora and her true love will pull at your heartstrings. But you’ll soon feel all warm and cuddly again once you get your new ranged partner as a quest reward: Wingless Amora (one per character).

[h3]Discount Sale: Weddings at Bargain Prices[/h3]
Let your long-awaited dreams of the big day come true and pick up a Wedding Box at a 20% discount. Just remember not to take marriage lightly – divorce can be a painful experience. To remind you of this, the Separation Letter now costs 20% more. This offer will end once the Valentine’s event is over. Don’t forget – you can also get Amora’s Specialist Partner Card in the shop.

[h1]Benefit from the Battle Pass Now[/h1]

In NosTale, a new season of our amazing Battle Pass awaits you. Enjoy many benefits and secure additional rewards as a Premium expansion owner! The current Battle Pass season runs from [b]14th February (midnight) to 14th March (midnight, CET)[/b].

[h3]This Is the NosTale Battle Pass[/h3]
With NosTale’s Battle Pass, you complete daily, weekly and seasonal challenges that earn you Battle Points. You can collect rewards for the points you earn. And everyone can benefit: Battle Pass activities and rewards are free for all players!

By the way: all rewards can be collected until 28th March at midnight (CET). Plus
you still have a chance to earn enough Battle Points for the final reward, even if you miss the first week of the Battle Pass season.

[b]Rewards:[/b] 
[list]
[*]Protection Amulet
[*]NosMerchant Medal (7 Days)
[*]Equipment Protection Scroll
[*]a new exclusive title
[*]many more prizes
[/list]
[h3]How About the Premium Expansion?[/h3]
If you decide to purchase the Premium Battle Pass, you can look forward to more and higher-value rewards. This feature is perfect for you if you want to get the most from the Battle Pass activities!

The Premium Battle Pass of the current season costs 250 NosDollars. If you want to invest less time, get the Premium Battle Pass Coin in the NosMall. With this coin you can skip a step and directly get 50 Battle Points. The coin will be available in the NosMall from 27th February (11 AM CET).

[b]Rewards:[/b] 
[list]
[*]Partner Skill Ticket (Single)
[*]Golden Specialist Card Holder
[*]Golden Equipment Protection Scroll
[*]a new exclusive pet
[*]many more prizes
[/list]

Have fun!
The NosTale Team

notes.title: Community Update – First half of 2023
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/e3648aefa3a44482ada06d3f3d040c565b0a52ff.jpg[/img]

Hello everyone! It’s time for another community update.

In 2022, we released lots of new content, including Act 8 and the new specialist cards. We also listened to your feedback and made some balancing adjustments and improved the playability of certain specialist cards. Of course, we also have a lot planned for you in 2023. In the following, we’ll give you a little preview of what’s to come in the next six months.

Kicking things off in January: the [b]new version of the Time-Space events[/b]. We’ve [b]adjusted the rewards[/b] for this and all future events (Lunar New Year Event, Valentine’s Day Event, Easter Event, etc.) and made sure that there are now more incentives to participate.

We also plan on continuing to [b]improve playability[/b], just as we have done regularly over the past few years. We’ve already made great progress in this area thanks to your great feedback. So look forward to more positive changes! And yes, that includes [b]balance adjustments for Master Wolf, the Crusader and the Holy Mage[/b]. These changes are scheduled for the first quarter of 2023.

Speaking of specialist cards... Originally we had planned to release a new Lifestyle specialist card in the second half of 2022, but we had to postpone that in order to be able to put more time into the development of SP10. This project is now complete, so you can look forward to a [b]new Lifestyle specialist who can tame and improve pets[/b] – to be released soon.

Of course, we also have to address the winners of our competition. We’re not talking about the story competition (as announced, there will be news about that in January), but about last year’s [b]fan art contest[/b]. We have already implemented the Lunar Wings this year, but we would like to incorporate more of your ideas into the game.

Last but not least, we have good news for all players on the Cylloan server. As you may know, the main problem is the server location in the US, which is why we couldn’t act earlier. But don’t worry, no member of the NosTale family is left behind! In the coming months, we will conduct a [b]migration test[/b] to move the server to Europe. If everything works out, we can hopefully carry out the merge you have been longing for. We don’t want to give you false hope – we can’t guarantee that this will work. But rest assured, we will do our best to find a satisfactory solution for everyone.

And that concludes our little preview. As you can see, we have a lot planned for the next six months, so we certainly won’t get bored. One more small spoiler: in the second half of the year we have a [u]frosty[/u] surprise for you! But until then... you’ll have to wait and see. ;)

Have a great start to the New Year!
he NosTale Team

notes.title: UPDATE: Four New Specialists
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/a3b8b69794cedc0e51a1f5f732cd925f22382930.jpg[/img]

At the turn of the year, you can look forward to the biggest update in a long time: four brand new specialists are coming to NosTale – one for each class, as well as numerous quests and a thrilling raid! Read on to find out the most important details about the new content. First up, the new specialists:

[h2]The New Specialists[/h2]
Become the greatest hero in NosTale with one of the four brand new specialists. But first you must free the souls of the contenders. To do this, you’ll complete an exciting series of quests in which you hunt monsters and collect Time-Space Stones and other items. Which of the four new specialists will you free?

[h3]DRAGON KNIGHT for Swordsmen[/h3]
The Dragon Knight wields a mighty lance for which even dragon scales are no match. To go with it, he carries a shield that cannot be harmed by magic and can even withstand dragon’s breath. The Dragon Knight’s attacks fill up his ‘Polished Lance’ bar: the longer he brawls with his enemies, the stronger his attacks become. In addition, his skills enable him to pierce the armour of enemies, causing them to suffer great damage from his other skills.

[h3]BLASTER for Archers[/h3]
The Blaster carries a devastating cannon which can launch various grenades and take down even the toughest enemies. The longer he fires his cannon, the hotter it gets. This in turn gives him powerful additional effects that he can use to inflict further damage on his opponent. But if the Blaster’s weapon overheats, he cannot use any skills for a short time until it has cooled down again. By reloading regularly he can prevent overheating and even increase his damage.

[h3]GRAVITY for Mages[/h3]
Gravitas rules over gravity: with the help of his gravitational sphere, he manipulates gravity and antigravity to his advantage. Depending on which element he uses, the power of the respective element increases. When he has fully tamed the two forces of gravity and antigravity, he reaches gravitational equilibrium to unleash special bonus abilities for his skills.

[h3]HYDRAULIC FIST for Martial Artists[/h3]
While the Hydraulic Fist may have a weak physique, he makes up for it with his devastating metallic fists. The Hydraulic Fist’s robotic arms are Draconium gauntlets powered by a magical engine that helps them unleash their immense destructive force. By supplying sufficient fuel, his attacks are significantly strengthened and receive additional bonus effects.

[h2]The New Raid[/h2]
To upgrade your new specialist with Perfection Stones, you will face dangerous adversaries in a challenging boss room in the new raid. Prepare for battle! It definitely won’t be a piece of cake!

[h2]More New Content[/h2]
In addition to the new content mentioned above, you can expect additional quests and our winter events with brilliant rewards and festive offers. Keep your eyes peeled for our next news post and find out what Christmas in NosTale has in store for you!

Enjoy the new content!
The NosTale Team

notes.title: Fangtastic Events in NosTale!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/4e3e338234f76014cdfb8c5d077a13fe7d696169.jpg[/img]

[i]Tiny spideys are creeping in, more and more of them.
‘Where could they all be coming from?’ you ask aghast.
You answer the door, and find a cheeky pumpkin grinning back.
What’s this gloomy mood that has overcome you?
You check your calendar and see the date.
It’s the end of October. Time to celebrate: Halloween![/i]

Get ready: [b]from 26th October to 9th November[/b], NosVille and Port Alveus will be decked out in eerie Halloween decorations and the mad Professor Macavity, Foxy and Jack O’Lantern will be causing all sorts of creepy mayhem in NosTale! An additional quest, a Halloween costume and a title with powerful effects are also waiting for you!

[h1]Event Raids[/h1]
[h3]Jack O’Lantern and His Minions[/h3]
Defeat the evil pumpkin Jack O’Lantern in the raid! He’s supported by his Pumpkin Bushi and Pumpkin Bomb minions. In reward for victory, you can claim a Halloween raid box.Amongst others you can pick up a Glowing Pumpkin Hat and creepy Tarot Cards from the raid box in this event.

[h3]Foxy and Her Brood[/h3]
Challenge Foxy and her sneaky brood in the raid! Use Foxy’s Raid Seal to confront her. If you’re successful, you’ll earn her Wonder Chest in reward. With a little luck it might contain Foxy’s Specialist Partner Card!Foxy is a raid boss with super skills, as well as being a new partner. Tame her and she’ll be your loyal companion forever!

The raid seals can be picked up in daily quests. Plus you can earn more rewards by collecting flasks.

[h3]Mad Professor Macavity[/h3]
The mad genius feline is back! Rally 7 players around you and start the raid. Two of the eight players will be transformed into Professor Macavity and the Test Subject. Let the hunt begin!

[b]Full details on the raid:[/b]
[list][*]Mad Professor Macavity’s Raid Seal drops in Foxy and Jack O’Lantern’s raids.[/*][*]The raid can only be attempted 5 times per day. There are however reset tickets.[/*][*]Exactly 8 players are needed to start the raid.[/*][*]Players who want to play must bring a pet.[/*][*]Professor Macavity can drag the Test Subject to him. Both need to work together to capture enemies.[/*][*]Only the hunted players can open boxes during the raid and receive handy items for the chase.[/*][*]Hunters can freeze opponents for a short time. [/*][*]Before hunted players can leave the raid, they must find a key in one of the boxes.[/*][*]The hunters must prevent the hunted from leaving the raid. For each player caught, the hunters earn a raid box. Caught players leave the raid without a box.[/*][*]If a hunted player leaves the raid successfully, they earn a raid box.[/*][*]White Witch Laurena’s Wand appears if the hunted player with the wand is caught.[/*][/list]
[h3]Reward: Titles with Powerful Effects[/h3]
In reward for each of the three Halloween raids there is one of these titles in the raid box:
[list][*]Test Subject: Increases resistance to Fatal Bleeding and other Bleeding by 1%.[/*][*]Sly Dog: Increases max. MP by 300.[/*][*]Horror: Deals greater damage to low-level undead monsters by 3%.[/*][/list]
[h1]Daily Quests[/h1]
[h3]The Cursed 13[/h3]
Talk to Mary in NosVille to start the quest and earn yourself a new title by successfully completing all three Halloween raids 13 times! The ‘Monstrous’ title gives you a 2% chance of triggering Horror when you attack.

[h3]Daily Quests from NosVille NPCs[/h3]
Talk to Eric, Eva Energy, Malcolm Mix and Teoman Topp and pick up handy items in the Trick or Treat Quests! For example, you can get Yellow and Black Pumpkin Sweets, the Halloween Blessing, a Glowing Pumpkin Hat or a Halloween Costume Scroll. Playing the quests will also get you Bags of Sweets which can be exchanged for Jack O’Lantern’s raid seal.
[list][*]Defeating monsters causes them to drop goodies like Yellow and Black Pumpkin Sweets. You can either gobble them down, or exchange them for a Halloween Costume Scroll or a raid seal for Jack O’Lantern.[/*][*]Don your new Glowing Pumpkin Hat! You’ll be sure to set a new trend in the village! You can get the deadly smart headgear from the Halloween Horror Box or the raid box.[/*][*]Halloween Costume Scroll: Transform into 10 different creepy critters which you know from the game. The new costume gives you 4x attack power and 2x defence power.[/*][/list]
[h1]NosMall Offers[/h1]
Pick your favourite monstrous costume and give enemies a good scare: during the event period, [b]the Plague Doctor/Nurse Costume[/b] will be available in the NosMall.

When you use an attack skill while wearing this eerie outfit, you have an 8% probability of receiving a 10-second healing effect which restores your HP by 5% of the damage dealt (maximum of 1,500 HP per skill). You also benefit from a 20% increase in champion experience and an additional +1 movement speed.

Wishing you tons of spooky fun,
The NosTale Team

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/9bf3d7e81291c1c0d73db080dfe7ba6ab1dda6d7.jpg[/img]

Celebrate [b]NosTale’s 15th Anniversary[/b] with amazing Battle Pass rewards and the Great Collectors’ Event geared to this grand milestone! Collect more experience in the Double EXP Event, grab a new specialist partner and more.

[previewyoutube=EveLYaaCUJE;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]New Battle Pass Rewards![/h3]
Between 12th October and 2nd November, you can look forward to new rewards in the Battle Pass! Complete missions to get the most of it.
For example, you could get the [b]Gloopy Cake[/b], or pick up a [b]brand-new title[/b] in fitting for the anniversary! If you have the premium version, you can also scoop up the [b]11th Anniversary Costume (Permanent)[/b], a [b]Golden Specialist Card Holder[/b], prized [b]Golden Equipment Protection Scrolls[/b], popular [b]mounts[/b] and more!

[h3]The Great Collectors’ Event[/h3]
Mimi Mentor is sending you on the hunt for various letters and numbers from 12th October (midnight) until 2nd November (11:29 PM CET). These can be collected when defeating monsters. Use them to restore HP, MP or SP, or exchange them for [b]exclusive event prizes[/b] from Mimi.
[list][*]Collect the letters N, O, S, Y, E, A, R and the number 15 and exchange them for a [b]15th Anniversary Medal[/b] from Mimi Mentor. This will earn you and your NosMates 10% more experience points for 15 days, and increase attack and defence by 10%.[/*][*]Collect the letters Y, E, A, R and the number 15 and exchange them for a [b]15th Anniversary Buff[/b] from Mimi Mentor. This increases your max. HP and MP by 10% for 3,200 seconds (~53 minutes).[/*][*]Collect N, O, S and refill your basic specialist points.[/*][/list]
[h3]EXP Event[/h3]
Gobble up [b]double experience[/b] between 21st October (midnight) and 24th October (11:59 PM CEST) for defeating monsters and completing quests.

[h3]New Specialist Partner[/h3]
A new specialist partner with a heart of gold is waiting to join you on your adventures! Who could it be? One thing’s for certain: you don’t need to be a rocket scientist to know he’s got nerves of steel, and won’t ever run out of steam...

Have fun!
The NosTale Team

notes.title: International Server Launched
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/71092fd237b9809edd4293faabbeb23e95b6ddc4.jpg[/img]

The wait is nearly over: the new international server INT-Asgobas launches on 25th August! Look forward to exciting challenges to master every week – the [b]Raid Challenges[/b]!

Plus enjoy powerful boosts during the first month, and chat to your friends in your own language on the server.

[h2]The Raid Challenges[/h2]
Play for the special ‘NosJewels’ event currency on the new international server by completing raid challenges. In the NosMall you’ll find a new category where you can use NosJewels to buy rewards such as powerful wings, titles, potions and more! Please note that there are some items which you can only purchase on the new server.

During the event, you can explore up to 10 different event raids. Each entry requires a raid seal, which you can acquire from the NosMall. The event starts off with 2 active raids for which you will be rewarded with points. These will remain active for 2 weeks and 2 more raids will be added each week. There are a maximum of 4 active raids at any time for which you can receive points.

The points for raids are awarded as follows:
[list][*]You have completed a raid in the given time → 10 points[/*][*]Complete one of the active raids 10 times → 25 points[/*][*]Complete a certain number of raids over the entire event period → 75 points (all raids count towards this challenge)[/*][*]Complete a certain number of Time-Spaces from level 30 over the entire event period → 75 points[/*][/list]
You receive NosJewels as a reward for completing the respective Battle Pass mission. Should you not collect your rewards in time, you will be automatically credited with your points at midnight.

notes.title: Server Merge
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/b42ce0597b0f8ac8d0971a8cb9acb09bba46f464.jpg[/img]

Dear players,

Your enjoyment playing NosTale is at the heart of everything we do. That’s why we’ve decided to merge some language servers together in August (final date will be announced very soon).

If you have any burning questions, we’ve done our best to answer them in the Merge FAQ below.

[h3]We are merging the following servers together:[/h3]
[list][*]DE 1 (Ancelloan) + DE 2 (Fortuna) = [b]DE 1 (Alzanor)[/b][/*][*]EN 3 (International-1) + EN 4 (International-2) = [b]EN 3 (INT-Valehir)[/b][/*][/list]
As you can see, we're merging some English servers, as well as the German servers. No changes will be made to any other servers.

[h2]Server Merge FAQ[/h2]

[h3]How did you decide which servers to merge together?[/h3]
We conducted extensive analysis of the servers and are merging them in such a way that we can ensure a balanced population and activity levels on all servers after the merge.

[h3]Are the US servers not being merged?[/h3]
The US servers will be merged at a later date. We’re going to have a test phase this summer, during which we will request your feedback so we can proceed with the US server merge soon.

[h3]What languages can I use on the Europe server, and what language will Support use?[/h3]
You can keep using the languages you want to use on the entire Europe server. And Support will still be available to help you in the languages you are used to. The only change is that from now on you’ll be on a server with lots of other languages being spoken at once.

[h3]What happens if I have characters on multiple servers which are being transferred onto the same one?[/h3]
You have a total of four available character slots. If you have more characters than that, the four highest-ranking characters will be transferred to the target server. But! You won’t lose the remaining characters. They’ll just be deactivated. On the website you’ll be able to activate/deactivate your characters as you wish. Please note that you only have one active slot for Martial Artists. Here are the various situations which can arise, and how they will be resolved (the ‘original’ classes mentioned here refer to Swordsman, Archer, and Mage):
[list][*][b]Situation 1[/b]: Three original classes and no Martial ArtistsThree slots will be occupied by your original class characters, and the fourth slot remains empty until you create another character.[/*][*][b]Situation 2[/b]: Four original class characters and no Martial ArtistsAll four slots will be occupied by your characters. [/*][*][b]Situation 3[/b]: More than three original class characters and no Martial ArtistsIf you don’t have any Martial Artists, all four slots will be occupied by your highest-ranking characters. Your remaining characters will be deactivated but can be reactivated via the website.[/*][*][b]Situation 4[/b]: More than four original class characters and at least one Martial ArtistThree slots will be occupied by your highest-ranking original class characters. The fourth will be occupied by your highest-ranking Martial Artist. Your remaining characters will be deactivated but can be reactivated via the website.[/*][*][b]Situation 5[/b]: Less than three original class characters and at least one Martial ArtistThe slots will be occupied by your original class characters, the remaining slots will remain empty until you create more original class characters. The fourth will be occupied by your highest-ranking Martial Artist. Your remaining Martial Artists will be deactivated but can be reactivated via the website.[/*][/list]
[h3]How do I activate/deactivate my characters?[/h3]
Follow these simple steps to activate/deactivate a character:
[list][*]Open the Gameforge Client and select NosTale.[/*][*]Click on Settings to open your account settings. This will take you to the relevant NosTale webpage where you can check your character list.[/*][*]If you have more than four characters and would like to play with one of your deactivated characters, select an active character and click on the character you’d like to play with. This will swap the two characters.[/*][*]Please note that you only have 1 active slot for Martial Artists. You can change your active characters on the website at any time.[/*][/list]
[h3]What’s happening to families?[/h3]
Active families will be transferred to the appropriate target server. Note that families whose members have been inactive for the last 180 days, or families with fewer than 4 members and a family level below 4 will be deleted.

[h3]What’s happening to the family warehouse?[/h3]
Items from the family warehouse will be sent to the Family Head by parcel. 

[h3]What if two or more characters have the same name?[/h3]
The first criterion for choosing who keeps the name is whichever character was online in the last 90 days. The others will be renamed.If multiple characters were online in the last 90 days, then the character which is (at least) 10 levels higher than the others keeps the name.Should there be a tie even after taking both of these criteria into account, then the older character (according to creation date) will keep their name.If you want to rename an automatically renamed character, select the character after the merge and a window will pop up that allows you to change it.

[h3]What happens when two or more families have the same name?[/h3]
If multiple families have the same name on the target server, the older family will keep the name. Newer families are automatically renamed as follows: ‘merge_number’. Please contact the [url=https://nostale.support.gameforge.com/]Support team[/url] to change the family name manually.

[h3]What if I have more than 1,000,000,000 Gold after the merge?[/h3]
As is standard, the merged servers limit the amount of Gold you can have to 1,000,000,000. If you are over this limit before the merge, you will be capped at this maximum once you are moved to the new server. If you lose Gold because of the merge, please contact our [url=https://nostale.support.gameforge.com/]Support team[/url].

[h3]What happens to items in the warehouse?[/h3]
Your items in the warehouse will be sent by parcel to your highest-level character.

[h3]What happens to items in the NosMall which aren’t claimed?[/h3]
Any unclaimed items in the NosMall will be sent by parcel to your highest-level active character. 

[h3]What happens to active auctions in the NosBazaar?[/h3]
All active offers in the NosBazaar will be cancelled before the merge and then sent to the respective characters by parcel.

[h3]What happens to friend lists and spouses?[/h3]
As far as possible, friend lists and spouses will be merged on the target servers.

[h3]Will the rankings be reset?[/h3]
No, all player ranks on the target servers will be newly calculated and adjusted.

[h3]What happens to the blacklist?[/h3]
The blacklist will be deleted during the merge.

[h3]My character/account is deleted. Will the data be transferred anyway?[/h3]
Yes, even deleted characters/accounts will be transferred. It will still be possible to restore your data if you want to after the merge. 

[h3]Do I have to delete or select the characters I want to be activated on the new server before the server merge?[/h3]
No, your characters will be activated automatically.

[h3]What happens to my Gold and the items in my inventory?[/h3]
Both your Gold and the items in your inventory will be transferred to the target server.

[h3]Do I need to reinstall the game after the server merge?[/h3]
No, you can launch the game just the same as before.

[h3]Will my login details get changed by the merge?[/h3]
No, you can log in as usual with your credentials. If you have more than 4 characters in total, the four highest-ranking characters will be transferred to the target server. But! You won’t lose the remaining characters. They’ll just be deactivated. On the website you’ll be able to activate/deactivate your characters as you wish. 

If you have any further questions, our [url=https://nostale.support.gameforge.com/]Support team[/url] will be happy to help. 

Have fun on the new servers!
The NosTale Team

notes.title: Community Update - Summer 2022
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/e3648aefa3a44482ada06d3f3d040c565b0a52ff.jpg[/img]

Hello NosPlayers!

Time really flies when you’re having fun! With half of the year already behind us, it’s about time we had another round of ‘What’s going down in the world of NosTale over the coming months?’

But before we get down to it, just the usual quick note that the following are only plans that may be subject to change. It’s entirely possible that some things get pulled forward, while others end up on the back-burner, so please see this roadmap as a general guide of what lies ahead, rather than a set of commandments chiselled in stone.

With that out of the way, let’s get to it!

In general, balancing changes and quality of life improvements will continue to be released sporadically between larger updates. There’s more than enough work to be done here, and while we don’t want to nail ourselves to any specific changes, rest assured we won’t be running out things to improve any time soon.

We previously announced the next round of balancing changes which will concentrate on the Master Wolf, Holy Mage and Crusader specialists. A little further on the horizon will be the Warrior, Sunchaser and Mystic Arts.

If you’re one of those people who’d much rather decimate the local wildlife though, don’t worry, we’ve got you covered, with SP10 planned for the end of the year! That’s right, we’re looking to introduce a new specialist for every class. Such big content changes always require a lot of effort, so we can’t absolutely guarantee that this patch won’t be pushed back to the following year, but for now we’re definitely aiming at a 2022 release.

Even though we already had a round of server merges in the first half of the year, we’re planning more for the second half. This time will focus on those servers which didn’t need any change in the last round, but where activity has dropped off and the requests for a merge have become louder.
Please note that we’ll only go into more specific detail (regarding which servers and when etc.) at a later point in time. Because of its geographic location, merging the US server (EN2) is giving us some headaches which will need more time to iron out, so it’s possible that this server will not be part of the second round of merges.

As it’s been almost a year since the last new server launch, we’ll probably have some news on that front in the second half of the year, but again, more details will follow in due course.

As ever, there’ll be seasonal events to look forward to, and doubtless a few new items will find their way into the game. And let’s not forget that NosTale will pass a huge milestone and celebrate its 15th anniversary in October! That’s right, if we’re made to feel old, you have to share our pain!

And that about wraps up everything we have to tell! As already mentioned at the start, it’s entirely possible for some of these plans to get waylaid or for others to take their place.  But we hope this update at least gives you a flavour of the things to come.

Wishing you a (not too) warm and sunny summer!

The NosTale Team

notes.title: Update: Specialist Partner Fusion & Wing Fusion
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/cbee6baf64337366ecc706fd0b0517bc35449a00.jpg[/img]

Not long now until 6th July, when you can start to explore the changes we wrote about in our [url=https://gameforge.com/en-GB/play/nostale/news/d5c413cc-0e2f-4791-9708-aa885bc3de7c]last post[/url]: [b]Specialist Partner Fusion[/b] and [b]Wing Fusion[/b]!

Specialist Partner Fusion is a new system which enables you to use the specialist partner cards you don’t need to upgrade the ones you do. Fusing them together gives your partners powerful bonuses!

Meanwhile, in the NosMall you can find the Wing Changer (Random), which gives you a certain chance to transfer the appearance of certain wings onto another pair. Keep the cool effects of the wings you have, while enjoying the looks of the wings which best suit your hero!

[h3]Trailer[/h3]
Check out the trailer for the update here:

[previewyoutube=1yiQZ3GnYMk;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]Patch Notes[/h3]
[b]Added the specialist partner fusion system.[/b]
[list][*]Specialist partner fusion allows you to upgrade your specialist partner cards by fusing unused cards with your main one. As with the familiar perfecting system you know from regular specialist cards, this permanently increases their stats.[/*][*]You can upgrade you specialist partners with every alchemist in the big towns.[/*][*]If you fuse your specialist partner card with an identical one, you’ll receive double the experience.[/*][*]An identical specialist partner card is even a requirement for upgrading from levels 19, 39, 59, 79 and 99. Exceeding these levels gives you a large amount of additional skill points.[/*][*]Temporary specialist partner cards and specialist partners with similar appearances (such as Foxy and Fiona) are considered copies for the purposes of the specialist partner fusion.[/*][*]When you upgrade your specialist partner card, it will randomly increase one of the following 8 stats: attack, defence, crit damage reduction, HP/MP, fire resistance, water resistance, light resistance or shadow resistance.[/*][*]The number of points depends on the card’s current upgrade level. In total you can receive up to 390 skill points, shared across all 8 stats, but you can never have more than 100 points in one main stat, or 35 points in a resistance stat.[/*][/list]
[b]Added a wing randomiser item.[/b]
[list][*]This was suggested by the players and was originally intended to be implemented as a wing fusion system. However, having thought more about the issue, we decided that few players would want to ‘waste’ an expensive pair of wings for the sake of a new appearance. So we’ve implemented this as a system which allows you to try out lots of different wing designs in the game, irrespective of their effects![/*][*]An option has been added to the specialist card interface which allows you to remove the current wing design.[/*][*]All buffs granted by specialist wings have their own buff symbol, making it easier to identify which wing effects are active.[/*][*]When using this item, you can't get the same wings twice in a row. You also won't receive the appearance of your currently equipped wings.[/*][/list]
[b]Added a Retro Wing randomiser item to the Rainbow Crystal shop.[/b]
[list][*]We also wanted to give you the option to try out the newly introduced Retro Wings in a separate package. Given the different colour variations, there was no easy way to include them in the regular wing fusion, without drowning out the other wing options. Please note that this item can only be used by characters who are already wearing Retro Wings.[/*][/list]
[b]Improvements to the fishing system.[/b]
[list][*]We understand that many of you find the current fishing system rather monotonous and not worthy of your time. We believe that the main reason for this is the very low chance of catching legendary fish. So we’ve decided to greatly increase (quadruple!) the chance of landing one, thereby also increasing the speed of levelling up (as legendary fish provide more fishing XP than regular ones).[/*][*]In this update we’re also introducing items which support your fishing activities.[/*][*]One additional change we’re implementing will however reduce the sale price of legendary fish. When we originally introduced the fishing system, legendary fish could be sold for high prices, as they had no other use. But since the introduction of the cooking system, they can now be used as ingredients for meals. The high price of the fish has led to cooking being far more expensive than originally planned. Of course, there are also expensive meals which are not fish-based, and we plan to take a look at these in due course. But with the increased fishing chances, we’re confident about making this change. We think that players will still be able to trade these fish amongst themselves for a decent price, but selling them to NPCs will no longer be as lucrative.[/*][*]We’ve slightly increased the success rate when fishing, and greatly reduced the chance of your line tearing.[/*][*]Most fishing titles have been improved and now give you more fishing XP and improved fishing chances.[/*][*]You can now only buy up to 250 fishing baits per day.[/*][/list]
[b]Changes to the minigame raids.[/b]
[list][*]Two of the main issues with the minigame raids were that they were hardly worth playing and that they always started at random times. We’ve made some changes to hopefully improve both of these points, but we’ll be keeping our eyes on them in future, so please send us your feedback or suggestions if you have any![/*][*]The raid seals for the Sheep Farm, Dodge Meteor and Bushi King Defence have been removed from the game.[/*][*]These three raids now start automatically at fixed times on channels 1 and 2 (CET/CEST):[list][*]Sheep Farm: 1:15, 4:15, 7:15, 10:15, 13:15, 16:15, 19:15, 22:15[/*][*]Dodge Meteor: 2:15, 5:15, 8:15, 11:15, 14:15, 17:15, 20:15, 23:15[/*][*]Bushi King Defence: 0:15, 3:15, 6:15, 9:15, 12:15, 15:15, 18:15, 21:15[/*][/list][/*][*]You can now purchase a Specialist Partner Box containing 1 of 9 specialist partner cards for 1 Golden Acorn and 1 Silver Acorn.[/*][*]The number of Acorns required to craft a Bronze Acorn has been reduced from 50 to 15.[/*][*]The Acorn rewards for the individual raids has been improved:[list][*]Sheep Farm: In addition to the raid box you now get some Acorns depending on your ranking:[/*][*]1st Place: 15 Acorns[/*][*]2nd–3rd Place: 10 Acorns[/*][*]4th–10th Place: 7 Acorns[/*][*]11th–20th Place: 5 Acorns[/*][*]21st–30th Place: 3 Acorns[/*][*]Dodge Meteor: The amount of Acorns dropped between each phase has been increased as follows:[/*][*]After round 1: 10 Acorns -> 15 Acorns[/*][*]After round 2: 10 Acorns -> 20 Acorns[/*][*]After round 3: 10 Acorns -> 25 Acorns[/*][*]After round 4: 10 Acorns -> 30 Acorns[/*][*]If you die during round 1, you’ll now get 1 Acorns instead of 0.[/*][*]If you die after completing round 1, you’ll now get 3 Acorns instead of 1.[/*][*]If you die after completing round 2, you'll now get 6 Acorns instead of 2.[/*][*]If you die after completing round 3, you'll now get 10 Acorns instead of 3.[/*][*]The rewards for rounds 4 and 5 remain unchanged (1 or 2 Bronze Acorns respectively).[/*][*]Bushi King Defence: In addition to the raid boxes (2 for the winners, 1 for the losers), the following changes have been implemented:[/*][*]The winning team now additionally receives 10 Acorns.[/*][*]The losing team now additionally receives 5 Acorns.[/*][*]The Bushi King Defence raid can now be started with a minimum of 10 instead of 20 players.[/*][*]The contents of the Bushi King Gift Box have been changed to provide more consistent Acorn rewards.[/*][*]Please note that you still need to meet the activity point requirement to receive a reward.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[b]Other changes:[/b]
[list][*]You can now transform champion level equipment into partner equipment. Partners can only wear this gear if their master also has the appropriate champion level.[/*][*]All cooldowns are reset after completing a Celestial Spire level.[/*][*]All cooldowns are reset after completing a round of the Arena of Talents.[/*][*]The debuff which you get when three characters with the same class start the Arena of Talents is now a neutral debuff (so you can change your specialist card).[/*][*]Dragon Gems, Shining Green Souls and Shining Red Souls have been added as map drops in the lower Land of Life (C30-C59).[/*][*]Shining Red Souls and Shining Blue Souls have been added as map drops in the upper Land of Life (C60-C80).[/*][*]Added new icons to the Erenia, Zenas and Fernon fairies, matching their respective elements.[/*][*]Rune powers now also work on secondary weapons.[/*][*]The knockback effect of the Kickback Power rune power now only applies to enemies in PvP.[/*][*]Dowsing Rods now show the location of hidden spaces across the entire map.[/*][*]You can now exchange 25x Draco’s Claw/Glacerus’ Mane for 5x Ruby/Sapphire of Completion from Sarakael.[/*][*]Eva Energy now sells animal food which increases your NosMate’s loyalty to 1,000.[/*][*]Upgraded NosMate Guardian Angels and Partner’s Guardian Angels which resurrect your pets/partners with 100% of their HP/MP are now available from Malcolm Mix. They are consumed before the regular guardian angels.[/*][*]The Guardian Angel’s Blessing now increases the experience of your NosMates and partners by 100% (previously it only applied to NosMates and increased the experience by 50%).[/*][*]When you right-click on an equipped fairy, you can now see how many monsters you still need to kill before it upgrades to the next level.[/*][*]Skill cooldowns are now displayed in minutes and seconds in the skill bar.[/*][*]The buff bar has been expanded from 2 to 3 rows, allowing you to see up to 30 buffs at once.[/*][*]If you click on a friend/foe, you can now see 15 effects instead of 8. These are also divided into a row of buffs and a row of debuffs.[/*][*]When clicking on a target, you can now see their exact current/max HP/MP values.[/*][*]The set effect of the Ice Witch costume has been changed: When attacked, you now have a 10% chance to heal for 3% of your max. HP. The set effect now also already activates when wearing the costume and wings (instead of the full set).[/*][/list]
[b]Bug fixes:[/b]
[list][*]Partners can now use the orange-coloured effects from their partner equipment correctly.[/*][*]Fixed an error which caused specialist partners to show an upgrade level when wearing certain gear long before this update.[/*][*]Fixed an error in which players received an incorrect error message when trying to equip a specialist partner card on a partner below level 30.[/*][*]Fixed an error which prevented players listing multiple items with a total sales fee of more than 100,000 Gold without an active NosMerchant Medal.[/*][*]Fixed an error which caused characters to lose gold if they tried to use the ‘Close All’ function when having multiple items at the bazaar, whilst being too close to the gold cap, causing it to be exceeded.[/*][*]Fixed an error which caused the page to jump back to page 1 when editing the sales price of an item on page 4 or higher in the bazaar.[/*][*]Added the missing Produce (Loop) button for the following items: Half Moon Crystal, Full Moon Crystal, Red Crystal Piece, Blue Crystal Piece, White Crystal Piece, Black Crystal Piece[/*][*]The debuff resistance on the Blue Magician’s Frozen Shield is now instantaneous and not just a side-effect after 0.1 seconds.[/*][*]Fixed an error which allowed players to use some of the Avenging Angel’s skills in unexpected ways.[/*][*]Fixed a bug that caused players to not receive any rewards from the Caligor raid if he was killed by an Onyx shadow.[/*][*]Fixed a bug that caused the damage from Erenia's Deadly Blackout attack to only occur on the next attack.[/*][*]Any buffs received from a mount are now properly removed when entering Erenia/Zenas raids[/*][*]The Flame Druid can now also activate partner skills while in his human stance.[/*][/list]

Have fun!
The NosTale Team

notes.title: Update Ready to Launch!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/cbee6baf64337366ecc706fd0b0517bc35449a00.jpg[/img]

The next update is bringing two great changes to your favourite game: [b]Specialist Partner Fusion[/b] and [b]Wing Fusion[/b]!

Learn more details about what to expect below.

[h2]Specialist Partner Fusion[/h2]
To make sure your partners stay the distance and don’t wilt at the first sign of danger, we’re introducing a new system to the game in the form of the Specialist Partner Fusion. This allows you to make use of those specialist partner cards you don’t need, whilst simultaneously [b]strengthening your favourites[/b]!

Simply open the Specialist Partner Fusion menu, and drag in the partner card you want to improve and the one you want to use as a material. The only other thing required is a bit of gold, and some additional materials, depending on the current level of your card.

The fusion works best if you use the same cards, but other partner cards can be used to give your favourites a boost up to a certain level. Certain levels will however require that you use the same card for upgrading. The maximum level you can reach through Specialist Partner Fusion is [b]level 100[/b].

Fusing cards gives your specialists more HP, better defence, reduced damage from crits, and other [b]powerful bonuses[/b], depending on the level and experience of the specialist partner card you use as the material.

[h2]Wing Fusion[/h2]
Similar to the system for Mysterious Hair Dye, in the future you’ll find a new item in the NosMall – the [b]Wing Changer (Random)[/b]! This gives you a certain chance to transfer the appearance of your wings to another pair, allowing you to benefit from the powerful effects of one set of wings, while enjoying the appearance of a different set you prefer.

There’s a button on your specialist card allowing you to reset the original appearance for free, in case you ever have second thoughts about your choice. Please note that the wings newly added to the game will not be available for Wing Fusion.

notes.title: Monsters on the Rampage!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/2b21b11fcd9056f075b5ddb4f2f279d08923310e.jpg[/img]

Adventurers, travellers, heroes! Troubling news has reached us from NosVille that hordes of wild monsters are streaming across the lands. We don’t know the reason for their appearance, but everything is going to rack and ruin for the poor innocent inhabitants. 

Join forces and send these monsters back whence they came. The more maps that you liberate of monsters, the better your rewards will be. May peace return to NosVille!

[b]Event period: From 14th June (11 AM) to 22nd June (9 AM CEST)[/b]

[h2]Liberate Maps of Monsters[/h2]
A portal will open in NosVille (channel 7) leading you to five different maps absolutely swarming with monsters! 

If you’re playing on a less highly populated server, you won’t face quite so many, but on fuller servers, you’ll have even more enemies to deal with!

The more players who successfully participate, the greater the rewards for your server at the end!

[h3]Reward Event[/h3]
The reward event for your hard work will be active between 24th June (11 AM) and 27th June (11 AM CEST). It’s down to you how juicy it will be:

[b]Higher Chances of Raid Boxes[/b] 

Why open one raid box when you can open two? The chance of receiving two raid boxes is increased by 50% for all players on your server.

And for each region you’ve rid of monsters, we’ll add an extra 10% on top of that 50% boost!  However you’ll also lose 5% for every map you didn’t liberate.

[u]Example 1:[/u] If you liberate two maps on your server, you’ll enjoy a boost of 55% → basic boost of 50% + 2 x 10% for maps liberated - 3 x 5% for maps not liberated = 55%

[u]Example 2:[/u] If you don’t liberate any maps on your server, you’ll still enjoy a boost of 25% → basic boost of 50% + 0 x 10% for maps liberated - 5 x 5% for maps not liberated = 25%

Best of luck!
The NosTale Team
