notes.title: The Celestial Lair: Part 2
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/77909655889035b8314d941de97d98bae0c6361b.jpg[/img]

At the end of last year, a new adventure got underway in NosTale with the release of [b]Act 8 – The Celestial Lair[/b]. In Part 2, we’re bringing a host of cool twists and improvements to bring more variety to your favourite game. Get the lowdown on all the changes in this post!

[h3]Land of Life[/h3]
In a similar vein to the Land of Death, you can level up your hero on this map by battling against golden yet dangerous monsters with your NosTale family. Uncover hidden altars and enjoy various bonuses!

You can access the Land of Life from the capital in Act 8. The map is available around the clock, and you have around 2 hours per day for hunting monsters there.

[h3]Armour Runes[/h3]
You can now add runes to your champion level armour! These runes give you a small armour bonus (+1 to +21). The runes are similar to the ones you know from weapons: attempting to carve runes can be successful, fail, or the rune can be damaged. In contrast to weapon runes, you can only apply 3 different rune effects to your armour.

Amongst other things, you require Runic Dragon Powder for carving runes, which can be collected in all Act 8 regions, and of course in the Land of Life.

[h3]More Fun![/h3]
Thanks to our latest balancing changes, you have even more reason to upgrade your weapons. You can focus on attack strength when upgrading your weapons, and defence when upgrading your armour.

Tattoos have also been overhauled, giving you all the more reason to experiment with their various effects and buffs.

[h3]NosMall Offers[/h3]
Four amazing items are also waiting for you in the NosMall:

[b]Cellon Eraser[/b]
[list][*]Reset your accessories. This eraser removes all Cellon options from an accessory, giving you space for new ones![/*][/list]
[b]Tattoo Switch Scroll (Random)[/b]
[list][*]Try something new. This scroll gives you a new tattoo skill from your loa. If you change tattoos, the level of your previous one will be transferred to the new one.[/*][/list]
[b]Loa Switch Crystal[/b]
[list][*]Explore new possibilities. Change your tattoo loa and then get a random tattoo from the chosen loa with the same level as your previous tattoo.[/*][/list]
[b]Premium Runic Upgrade Scroll[/b]
[list][*]Even easier rune carving. This scroll not only increases your chances of success by a whopping 30%, but also increases the chance of getting a rune power by 5%. Your weapon will not be damaged when carving, and you have a 50% chance that the material used is not consumed. As if that weren’t enough, you even save half of the gold costs with every attempt![/*][/list]

Easter in NosTale is more than colourful eggs: you can look forward to two thrilling Spring raids and cute bunny costumes!

The Mad March Hare is causing headaches in NosTale! You and your friends are the only ones who can stop him!

[list][*]By defeating monsters you can pick up the Mad March Hare Raid Seal which you allows you to enter the raid.[/*][*]Enter the raid from the Chicken Farm Path and join other adventurers in combat against the Mad March Hare.[/*][*]The boss has an array of eggs in his arsenal. Then you can pick up some juicy rewards![/*][/list][h3]Reward[/h3]

Complete the additional Easter Quest and collect Cleansed and Rotten Eggs. You can exchange them for valuable items.
[h2]Chicken Queen[/h2]
The Chicken Queen is causing problems again! Defeat her in the Chicken Queen Raid and you can get a pet [b]Hell Hamster[/b] and other rewards! This hamster is devilishly ingenious, as it has two levels of development! 

By the way, in this raid you have the chance to pick up the ‘BBQ King’ title.
[h2]Easter Offers in the NosMall[/h2]
The NosMall is also decked out for Easter! The following cute Easter Costumes are available in various sets and durations for direct purchase:
[list][*]Easter Bunny Party Costume[/*][*]Easter Bunny Costume[/*][/list]
We wish you an action-packed Easter!
The NosTale Team

notes.title: Battle Pass: Winter Continues!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/a91cc13a71e16dd27e7c45055909e784aea0e1e5.jpg[/img]

You can enjoy the benefits of a battle pass right now in NosTale – now in the Winter Clearance Version, as we’ve got plenty of items tucked away for you that you might have missed!

[b]Period: From 10/03 (0:00 CET) until 20/04 (23:59 CEST).[/b]

[h3]What is the Battle Pass?[/h3]

The NosTale Battle Pass gives you lots of daily, weekly, and seasonal challenges to master, and you’ll earn Battle Points by completing them. The points you earn can then be exchanged for some amazing items. And the best part is: every player can access all the Battle Pass activities and rewards for free!

Each Battle Pass season lasts for about 6 weeks (but this isn’t a hard and fast rule). But even if you miss the first week of the current season, you’ll still have the chance to earn enough Battle Points for the final reward from the activities in the subsequent weeks. 

[b]Rewards:[/b] The Battle Pass rewards include: 4x Tarot Fortune Box, 3x Partner Skill Ticket (Single), a Mount Bead, the exclusive title ‘Snow Fairy’. which will increase your SP: Element skill points by 3, plus lots of other amazing prizes!

[h3]Don’t Miss out on Premium Rewards![/h3]

If you decide to purchase the Premium Battle Pass, you can look forward to more and higher-value rewards. This feature is perfect for those players who want to get the most from the Battle Pass activities!

For just 250 NosDollars, you can pick up the Premium Battle Pass – valid for one season. For those who don’t have much time on their hands, there’s also the Premium Battle Pass Coin in the NosMall, which you can use to skip ahead and earn yourself 50 Battle Points. The coin is available from week 3 of each season.

[b]Rewards:[/b] The premium-level rewards include such goodies as: 5x Completion Gemstone Random Box, a NosMerchant Medal (30 Days), 80x Perfume, a golden Specialist Card Holder, the exclusive Mini Snowball pet, and many more high-quality prizes! Mini Snowball has a 7% chance to apply the Freeze debuff when it attacks, and will support you with the Docile Mini Snowball’s Blessing buff that increases all your attacks by 10% and reduces all used skill cooldowns by 10%.

Have fun!
The NosTale Team

notes.title: Server Merge
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/b42ce0597b0f8ac8d0971a8cb9acb09bba46f464.jpg[/img]

Dear players,

Your enjoyment playing NosTale is at the heart of everything we do. That’s why we’ve decided to merge some language servers together.

If you have any burning questions, we’ve done our best to answer them in the Merge FAQ below.

[b]We’ve merged the following servers together:[/b]
[list][*]EN1 UK–NosCitadel + ES1 Infinity + PL1 Feniks + IT1 Flare = EU-Dragonveil[/*][*]FR1 Cosmos + FR2 Galaxie = Cosmos[/*][/list]
No changes have been made to any servers not mentioned.

[h2]Server Merge FAQ[/h2]

[h3]How did you decide which servers to merge together?[/h3]
We conducted extensive analysis of the servers and are merging them in such a way that we can ensure a balanced population and balanced activity levels on all servers after the merge.

[h3]What languages can I use on the Dragonveil server, and what language will Support use?[/h3]
You can keep using the languages you want to use on the entire Dragonveil server. And Support will still be available to help you in the languages you are used to. The only change is that from now on you’ll be on a server with lots of other languages being spoken at once.

[h3]What happens if I have characters on multiple servers which are being transferred onto the same one?[/h3]
You have a total of four available character slots. If you have more characters than that, the four highest-ranking characters will be transferred to the target server. But! You won’t lose the remaining characters. They’ll just be deactivated. On the website you’ll be able to activate/deactivate your characters as you wish. Please note that you only have 1 active slot for Martial Artists. Here are the various situations which can arise, and how they will be resolved (the ‘original’ classes mentioned here refer to Swordsman, Archer, and Mage):
[list][*][b]Situation 1[/b]: Three original classes and no Martial Artists
Three slots will be occupied by your original class characters, and the fourth slot remains empty until you create another character.[*][b]Situation 2[/b]: Four original class characters and no Martial Artists
All four slots will be occupied by your characters.[*][b]Situation 3[/b]: More than three original class characters and no Martial Artists
If you don’t have any Martial Artists, all four slots will be occupied by your highest-ranking characters. Your remaining characters will be deactivated but can be reactivated via the website.[*][b]Situation 4[/b]: More than four original class characters and at least one Martial Artist
Three slots will be occupied by your highest-ranking original class characters. The fourth will be occupied by your highest-ranking Martial Artist. Your remaining characters will be deactivated but can be reactivated via the website.[*][b]Situation 5[/b]: Less than three original class characters and at least one Martial Artist
The slots will be occupied by your original class characters, the remaining slots will remain empty until you create more original class characters. The fourth will be occupied by your highest-ranking Martial Artist. Your remaining Martial Artists will be deactivated but can be reactivated via the website.[/list]

[h3]How do I activate/deactivate my characters?[/h3]
Follow these simple steps to activate/deactivate a character:
[list][*]Open the Gameforge Client and select NosTale.[/*][*]Click on Settings to open your account settings. This will take you to the relevant NosTale webpage where you can check your character list.[/*][*]If you have more than four characters and would like to play with one of your deactivated characters, select an active character and click on the character you’d like to play with. This will swap the two characters.[/*][*]Please note that you only have 1 active slot for Martial Artists. You can change your active characters on the website at any time.[/*][/list]

[h3]What’s happening to families?[/h3]
Active families will be transferred to the appropriate target server. Note that families whose members have been inactive for the last 180 days, or families with fewer than 4 members and a family level below 4 will be deleted.

[h3]What’s happening to the family warehouse?[/h3]
Items from the family warehouse will be sent to the Family Head by parcel. 

[h3]What if two or more characters have the same name?[/h3]
The first criterion for choosing who keeps the name is whichever character was online in the last 90 days. The others will be renamed.If multiple characters were online in the last 90 days, then the character which is (at least) 10 levels higher than the others keeps the name.Should there be a tie even after taking both of these criteria into account, then the older character (according to creation date) will keep their name.If you want to rename an automatically renamed character, select the character after the merge and a window will pop up that allows you to change it.

[h3]What happens when two or more families have the same name?[/h3]
If multiple families have the same name on the target server, the older family will keep the name. Newer families are automatically renamed as follows: ‘merge_number’. Please contact the [url=https://nostale.support.gameforge.com/index.php?fld=en]Support team[/url]  to change the family name manually.

[h3]What if I have more than 1,000,000,000 Gold after the merge?[/h3]
As is standard, the merged servers limit the amount of Gold you can have to 1,000,000,000. If you are over this limit before the merge, you will be capped at this maximum once you are moved to the new server. If you lose Gold because of the merge, please contact our [url=https://nostale.support.gameforge.com/index.php?fld=en]Support team[/url].

[h3]What happens to items in the warehouse?[/h3]
Your items in the warehouse will be sent by parcel to your highest-level character.

[h3]What happens to items in the NosMall which aren’t claimed?[/h3]
Any unclaimed items in the NosMall will be sent by parcel to your highest-level active character. 

[h3]What happens to active auctions in the NosBazaar?[/h3]
All active offers in the NosBazaar will be cancelled before the merge and then sent to the respective characters by parcel.

[h3]What happens to friend lists and spouses?[/h3]
As far as possible, friend lists and spouses will be merged on the target servers.

[h3]Will the rankings be reset?[/h3]
No, all player ranks on the target servers will be newly calculated and adjusted.

[h3]What happens to the blacklist?[/h3]
The blacklist will be deleted during the merge.

[h3]My character/account is deleted. Will the data be transferred anyway?[/h3]
Yes, even deleted characters/accounts will be transferred. It will still be possible to restore your data if you want to after the merge. 

[h3]Do I have to delete or select the characters I want to be activated on the new server before the server merge?[/h3]
No, your characters will be activated automatically.

[h3]What happens to my Gold and the items in my inventory?[/h3]
Both your Gold and the items in your inventory will be transferred to the target server.

[h3]Do I need to reinstall the game after the server merge?[/h3]
No, you can launch the game just the same as before.

[h3]Will my login details get changed by the merge?[/h3]
No, you can log in as usual with your credentials. If you have more than 4 characters in total, the four highest-ranking characters will be transferred to the target server. But! You won’t lose the remaining characters. They’ll just be deactivated. On the website you’ll be able to activate/deactivate your characters as you wish. 

If you have any further questions, our [url=https://nostale.support.gameforge.com/index.php?fld=en]Support team[/url]  will be happy to help. 

Have fun on the new servers!
The NosTale Team

Do you want to chill out, but can’t stomach spending another night on the couch? We’ve got just the thing to brighten up your day, with not one, not two, but [b]three fantastic events[/b] in store! Shoot the breeze while fishing, cook up a tasty treat and wind out the day with a fantastic raid. You’ll not only feel more relaxed, but earn [b]extra EXP and raid boxes[/b] while doing it!

[b]Event Period:[/b] 25th February (11 AM) to 28th February (11 AM CET).

[h3]Out of the River, Into the Frying Pan[/h3]
If you need to switch off and take a breather from bashing monsters, we’ve got just the thing. Haul in a fresh fish, fry it up and get all the juicy goodness from this event! Don’t miss your chance to get [b]50% more experience[/b] when fishing and cooking. Go grab your rod and throw that fish straight into the frying pan!

[h3]How it works:[/h3][list][*]Each time you carry out a cooking or fishing activity, you’ll earn additional experience.[/*][*]The experience you earn depends on the rarity of the fish you catch or meal you cook.[/*][*]Each fish caught or meal successfully cooked earns 50% more experience.[/*][/list]

If getting stuck into the thick of the action is more your style, you can also benefit in raids, with a 50% higher chance to pick up [b]two raid boxes[/b] instead of one! All raids in NosTale enjoy this benefit.

Slip on your armour, grab your weapon, call your NosMates and charge into the fray to make sure don’t miss out on any great and rare rewards. Leave the mundane behind you!

Have fun!
The NosTale Team

notes.title: Community Update 1/22
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/e3648aefa3a44482ada06d3f3d040c565b0a52ff.jpg[/img]

Hello NosPlayers!

As some of you may have noticed... it’s the start of a new year! And of course that means it’s time for another community update.

As the last update was around half a year ago now, here is a short explanation of what community updates are. For a while now, at the start and middle of the year, we send out a little note summarising any updates, changes, and ideas we’re considering for the months thereafter. 

Of course, nothing is set in stone, and sometimes plans are pushed back or forward. But this just gives you a good overview of what you can look forward to. The plans discussed in today’s update will cover the first half of 2022 (in no particular order). We’re looking forward to another wonderful year with you all!

Of course, the biggest point on the list is the second half of the Act 8 Update. As the main feature of 8.2., our plan is to introduce a champion level equivalent to the Land of Death, something that’s been requested for a while now. We also want to make some significant changes to runes and tattoos. As well as introducing new stuff (why exactly do runes only work on weapons?), we will also have to take a piercing gaze at a few things needing nerfs.

Another greatly awaited topic that we will be turning our minds to now the new year has started is merging more servers. The whos, whats and wherefores regarding this merge will all be made clear in separate news posts. For the moment, we just want you to know that we see and hear the calls for merges loud and clear, and are making preparations.

But servers aren’t the only things that will see some merging in the next 6 months! We’re currently in discussions with Entwell about a possible merge system for partners and wings: two areas that we know are very much hoped for by the community.

And of course we have to mention the hotly discussed balance patches, as they are absolutely still on the cards. The next pair we have planned are for Seers and Berserkers. We’re diligently pottering about making plenty of improvements.

Besides all of that, you can also look forward to another season of the battle pass, as well as all the usual seasonal events, and some fantastic new items (such as a pair of wings based on the winner of our last fan art competition).

As you can see, we’ve got plenty of things in the works. Let us know what you think of our ideas! We love to hear your opinions. You’ll be hearing from us in at most 6 months with another community update for you.

Wishing you the best possible start to your new year,
The NosTale Team

notes.title: Winter Events in NosTale
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/499b1ac9d9c6d7efc71a3866c108caaa673d4d76.jpg[/img]

Silent night, holy night… not in NosTale: This Christmas will be a scream, with plenty of awesome events, amazing loot, great offers, and seasonal surprises!

[b]There’s plenty to look forward to between 13/12/2021 and 12/1/2022:[/b]

[h3]Holiday Offers in the NosMall[/h3]
This year there are plenty of wintery items waiting for you in the NosMall – open the doors in our advent calendar and find out what’s inside!

During the holidays the Jewel Shop is closed. But don’t worry, from 15th to 29th December 2021, the NosTale Christmas Market will be open and you can get all sorts of things there, like Christmas costumes and pretty decorations for your Miniland.

[h3]Magic Sleigh with Red-Nosed Reindeer[/h3]

The NPC Santa Claus has something very special in store for you. In exchange for a Red-nosed Reindeer Bead (available from quests and the Winter Event raids listed below) and a sleigh, Santa Claus will build a super-fast Magic Sleigh with Red-Nosed Reindeer for you.

[h3]Specialist Partners[/h3]

Use Maru’s Specialist Partner Card to transform partners that use melee attacks into the Millennial Tiger. Use the second Specialist Partner Card, Maru in Mother’s Fur, to transform partners that use melee attacks into a tiger disguised as a caring mother of siblings. As a tiger, each partner has three razor-sharp skills: Hi-yah!, Spin Up, and Tiger Power

[h3]Raid Against Maru the Millennial Tiger[/h3]

Challenge Maru and his followers in the raid! Just use Maru’s Raid Seal to take him on. If you beat the raid, you’ll be rewarded with his special Tiger Chest, which might contain the ‘Doppelgänger’ title as well as the Obsidian of Completion.

Note: You can neither make yourself invisible, nor summon miniatures as Jajamaru in this raid.

[h3]Snowman Raid[/h3]

Take revenge on the snow monster for the Vikings – grab your friends and bring the heat to the wicked snowman! You’ll get a raid box as a reward. You’ll find awesome specialist partner cards, the ‘Sleepy Head’ title and other wintry event items inside.

[h3]Daily Quests[/h3]

You’ll be able to play the following dailies during the event:
[list][*]Searching for the Siblings’ Mother[/*][*]Save the Siblings[/*][*]Need Sesame Oil[/*][/list]
You can earn Maru’s Raid Seal and Brass Coins as a reward when you complete these daily quests.

[b]Daily Quests from Six NPCs in NosVille[/b]

You’ll meet good and evil reindeer, let the bells ring out, watch how scarves are made from magical wool and knitting needles, and much more. Complete quests to collect colourful stockings and then exchange them for a Christmas Gift Box.

[h3]Event Quest[/h3]

Pay a visit to the Wanderer to exchange Brass Coins for the Wanderer’s Chest and grab yourself some great items.

[h3]Red Bean Rice Cakes and Sesame Oil[/h3]

Collect Red Bean Rice Cakes and Sesame Oil by hunting monsters. Exchange the items for a reward or use them yourself. The cakes restore your and your NosMate’s HP and MP, and the Sesame Oil is useful in raids.

[h3]Happy New Year… Literally![/h3]

Collect golden letters (H, A, P, Y) and white letters (N, E, W, Y, A, R) that are dropped by monsters. Once you have enough to spell the words HAPPY NEW YEAR, you can exchange them for a Happy New Year Box and/or a Happy New Year Golden Box. If you’re lucky, you’ll find a Movement Scroll, fancy costumes, or a variety of fireworks inside.

Wishing you a wonderful Winter Event!
The NosTale Team

notes.title: Act 8 – The Celestial Lair
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/9da43444f9773e07d90b56398fb7ad30f0cb4b12.jpg[/img]

The time has come – a new adventure has begun! [b]Act 8 – The Celestial Lair[/b] breathes new life into NosTale. Get ready for extra maps, raids, time-spaces, new equipment, an expanded specialist system and much more! And of course you’ll also find out what happens next in the NosTale story.

[h3]The Story[/h3]

The story continues as you meet Ain, the ingenious inventor. Her people live on a floating archipelago that has recently come under attack. To rescue them, you must take on the Dragov – a group of radical Draconians who worship dragons as if they were gods. You will encounter ruthless opponents like zombie dragon Valehir, ice dragon Alzanor and their leader, Dragon Lord Asgobas!

Play through new quests – including 8 new time-spaces, multiple dungeons and a host of side stories and daily quests.

[h3]Two New Raids[/h3]

Both new raids feature two lobby maps where you’ll complete various tasks. A new token system also provides you with rare raid rewards which you can trade.

[h3]Asgobas’ Invasion[/h3]

In these action-packed instant combats, you must defend the floating islands against the marauding dragons. You will be richly rewarded if you return from these battles as the conquering hero!

[h3]Specialist System Expanded[/h3]

Upgrade your specialist to level 20 with immediate effect to earn a shot at unlocking a special attack with extra effects. You can also increase their specialist points to a maximum of 120, depending on the level. This update also boosts the chances of reaching level 15, so specialist novices can enjoy the benefits of the system expansion too!

[h3]New Equipment[/h3]

There’s a fine line between winning and losing, and having the right equipment makes all the difference. In Act 8 you can pick up some new equipment to propel you to your chosen champion level. You can also get your hands on some powerful equipment if you are already playing the endgame. Take the opportunity to grab some new accessories, hats, and resistances that you can rely on as you fight your way through NosTale’s raids!

Enjoy the new content!
The NosTale Team

notes.title: Ghoulishly Grandiose Events in NosTale!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/427337f349d886aa68fe57c05a71ba4afeca4ed4.jpg[/img]

[i]Tiny spideys are creeping in, more and more of them.
‘Where could they all be coming from?’ you ask aghast.
You answer the door, and find a cheeky pumpkin grinning back.
What’s this gloomy mood that has overcome you?
You check your calendar and see the date.
It’s the end of October. Time to celebrate: Halloween![/i]

Get ready: [b]from 27/10 to 10/11[/b] NosVille and Port Alveus will be decked out in eerie Halloween decorations and the mad Professor Macavity, Foxy and Jack O’Lantern will be causing all sorts of creepy mayhem in NosTale! An additional quest, a Halloween costume and a title with powerful effects are also waiting for you!

[h3]Your new creepy costume[/h3]
Give friends and enemies a good scare: during the event period, [b]the Plague Doctor/Nurse Costume[/b] will be available in the NosMall.

When you use an attack skill while wearing this eerie outfit, you have an 8% probability of receiving a 10-second healing effect which restores your HP by 5% of the damage dealt (maximum of 1,500 HP per skill). You also benefit from a 20% increase in champion experience and an additional +1 movement speed.

[h3]The Cursed 13[/h3]
Talk to Mary in NosVille to start the quest and earn yourself a new title by successfully completing all three Halloween raids 13 times! The ‘Monstrous’ title gives you a 2% chance of triggering ‘Horror’ when you attack.

[h3]Titles with powerful effects[/h3]
In reward for each of the three Halloween raids there is one of these titles in the raid box:
[list][*]Test Subject: Increases resistance to Bleeding by 1%.[/*][*]Sly Dog: Increases max. MP by 300.[/*][*]Horror: Deals greater damage to low-level undead monsters by 3%.[/*][/list]
[h3]Mad Professor Macavity[/h3]
The mad genius feline is back! Rally 7 players around you and start the raid. Two of the eight players will be transformed into Professor Macavity and the Test Subject. Let the hunt begin!
[b]Full details on the raid:[/b]
[list][*]Mad Professor Macavity’s Raid Seal drops in Foxy and Jack O’Lantern’s raids.[/*][*]The raid can only be attempted 5 times per day. There are however reset tickets.[/*][*]Exactly 8 players are needed to start the raid.[/*][*]Players who want to play must bring a pet.[/*][*]Professor Macavity can drag the Test Subject to him. Both need to work together to capture enemies.[/*][*]Only the hunted players can open boxes during the raid and receive handy items for the chase.[/*][*]Hunters can freeze opponents for a short time. [/*][*]Before hunted players can leave the raid, they must find a key in one of the boxes.[/*][*]The hunters must prevent the hunted from leaving the raid. For each player caught, the hunters earn a raid box. Caught players leave the raid without a box.[/*][*]If a hunted player leaves the raid successfully, they earn a raid box.[/*][*]White Witch Laurena’s Wand appears if the hunted player with the wand is caught.[/*][/list]
[h3]Foxy and Her Brood[/h3]
Challenge Foxy and her sneaky brood in the raid! Use Foxy’s Raid Seal to confront her. If you’re successful, you’ll earn her Wonder Chest in reward. With a little luck it might contain Foxy’s Specialist Partner Card!Foxy is a raid boss with super skills, as well as being a new partner. Tame her and she’ll be your loyal companion forever!

The raid seals can be picked up in daily quests. Plus you can earn more rewards by collecting flasks.

[h3]Jack O’Lantern and His Minions[/h3]
Defeat the evil pumpkin Jack O’Lantern in the raid! He’s supported by his Pumpkin Bushi and Pumpkin Bomb minions. In reward for victory, you can claim a Halloween raid box.Amongst others you can pick up a Glowing Pumpkin Hat and creepy Tarot Cards from the raid box in this event.

[h3]Daily quests from NosVille NPCs[/h3]
Talk to Eric, Eva Energy, Malcolm Mix and Teoman Topp and pick up handy items in the Trick or Treat Quests! For example, you can get Yellow and Black Pumpkin Sweets, the Halloween Blessing, a Glowing Pumpkin Hat or a Halloween Costume Scroll. Playing the quests will also get you Bags of Sweets which can be exchanged for Jack O’Lantern’s raid seal.
[list][*]Defeating monsters causes them to drop goodies like Yellow and Black Pumpkin Sweets. You can either gobble them down, or exchange them for a Halloween Costume Scroll or a raid seal for Jack O’Lantern.[/*][*]Don your new Glowing Pumpkin Hat! You’ll be sure to set a new trend in the village! You can get the deadly smart headgear from the Halloween Horror Box or the raid box.[/*][*]Halloween Costume Scroll: Transform into 10 different creepy critters which you know from the game. The new costume gives you 4x attack power and 2x defence power.[/*][/list]
Wishing you tons of spooky fun,
The NosTale Team

notes.title: RSVP: We’re Celebrating NosTale’s 14th Anniversary!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/61edc97cbf301b5864fd5e95df1f96fed864ea23.jpg[/img]

NosTale’s turning 14! That’s a milestone which deserves celebrating, so consider this your invitation. On top of the 14 gift boxes you’ve been able to pick up from 5th October, this year’s NosTale party has a [b]special quest, fantastic events and a mount with a spring in its step[/b]!
[h3]Free Kangaroo Mount![/h3]
Here’s your chance to pick up a bouncy [b]14th Anniversary Kangaroo[/b]! Simply collect it for free from the NosMall from Monday 18th onwards. If you prefer a mount that packs a punch, then pick up a Boxer Kangaroo Random Box which may contain a [b]14th Anniversary Boxer Kangaroo[/b]. If you don’t manage to find this antipodean pugilist after purchasing 30 boxes, you’ll get the exclusive mount together with the 30th box guaranteed.
[h3]The Great Collectors’ Event[/h3]

notes.title: Arm Yourself with the Battle Pass!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/4c157cdbed30bfa05d165973f3a94bf8338da317.jpg[/img]

It’s finally here – you can soon take advantage of the cool benefits from NosTale’s brand-new Battle Pass! Find out all the details about your favourite game’s newest feature in this post.

[h3]What Is the Battle Pass?[/h3]
The NosTale Battle Pass gives you lots of daily, weekly and seasonal challenges to master and earn Battle Points for completing. The points you earn can then be exchanged for amazing items. And everyone can benefit: all Battle Pass activities and rewards are free for all players!

Each Battle Pass season will last around 6 weeks (with possible variations). But even if you miss the first week of the current season, you still have the chance to earn enough Battle Points for the final reward from the subsequent activities. 

[b]Rewards:[/b] Battle Pass rewards include a wide variety of cool items, including the NosMerchant Medal (7 Days), Equipment Protection Scroll, a new exclusive title, 10x Perfume and more!

[h3]Don’t Miss the Premium Rewards![/h3]
If you decide to purchase the Premium Battle Pass, you can even look forward to additional higher-value rewards. This feature is perfect for those players who want to get the most from the Battle Pass activities!

For just 250 NosDollars, you can pick up the Premium Battle Pass which is valid for one season. For those without much time to burn, we also offer the Premium Battle Pass Coin in the NosMall, with which you can skip ahead and get yourself 50 Battle Points. The coin is available each season from week 3.

[b]Rewards:[/b] Among the premium-level rewards, you can find such goodies as the NosMerchant Medal (30 Days), 2x Golden Equipment Protection Scroll, 30x Perfume, the exclusive Tame Queen Bee pet and many more high-quality prizes!

notes.title: New International Server
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/71092fd237b9809edd4293faabbeb23e95b6ddc4.jpg[/img]

Dear player,

We hope you’re ready for a new place to run around in and even more action: NosTale will have a new international server soon!

But it’s not just a new server. Oh no – it will have exciting event raid challenges that will be worth your while to master. More details will be provided before the server start!

The new international server won’t have any language region restrictions. That means you can make an exciting new start, and experience everything in your own language, thanks to the multi-language client.

In case you haven’t heard about our multi-language client yet, here are some FAQs that will explain everything you need to know:

[h2]International Server FAQ[/h2]
[h3]What language will the new server support?[/h3]
Everyone playing on the international server will have the ability to play in their own language. Players who aren’t interested in seeing a mix of languages will still be able to play on their regional non-multilingual servers. Nevertheless, we’ll be keeping an eye on things, and may choose to establish a chat language at a later date.

[h3]What language will ticket support be in?[/h3]
The international server’s ticket support will only be available in English.

[h3]Where can I go to discuss server-related things?[/h3]
We’ll have separate channels for the new server on our Discord. And, if there’s demand for it, we’ll also consider opening an extra category on the forum.

[h3]Are you planning anything special for the server launch?[/h3]
As mentioned above, we’re planning to have event raid challenges on the new international server. In addition, the server will receive several boost events for one month. We’ll release more details on challenges and boosts over the next few days.

notes.title: Four Brand New Specialists
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/7278e4965e775e2cb26fc5a5f2748e3ed0dfbde6.jpg[/img]

Our newest update is coming – and with it comes a whole host of exciting content. Look forward to four brand new specialist cards, a thrilling quest series and a challenging raid! Read on to find out everything you need to know.
[h1]Spirit Forest Raid[/h1]
Rally your fellow fighters and head to the Spirit Forest to talk to Datitus in order to start this new daily raid quest. 

A barrage of nasty monsters will be waiting in the wings to trip up you and your friends in each of the three raid areas, and you’ll find the boss Revenant Paimon waiting for you at the end. Be warned: He has three shadow clones of the new specialists at his side. Defeat them to win their support for your battle against Paimon!

The raid is open for up to 15 players (champion levels 10–60) and there are, of course, lots of valuable rewards up for grabs in addition to a punishing challenge.
[h1]The Ancient Orc Heroes[/h1]
Use the Time-Space Stone to travel back into the past and discover how the Ancient Orc Heroes managed to put a stop to the demon Paimon. Learn more about the backgrounds of the new specialists along the way, and discover their secret.
[h1]New Specialist Cards[/h1]
Fight as a [b]Flame Druid[/b] with the power of the fire element, a [b]Waterfall Berserker[/b] with a terrifying axe, a [b]Sunchaser[/b] side by side with your Sun Wolf, or as a [b]Voodoo Priest[/b] to inflict debilitating curses on your enemies.
[h2]The Flame Druid[/h2]
[i]‘With the power of the Bear Loa, I will incinerate evil!’[/i]

The new Flame Druid specialist card turns a Martial Artist into a powerful fire element druid who can transform into a bear or leopard. As a bear, the Flame Druid has bear-strength skills at their disposal; as a leopard, they won’t be able to attack but will move with the speed of a big wild cat!
[h3]Flame Druid Skill Highlights[/h3][list][*]
[b]Purifying Flames[/b]: The purifying flames burn away all your debuffs and make you highly resistant to enemy debuffs.
[list][*]Removes all debuffs up to level 4.[/*][*]You’ll have a chance of resisting debuffs for a certain amount of time, based on the number of buffs you have (up to 30%).[/*][/list][/*][*]
[b]Absorbing Flames[/b]: A hot flame burns away all attacks.
[list][*]Doesn’t consume HP.[/*][*]It provides a 50% chance of triggering Fatal Burn.[/*][/list][/*][*]
[b]Emberpunch[/b]: You deal a hefty uppercut with the flame energy crackling in your front legs.
[list][*]There is a 100% chance of triggering Third-Degree Burns. The skill cooldown time is increased by 50%.[/*][*]It provides a 100% chance of triggering Blackout.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[h2]The Waterfall Berserker[/h2]
[i]‘Not even the coldest waterfall can cool my temper!’[/i]

The Waterfall Berserker specialist card turns a Swordsman into a hardened warrior of the water element, wielding a fearsome axe and unleashing unlimited fury in battle. The Waterfall Berserker is not someone you’d want to have as an enemy, that’s for sure!
[h3]Waterfall Berserker Skill Highlights[/h3][list][*]
[b]Clear Water:[/b] Heals you based on how much HP you’ve lost, and simultaneously increases your defence and elemental stats.
[list][*]Restores 20% of lost HP.[/*][*]Increases your defence by 15%.[/*][*]Increases water element equivalent to the player’s level x4.[/*][/list][/*][*]
[b]Under the Waterfall[/b]: The energy of the waterfall renders you immune to damage, and protects you from debuffs when enemies try to inflict damage on you.
[list][*]Doesn’t consume HP.[/*][*]Removes 1 debuff (up to level 4) each time you’re hit.[/*][*]Provides a 40% chance of inflicting Serious Injury on an opponent. There’s a certain chance of the attacker’s skill cooldown time being reset when they attack.[/*][/list][/*][*]
[b]Raging Waterfall[/b]: You jump into the air and beat your axes into the ground, inflicting damage to enemies over a large radius.
[list][*]Reduces your opponent’s movement speed by 3.[/*][*]Increases the damage of all water element attacks by 20%.[/*][*]After the buff wears off, there’s a 100% chance of causing Serious Injury.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[h2]The Sunchaser[/h2]
[i]‘No one can hide from the sun!’[/i]

The Sunchaser specialist card enables Archers to assert themselves as hunters of the light element, who are always accompanied by a wolf. The Sun Wolf takes on its master’s level, has 5 of its own skills and can be revived. Your opponents had better not let themselves be dazzled by their refined appearance. Sunchasers fights with lethal precision!
[h3]Sunchaser Skill Highlights[/h3][list][*]
[b]Solar Shower[/b]: Numerous blazing spears fall from the sky and attack your opponent.
[list][*]Provides a 20% chance of triggering Blinding Light: [/*][*]Reduces evasion by 50%.[/*][*]Reveals vulnerabilities when the Sun Wolf attacks. Increases long-range damage and critical hit rate by 10%.[/*][/list][/*][*]
[b]Solar Eruption[/b]: Teleports your glowing Sun Wolf to the target, where it attacks and blinds them.
[list][*]Teleports to the target at a range of 9 spaces.[/*][*]Pounces on opponents and causes AoE damage.[/*][*]It provides an 80% chance of triggering Blackout.[/*][/list][/*][*]
[b]Light Net[/b]: When thrown, the spear turns into a light net which traps your enemy.
[list][*]Renders enemies unable to move.[/*][*]When the Sun Wolf attacks, your damage increases by 50%.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[h2]The Voodoo Priest[/h2] 
[i]‘When you die, your soul belongs to me!’[/i]

With the new Voodoo Priest specialist card, Mages become shadow element priests who use curses to drive pain and fear into their enemies’ midst. Voodoo Priests can inflict several powerful debuffs onto multiple enemies simultaneously, and they have absolutely no reservations about putting these devastating curses to use! 
[h3]Voodoo Priest Skill Highlights[/h3][list][*]
[b]Soulwalk[/b]: You transform into a soul for a short time, becoming immune to damage and nullifying debuffs.
[list][*]Removes all debuffs up to buff level 4[/*][*]Restores HP equivalent to the player’s level x10 every 2 seconds.[/*][*]Cannot attack.[/*][*]Doesn’t consume HP.[/*][*]You become invisible.[/*][/list][/*][*]
[b]Locust Swarm[/b]: You summon a swarm of greedy locusts who inflict damage on opponents across a large area while you regenerate HP.
[list][*]Restores HP equivalent to the player’s level x15.[/*][*]It provides a 25% chance of triggering Voodoo Priest Curse: Increases the efficiency of buffs which degrade HP and inflict damage over time by 15% per debuff.[/*][/list][/*][*]
[b]Deathly Curse[/b]: You absorb your target’s soul energy and increase your power.
[list][*]Only causes damage if the enemy is suffering from at least one debuff.[/*][*]The damage increases proportional to the number of debuffs active on your enemies.[/*][*]There is a 100% chance that the buff of the same name (Deathly Curse) will be triggered:[/*][list][*]You lose HP equivalent to the player’s level x6 every 2 seconds.[/*][*]Increases the damage of all shadow element attacks by 20%.[/*][/list][/list]
[/*][/list]

Enjoy the new content!
The NosTale Team

notes.title: Community Update - Summer 2021
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/e3648aefa3a44482ada06d3f3d040c565b0a52ff.jpg[/img]

Hello NosPlayers!

The second quarter of the year will end soon, and so it’s time for another community update.

In the last months, we were able to complete a number of our long-awaited projects and successfully merged databases and servers on an international level for the first time as well as launching new ones (any rumours about a 30-hour maintenance are wholly unfounded).
And after 13½ years, we’ve also finally learned how to cook, thereby displacing the conventional frozen pizza from the broader food meta.

But there are obviously two very specific projects you wanted to know about!
We all know what this is really about anyway, so we’ll set aside the annual outlook for the second half and get straight down to the nitty-gritty: SP9 and balancing – when’s it happening already?!

Entwell is currently concentrating entirely on the new Specialist Card and will likely present us with a first version before the end of June. However, we want to leave ourselves enough time to make any necessary changes to ensure you’ll be satisfied not only with the cards themselves but also everything to do with them. Based on this, we’re currently planning the release of SP9 for mid to late July. Of course, we’ll be dropping a few hints for you here or there in advance – the archer, for example, will be very spear-cial.

Balancing! We informed you in our last update that we’re preparing a test server so we can upload large balancing changes without putting the live environment at risk.
This project has since encountered a number of hurdles which make it impossible for us to implement it in a way we think it makes sense. While we will continue to pursue how to implement these servers in the background, you’ll still want to see changes, of course. 
And we’ll get them to you! – even if not all at once.

As we still do not want to take the risk of a single massive balancing update, we will roll out adjustments for individual specialists between content updates as often as possible.
We’ll start with the Death Reaper and Destroyer next week, followed up in the next round by the Fire Cannoneer and Tide Lords and Ladies.

Please let us know what you think about the changes. It won’t only help us in the following weeks, but also with any potential readjustments.

With these two topics out of the way, what else is planned for the rest of the year? At the moment, we’re totally focused on what we mentioned above, but here’s a little preview for you anyway!

As you can already see, we’re experimenting with a new type of event. This concerns a feature that we would like to expand to eventually provide daily, weekly and even seasonal quests and activities.

And of course we can’t leave out the new items in the form of costumes, pets, wings and more. Plus we’d like to make further adjustments to the EXP system, but we’ll talk more about that at a later date.

And finally, in case that wasn’t enough already, there miiight still be another large update hiding around the corner come the end of the year. It’s too early to clearly tell if and when or what that may be – for the moment, we can rest assured knowing there’ll be plenty more to talk about in our next, wonderful community update.

We’ll let that be all for now.

The exact changes to the Death Reaper and Destroyer will be announced separately in the coming days. Until then, we encourage you to keep an eye out for more SP9 teasers. 

We look forward to another, stupendous half year with you!
[i]With a 60-Hour Maintenance![/i]

The NosTale Team

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/2e78edb22e501362c664d41b7292a436a6421107.jpg[/img]


Mysterious Sealed Vessels are circulating around the world of NosTale. Surrounded by a magical aura, only [b]parties of experienced adventurers[/b]  should dare open them, as these otherwise unremarkable vessels contain the most wicked of creatures, banished by wise mages. The brave – or the foolish – who nevertheless rise to the challenge to liberate and defeat the evil creature inside one of these Sealed Vessels have a chance of being rewarded with a treasure chest. These contain fantastic items from the NosMall! With a pinch of good fortune, the monsters may even drop a Death Lancer Set, Ice Witch Costume Set, Fire Devil Set or the exclusive ‘Liberator’ title which grants you +5% damage against monsters from Sealed Vessels.

[list][*]Pick up a Sealed Vessel from the NosMall, NosWheel or NosBazaar.[/*][*]Rally your friends/family together and steel yourselves for a tough fight.[/*][*]Open the Sealed Vessel summoning one of 20 monsters.[/*][*]The higher the monster’s level, the greater the chance of collecting a treasure chest.[/*][/list]

[list][*]The Sealed Vessels can be opened on any map, with the exceptions of those detailed below.[/*][*]Sealed Vessels cannot be opened in the capitals (NosVille, Port Alveus, Sunset Cliff).[/*][*]Only 11 Sealed Vessels can be active simultaneously on the following maps: NosVille Meadows, Mine Plains, Sunny Meadows, Fernon Outpost, Western Mine (all maps), Northern Mine (all maps), Fernon Temple (all maps) and Fernon’s Hideout (all maps).[/*][/list]
In addition to the treasure chest, the following items may drop after defeating the monster:
[list][*]1x Death Lancer Set[/*][*]1x Liberator (Title)[/*][*]2x Wings of Friendship[/*][*]1x Tarot Card Game[/*][*]5x Fairy Experience Potion[/*][*]20x Perfume[/*][*]20x Huge Recovery Potion[/*][*]10x Cylloan Spring Water[/*][*]40x Seed of Power[/*][*]10x Guardian Angel’s Blessing[/*][*]1x Special Pet Food[/*][*]1x Guardian Lucifer’s Specialist Partner Card[/*][*]1x Fire Devil Set[/*][*]1x Small Ice Witch [/*][*]1x Ice Witch Costume Set [/*][*]1x Ice Witch Costume Wings (Permanent) [/*][*]1x Death Lancer [/*][*]1x Death Lancer Murderwings (Permanent)[/*][*]1x Fire Devil Costume Wings (Permanent) [/*][*]1x Mini Fire Devil[/*][/list]
Enjoy the monster hunt!

notes.title: Coming Soon: The Chef Specialist Card
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/771fcb820e4363ff626d19ee669f8911fc76c990.jpg[/img]

The brand-new [b]Chef[/b] specialist card transforms you into a culinary mastermind who knows who to put together delicious meals for the most refined tastes! 

The amazing dishes your present aren’t only mouth-watering, but also provide unexpected power to the people who consume them. Give the Chef a [u]taster[/u] soon!
[h3]Become a Masterchef[/h3]
As a Chef, you first need to gather your materials, buy your spices, chop your ingredients, before you can set about cooking them. You’ll need certain skills for the various recipes which each have different preparation times.

In reward for your efforts, you can look forward to various titles to perfect your cooking skills with handy buffs. For especially tasty morsels you also stand a chance of picking up additional items.
[h3]À la carte[/h3]
When preparing your recipes, there are certain things you have to watch out for to make sure you pull them off:
[olist][*]Some of the ingredients you collect cannot be cooked directly. You’ll need to chop them up with you skills first, either individually or multiple ingredients at once.[/*][*]Use recipes to prepare your chopped ingredients.[/*][*]Choose from three cooking methods: roast, simmer or stir fry.[/*][*]What you produce depends on your timing. Wait for the right moment to ‘Finish Cooking’. Keep your eyes on the dark steam rising from your meal to tell you it’s ready. If you finish too soon or too late, the meal will be ruined.[/*][*]Successfully cooking several meals will earn you cooking XP, a new higher-quality recipe, and you have a chance to get a Fortune Cake. Eat the Fortune Cake and you might get some handy items.[/*][*]If you mess up your cooking, you won’t receive these rewards.[/*][/olist]
[h3]Cooking Skills[/h3]
These are the skills at your disposal as a Chef:
[list][*][b]Basic Attack[/b]: You attack with your wok.[/*][*][b]Cooking Preparation[/b]: You prepare everything you need for cooking. → Earns you cooking XP.[/*][*][b]Chop Ingredients[/b]: You prepare your ingredients.[/*][*][b]Sharpen Knife[/b]: You sharpen your cooking knife. → Gives you the chance to generate additional chopped ingredients or meals.[/*][*][b]Roast[/b]: You prepare a roast meal.    [/*][*][b]Simmer[/b]: You prepare a stew.[/*][*][b]Stir Fry[/b]: You prepare a difficult stir fry.    [/*][*][b]Secret Spice[/b]: You add a little secret spice to your meal. → Helps to make successful meals.[/*][*][b]Healthy Eating[/b]: You try to cook the meal without using spices. → Provides a chance not to consume any spices at all.[/*][*][b]Finish Cooking[/b]: You stop cooking. → Timing is of the essence![/*][*][b]Voilà![/b]: You proudly present your meal.[/*][/list]
[h3]Finest Ingredients[/h3]
[b]Tasty Fruit and Veg[/b]
For your recipes you need only the best ingredients, such as the big new tomatoes, onions, mangos and lettuces which can be collected in NosTale!

[b]Sweet or Sour[/b]
It takes the right combination of spices to turn a plain meal into a serious taste explosion. Chef Terry can provide you with fine spices such as garlic, chilli powder, cinnamon, and pepper. Meanwhile MSG can be looted by completing Act 7 raids.
[h2]For Gourmets[/h2][list][*]
Before trying your hand at the more exquisite meals, you need to set Chef as your character’s side job. The first choice of side job is free, but each subsequent change costs 1,000,000 Gold.
[/*][*]
You can acquire and equip the specialist card irrespective of your side job. But you can only transform into a Chef once you have selected it as your side job with Terry.
[/*][*]
As a Chef, you can earn cooking XP by cooking meals and preparing ingredients, increasing the level of your specialist card.
[/*][*]
The cooking XP depends on the level of meals you prepare.
[/*][*]
The maximum level for Chef is 50.
[/*][*]
The Chef is a down-to-earth specialist whose sights are only set on fine cuisine, so you can’t equip them with wings.
[/*][*]
Look forward to extra culinary challenges. Chef Terry has daily quests ready for you as soon as you’ve finished the main quest.
[/*][/list]
Bon appétit!
The NosTale Team

notes.title: Bombastic Easter Events
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/80027e5aa7ae8abbf4d6ea7ea1a47b3a20c00867.jpg[/img]

Easter in NosTale is more than colourful eggs: you can look forward to two thrilling Spring raids and cute bunny costumes!

[b]Event Period[/b]: 1/4 until 21/4
[h2]The Mad March Hare[/h2]
The Mad March Hare is causing headaches in NosTale! You and your friends are the only ones who can stop him!

[b]How it Works:[/b]
[list][*]By defeating monsters you can pick up the Mad March Hare Raid Seal which you allows you to enter the raid.[/*][*]Enter the raid from the Chicken Farm Path and join other adventurers in combat against the Mad March Hare.[/*][*]The boss has an array of eggs in his arsenal. Dodge them and watch out for Rotten Egg Bombs, Eggy Bombs and Crazy Egg Bombs – you’ll need to interact with some of them![/*][*]Give the Mad March Hare a boot down the burrow. notes.title: Event: Big Fishing Competition
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/dd0a9815cb695901d34129e50759f681b2836bc9.jpg[/img]

Have you got the skills and the expertise to become a famous angler? Make a name for yourself, and land the biggest whopper from NosTale’s waters. On top of the glory, you could pick up a [b]Professional Angler Skin[/b], or the cute [b]Otter[/b], every fisherman’s best friend. Just watch out he doesn’t gobble up everything you catch… after all, he more than shares your passion for fish! 
[h2]Catch a Whopper![/h2]
Between 3rd March (midnight) and 9th March (11:59 PM) you can take part in NosTale’s Big Fishing Competition and pick up amazing prizes. Check the rules, prepare your lines and select your bait wisely. And make sure you stock up in time, because you can only buy 500 bait per day from Wade.
[h3]Competition Rules[/h3][list][*]The winner is the person who lands the longest fish.[/*][*]Fish length is measured in centimetres.[/*][*]To ensure a level playing field, each player gets exactly 2,000 attempts with each of their characters.[/*][*]Each time you cast your line counts as one attempt, even if you don’t catch anything.[/*][*]If there are multiple winners (i.e. whose biggest catches are all the same), then all of them will receive the prize. That also applies to the lucky losers.[/*][/list][h3]Rewards[/h3]
[b]Winners[/b]The winners of the competition get the following prizes:
[list][*]Professional Angler Skin (tradeable)[/*][*]Otter pet (tradeable)[/*][/list]
[b]Lucky Losers[/b]NosVille’s Anglers’ Association have decided to make an exception to the rules, such that the Anglers who catch the smallest fish (from the big fish category) will also be rewarded. This fish must however have a value of at least 500,000 Gold.
[list][*]Professional Angler Skin (tradeable)[/*][*]Winnie Whitefeather (not tradeable)[/*][/list]
[b]Avid Anglers[/b]Participants who catch at least 1,500 fish (from 2,000 attempts) will receive the following prizes:
[list][*]100x Infinity Coin (not tradeable)[/*][*]Tropical Hat (30 Days, not tradeable)[/*][*]Tropical Costume (30 Days, not tradeable)[/*][*]Tropical Costume Wings (30 Days, not tradeable)[/*][/list]
Good luck!
The NosTale Team

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/d7beda739e0ad88f718a91cc338451dd0a55fe12.jpg[/img]


Get ready! At 17:00 CET on 17th February the new international server kicks off with a host of challenges, boosts and active galore – join the fun!

We’ve also merged some other language servers together to increase your gaming enjoyment. Find more details at the bottom of this post.
[h1]New Server, Epic Events[/h1]
Set out on an unforgettable journey full of excitement and adventure! There’s a double drop rate, double experience points, a range of rewards for your heroic deeds and much more in store!
[h3]Insane Boosts[/h3]
Start out on the new server with a whole month of crazy boosts – and the chance to extend them for 2 weeks!

The boosts will run until at least 17th March, and may be extended to 31st March if you and your fellow players meet the goal set on the server by 17th March! Join the fun and benefit from: 
[list][*]Double Family XP – Extended if 20 families reach level 5[/*][*]Double XP – Extended if 10,000 Mother Cuby raids are completed (each character counts 1x per raid)[/*][*]Double drop rate – Extended if 200,000 Time-Spaces are completed[/*][*]Double Gold – Extended if 60,000 Instant Combats have been won (each character counts 1x per combat)[/*][/list]

notes.title: New Server and Server Merge
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/e3648aefa3a44482ada06d3f3d040c565b0a52ff.jpg[/img]

Dear player,

Your enjoyment playing NosTale is at the heart of everything we do. That’s why we’ve decided to open a new international server and merge some language servers together. 

We’ve put together an FAQ covering everything about the new server and the server merge. Let’s start with the new server:

[h1]New International Server
[/h1]
The international server is the first one to be launched independent of language region. Enjoy an exciting start on the new server, and play in the language of your choice thanks to the multi-language client.


[h2]International Server FAQ
[/h2]
[h3]Eight languages in one chat? Won’t that get messy?
[/h3]We thought about that, and as it’s an international server, we wanted to give everyone the chance to play here and use their own language. Otherwise we might as well just be launching another English server! Players who aren’t interested in seeing a mix of languages will still be able to play on the servers in their regions where the language is restricted. Nevertheless, we’ll be keeping an eye on the situation, and may choose to restrict the language(s) used in the chat at a later date, should things get out of hand.

[h3]What about support? Which languages will that be provided in?
[/h3]Ticket support for the international server will only be available in English.

[h3]Where can I go for server-related discussions?
[/h3]We’ll have separate channels for the new server on our Discord server. And if there’s demand for it, we’ll also consider opening an extra category on the forum.

[h3]Are you planning anything special for the server launch?
[/h3]As has become tradition for our server launches, we have a range of events and special offers planned for the launch. We’ll release more details on those over the coming days.

[h1]Server Merge
[/h1]We’re merging the following servers together:
[list][*]DE7 Paimon + DE2 Fortuna = Fortuna
[*]ES6 Carno + ES1 EU-Infinity = EU-Infinity
[*]FR7 Kirollas + FR2 Galaxie = Galaxie
[*]IT5 Solaris + IT1 Flare = Flare
[*]PL6 Belial + PL1 Feniks = Feniks[/list]

No changes have been made to any servers not mentioned.

[h2]Server Merge FAQ
[/h2]
[h3]How was it decided which servers to merge together?
[/h3]We conducted extensive analysis of the servers and are merging them in such a way that we can ensure a balanced population and activity levels on all servers after the merge.

[h3]What happens if I have characters on multiple servers which are being transferred onto the same one?
[/h3]You have a total of four character slots available. If you have more characters than that, the four highest-ranking characters will be transferred to the target server. The remaining characters will not be lost, however, only deactivated. On the website you’ll be able to activate/deactivate your characters as you wish. 
Please note that you only have one active slot for Martial Artists. 
There are multiple situations which can arise and will be solved as follows (the Swordsman, Archer and Mage classes are referred to here as ‘original’ classes):
[b]Situation 1[/b]: Three original classes and no Martial Artists
Three slots will be occupied by your original class characters, and the fourth slot remains empty until you create another character.
[b]Situation 2[/b]: Four original class characters and no Martial Artists
All four slots will be occupied by your characters. 
[b]Situation 3[/b]: More than three original class characters and no Martial Artists
If you don’t have any Martial Artists, all four slots will be occupied by your highest-ranking characters. Your remaining characters will be deactivated but can be reactivated via the website.
[b]Situation 4[/b]: More than four original class characters and at least one Martial Artist
Three slots will be occupied by your highest-ranking original class characters. The fourth will be occupied by your highest-ranking Martial Artist. Your remaining characters will be deactivated but can be reactivated via the website.
[b]Situation 5[/b]: Less than three original class characters and at least one Martial Artist
The slots will be occupied by your original class characters, the remaining slots remain empty until you create more original class characters. The fourth will be occupied by your highest-ranking Martial Artist. Your remaining Martial Artists will be deactivated but can be reactivated via the website.

[h3]How do I activate/deactivate my characters?
[/h3]Follow these simple steps to activate/deactivate a character:
[list][*]Open the Gameforge Client and select NosTale.
[*]Click on Settings to open the account settings. Here you’ll land on the relevant NosTale webpage where you can check your character list.
[*]If you have more than four characters and would like to play with one of your deactivated characters, select an active character and click on the character you’d like to play with. The two will be swapped.
[*]Please note that you only have one active slot for Martial Artists. 
You can change your active characters on the website at any time.[/list]

[h3]What happens to families?
[/h3]Active families will be transferred to the relevant target server. Only families whose members have been inactive for the last 180 days, or families with fewer than 4 members and a family level below 4 will be deleted.

[h3]What happens to the family warehouse?
[/h3]Items from the family warehouse will be sent to the Family Head by parcel. 

[h3]What happens when two or more characters have the same name?
[/h3]The first criteria for choosing who keeps the name is whichever character was online in the last 90 days. The others will be renamed.
If multiple characters were online in the last 90 days, then the character which is (at least) 10 levels higher than the others keeps the name.
Should there be a tie even after taking both of these criteria into account, then the older character (according to creation date) will keep their name.
If your character is forced to change, you will be presented with a window allowing you to change their name after selecting the character following the merge.

[h3]What happens when two or more families have the same name?
[/h3]If multiple families have the same name on the target server, then the older family gets to keep it. Newer families are automatically renamed as follows: ‘merge_number’. Please contact the Support team to change the family name manually.

[h3]What happens to items in the warehouse?
[/h3]Your items in the warehouse will be sent by parcel to your highest-level character.

[h3]What happens to items in the NosMall which aren’t claimed?
[/h3]The unclaimed items from the NosMall will be sent by parcel to your highest-level active character. 

[h3]What happens to active auctions in the NosBazaar?
[/h3]All active offers in the NosBazaar will be cancelled before the merge and then sent to the respective characters by parcel.

[h3]What happens to friends lists and spouses?
[/h3]As far as possible, friends lists and spouses will be merged on the target servers.

[h3]Will the rankings be reset?
[/h3]No, all player ranks on the target servers will be newly calculated and adjusted.

[h3]What happens to the blacklist?
[/h3]The blacklist will be deleted during the merge.

[h3]My character/account is deleted. Will the data be transferred anyway?
[/h3]Yes, even deleted characters/accounts will be transferred. If you wish to restore your data, this is still possible. 

[h3]Do I have to delete or select the characters to be activated after the transfer before the server merge?
[/h3]No, your characters will be activated automatically.

[h3]What happens to my Gold and the items in my inventory?
[/h3]Both your Gold and the items in your inventory will be transferred to the target server.

[h3]Do I need to reinstall the game after the server merge?
[/h3]No, you can launch the game just the same as before.

[h3]Do my login details remain unchanged?
[/h3]Yes, you can log in as usual with your credentials. If you have more than 4 characters in total, the four highest-ranking characters will be transferred to the target server. The remaining characters will not be lost, however, only deactivated. On the website you’ll be able to activate/deactivate your characters as you wish. 

If you have any further questions, our Support team will be happy to help. 

Have fun on the new servers!
The NosTale Team

notes.title: [10/2–24/2] Bumper Double Event: Chinese New Year and Valentine’s Day
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/17d03883a3481042cccdd5b992ed0e8030b9ddf4.jpg[/img]

Get ready for double the action! This year we’re celebrating both the Chinese New Year and Valentine’s Day at the same time in NosTale, with tons of exciting missions and great rewards in store.

[b]Year of the Ox: Mimi Needs Help[/b]
Wild bull bushtails are roaming the lands in NosTale and have played a nasty trick on Mimi Mentor! They’ve caused as much chaos outside the China shop as they would inside, and have run off with Mimi’s things. Return Mimi’s stolen items and earn yourself a New Year’s Gift Box.

How it works:
[list][*]Talk to Mimi Mentor.[/*][*]Travel around the world of NosTale and defeat monsters. With a bit of luck, a Bull Bushtail might appear (excluding Instant Combat, raids, Time-Spaces and Glacernon).[/*][*]The thieves won’t defend themselves and can be beaten with just 5 blows, but make sure those little good-for-nothings don’t slip through your fingers.[/*][*]After each blow, a Bull Bushtail will drop one of the following items:[/*][*]Gold[/*][*]Golden New Year’s Carrot [/*][*]Tasty Carrot Snack[/*][*]Stolen Gift Bag[/*][*]Stolen Lucky Charm[/*][*]Return the stolen goods back to Mimi and you’ll earn a New Year’s Gift Box.[/*][/list]
The New Year’s Gift Box may contain the following:
[list][*]New Year Lucky Pig[/*][*]Bushtail Costume Scroll[/*][*]March Hare Costume (7 Days)[/*][*]March Hare Hat (7 Days)[/*][*]Adorable Bunny Costume (7 Days)[/*][*]Adorable Bunny Ears (7 Days)[/*][*]Golden New Year’s Carrot [/*][*]Fresh Carrot Juice[/*][*]Tasty Carrot Snack[/*][*]Cute Bunny [/*][/list]
[b]Love is in the Air: NosTale Valentine Events[/b] 

Is there someone special you’ve always wanted to confess your love to? Now’s the perfect time to show your feelings and express your undying devotion. There are lots of loveydovey events and promotions waiting for you during the Valentine’s period!

[b]Event: Amora Needs Cupid’s Arrows[/b]
[list][*]Help Amora spread the love in NosVille! To do that she’ll need some arrows.[/*][*]Talk to Amora once you reach at least level 50. She’ll explain what she needs to make them. Collect the components and bring them to her![/*][*]You’ll get the [b]Wedding Costume Specialist Card[/b] (one per character) as a thank you.[/*][/list]
[b]Event: Share the Love![/b]
[list][*]Hunt monsters and collect Chocolate, Gift Boxes, and Ribbons.[/*][*]Exchange them for a Valentine’s Day Gift from Eva Energy. Then you’ll have the chance to share your love![/*][*]If your friend accepts your gift, you’ll get a Valentine’s Day Blessing that grants you extra energy and strength. This temporarily increases your attack and defence power.[/*][*]1-3 Gifts: Small Valentine’s Day Blessing[/*][*]4-9 Gifts: Valentine’s Day Blessing[/*][*]10+ Gifts: Big Valentine’s Day Blessing[/*][*]Now remember, not everyone will want to accept your gifts – but stay strong![/*][*]Don’t be shy, share your love! You can give someone a present up to 3 times each day.[/*][/list]
[b]Event: Amora’s Missing Wings[/b]

Love can be a double-edged sword. The tragic story of [u]Wingless Amora[/u] and her true love will pull at your heartstrings. But you’ll soon feel all warm and cuddly again once you get your new ranged partner as a quest reward: [b]Wingless Amora[/b] (one per character).

[b]Discount Sale: Weddings at Bargain Prices[/b]
Let your long-awaited dreams of the big day come true and pick up a Wedding Box at a 20% discount.Just remember not to take marriage lightly – divorce can be a painful experience. To remind you of this, the Separation Letter now costs 20% more.This offer will end once the Valentine’s event is over. Don’t forget – you can also get Amora’s Specialist Partner Card in the shop.

Good luck and have fun!
The NosTale Team

notes.title: Community Update – Roadmap 2021
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/e3648aefa3a44482ada06d3f3d040c565b0a52ff.jpg[/img]

Hello NosPlayers!

As we put 2020 behind us, we say farewell to a turbulent and troublesome year, and not just in NosTale. Together we conquered the Celestial Spire, learned how to fish, and threw our keyboards out of the window after the third hotfix maintenance within a week!

But today’s not about NosTalgic reminiscences – you want to know what lies ahead! Together with Entwell, we’ll be working to bring you big updates and expansions this year… and probably a good bit of nail-biting on patch day.

Below you can find a list of our rough plans for the first half of the year, from January to June. As some of these updates lie several months down the road, there’s always the chance they’ll get pushed back into the second half of the year. So treat this list as a teaser of things to come, rather than a roadmap set in stone! But who are we talking to? We know you’ve all scrolled down past this already…

Planned updates for Q1 and Q2 2021:
[list][*]International merges for EN/CZ/TR/RU and South America (for real this time!)[/*][*]International test and game server launches[/*][*]Further balance changes[/*][*]New lifestyle specialist (similar to the Angler)[/*][*]New specialist for every class[/*][*]Various mounts, pets, wings, costumes and more[/*][/list]
Our seasonal and weekend events will continue as usual. And if the situation in the real world improves, we’ll hopefully squeeze in a few streams as well.Any questions, quibbles or queries about all that, talk to your favourite Community Manager. We hope you’re as excited about the future as we are!

Wishing you a great 2021!
The NosTale Team

notes.title: Event: Exclusive Costumes in Sealed Vessels
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/c83b7a3130c034cbca81ed368883a297d5145759.jpg[/img]

Mysterious Sealed Vessels are circulating around the world of NosTale. Surrounded by a magical aura, only [b]parties of experienced adventurers[/b]  should dare open them, as these otherwise unremarkable vessels contain the most wicked of creatures, banished by wise mages. 

The brave – or the foolish – who nevertheless rise to the challenge to liberate and defeat the evil creature inside one of these Sealed Vessels have a chance of being rewarded with a treasure chest. These contain fantastic items from the NosMall! 

With a dollop of good fortune, you could pick up [b]the Death Lancer Set, the Death Lancer Murderwings, the Small Ice Witch, the Ice Witch Costume Set, the Ice Witch Costume Wings or the ‘Liberator’ title[/b].

[b]Event Period:[/b] From 13th January (11 AM CET) to 27th January (9 AM CET)
[h3]Effects[/h3]
[list][*]Death Lancer Murderwings: Grant 10% more damage to monsters from Sealed Vessels and 5% more damage to monsters in the Land of Death.[/*][*]Death Lancer Set: Slightly increases your movement speed and provides a 2% chance to inflict Hand of Death on your enemies when attacking.[/*][*]Liberator: The title provides +5% damage to monsters from Sealed Vessels.[/*][/list]
[h3]How the Event Works[/h3]
[list][*]Pick up a Sealed Vessel from the NosMall, NosWheel or NosBazaar.[/*][*]Rally your friends/family together and steel yourselves for a tough fight.[/*][*]Open the Sealed Vessel summoning one of 20 monsters.[/*][*]The higher the monster’s level, the greater the chance of collecting a treasure chest.[/*][/list]
[h3]Things to Know[/h3]
[list][*]The Sealed Vessels can be opened on any map, with the exceptions of those detailed below.[/*][*]Sealed Vessels cannot be opened in the capitals (NosVille, Port Alveus, Sunset Cliff).[/*][*]Only 11 Sealed Vessels can be active simultaneously on the following maps: NosVille Meadows, Mine Plains, Sunny Meadows, Fernon Outpost, Western Mine (all maps), Northern Mine (all maps), Fernon Temple (all maps) and Fernon’s Hideout (all maps).[/*][*]The event will be repeated in future with another unique reward.[/*][/list]
[h3]Your Loot[/h3]
In addition to the treasure chest, the following items may drop after defeating the monster:
[list][*]1x Death Lancer Set [/*][*]1x Death Lancer [/*][*]1x Death Lancer Murderwings [/*][*]1x Liberator[/*][*]1x Small Ice Witch[/*][*]1x Ice Witch Costume Set[/*][*]1x Ice Witch Costume Wings[/*][*]2x Wings of Friendship[/*][*]1x Tarot Card Game[/*][*]5x Fairy Experience Potion[/*][*]20x Perfume[/*][*]20x Huge Recovery Potion[/*][*]10x Cylloan Spring Water[/*][*]40x Seed of Power[/*][*]10x Guardian Angel’s Blessing[/*][*]1x Special Pet Food[/*][*]1x Guardian Lucifer’s Specialist Partner Card[/*][*]1x Sheriff Chloe’s Specialist Partner Card[/*][*]1x Archdaemon Amon’s Specialist Partner Card[/*][/list]
Enjoy the monster hunt!
The NosTale Team

notes.title: Event: Tough Time-Space Challenge
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/8d45ce72a5f81e3b2166162ff67592857511f90a.jpg[/img]

Listen up, brave hero! Princess Sakura has been kidnapped, and you’re the only one who has what it takes to be able to rescue her! 

But be on your guard, as sneaky Ninjas will be lurking in the shadows to stop you in your tracks. They are competent fighters, and love to lay an ambush so they can catch their opponents off guard. They’re not shy of killing their hostages either, so you’ll need to be move very carefully. The Ninjas’ fortress is a deathly labyrinth, with a sinister trick waiting in every room.

Do you have what it takes to rescue the princess from the Ninjas’ clutches and escape with both your lives intact?
[h3]The Event[/h3]
The Ninja Time-Space opens on Port Alveus Square [b]from 7th January (11 AM) to 13th January (9 AM CET)[/b] for all solo players from level 80. You’ll need the Jajamaru Specialist Card in order to beat the Time-Space.
[h3]Rewards[/h3]
Every hero remembers the first princess they rescued. And for this first rescue, you’ll receive the new ‘Ninja’ title which allows you to fight like a shadow warrior, giving you the Sharp Vision buff (revealing hidden characters for a short time) and briefly increasing hit rate and concentration.

Plus you’ll get 10 Small Completion Gemstone Random Boxes in reward.

[b]Additional rewards:[/b]Think you’ve got both the brains and the brawn and want to get your hands on even more rewards? Then be among the 5 top players to leave the fortress safely in the fastest time!

The 5 players with the best times per server can look forward to the following juicy rewards:
[list][*]Ninja Bushtail[/*][*]Pumpkin Witch/Pumpkin Knight Costume[/*][*]Pumpkin Witch/Pumpkin Knight Costume Wings (Permanent)[/*][/list]
Please note that the rewards will only be given out at the end of the event. Rescue missions conducted in ‘Loser Mode’ do not count.

Best of luck!
The NosTale Team

notes.title: Winter Events and a Christmas Gift
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/499b1ac9d9c6d7efc71a3866c108caaa673d4d76.jpg[/img]

Silent night, holy night… not in NosTale! The wild cats are back once more, trying to take over in our Winter Event. What’s more, you have the special chance to create a reindeer-drawn sleigh – this sleek ride would make even Santa Claus turn green with envy, though at this festive time of year he can’t keep a merry smile off of his face at seeing you ride it.

[b]Look forward to these highlights between 9th December 2020 and 13th January 2021:[/b]
[h3]Holiday Offers in the NosMall[/h3]
Winter items and Christmassy surprises await you in the NosMall – including a festive Miniland decoration! 

Wondering why the sleigh isn’t on offer this winter? That’s because there are more than enough other Christmas items to buy. Besides, there’s another big surprise waiting behind the last door of our Advent calendar. What could it be…?
[h3]Magic Sleigh with Red-Nosed Reindeer[/h3]
The NPC Santa Claus has something very special in store for you. In exchange for a Red-nosed Reindeer Bead (available from quests and the Winter Event raids listed below) and a sleigh, Santa Claus will create a super-fast Magic Sleigh with Red-Nosed Reindeer for you.
[h3]Specialist Partners[/h3]
With Maru’s Specialist Partner Card you can transform Tom and Kliff into the Millennial Tiger. With the second Specialist Partner Card ‘Maru in Mother’s Fur’, you can transform Tom and Kliff into a tiger disguised as the siblings’ caring mother. The partner has three razor-sharp skills: Hi-yah!, Spin Up and Tiger Power
[h3]Raid Against Maru the Millennial Tiger[/h3]
Challenge Maru and his followers in the raid! Simply use Maru’s Raid Seal to take him on. If you’re successful, you’ll be rewarded with his special Tiger Chest, possibly containing the ‘Doppelgänger’ title as well as the Obsidian of Completion.

Note: You can neither make yourself invisible, nor summon miniatures as Jajamaru in this raid.  
[h3]Daily Quests[/h3][list][*]Searching for the Siblings’ Mother[/*][*]Save the Siblings[/*][*]Need Sesame Oil[/*][/list]
You can earn Maru’s Raid Seal and Brass Coins as your reward for completing the daily quests.
[h3]Event Quest[/h3]
Talk to the new Wanderer NPC to exchange Brass Coins for the Wanderer’s Chest and the great items hidden inside.
[h3]Red Bean Rice Cakes and Sesame Oil[/h3]
Collect Red Bean Rice Cakes and Sesame Oil by hunting monsters, then exchange the items for a reward or use them yourself. The cakes restore you and your NosMate’s HP and MP, while the Sesame Oil is useful in the raid.
[h3]Snowman Raid[/h3]
Once you’ve completed the quest and mastered the Time-Space, you can get your revenge on the Snow Monster in the Vikings’ name. Grab your friends and bring the heat to the wicked snowman! In reward you’ll earn a raid box containing awesome specialist partner cards, the ‘Sleepy Head’ title and other wintry event items.
[h3]The Search for Bigfoot[/h3]
Another Bigfoot sighting has been reported in NosVille: The mysterious creature who doesn’t exactly live life as large as the footprints it leaves behind has been seen in the snowy mountains. The tracks in the snow apparently resemble those of a tiger… Can you get to the bottom of this mystery? Complete the quest successfully to obtain the new ‘Bigfoot’ title!
[h3]Sealed Christmas Vessel[/h3]
You can summon monsters with the Sealed Christmas Vessel. This time, you can obtain the new ‘Grinch’ title from these monsters.
[h3]Daily Quests from Six NPCs in NosVille[/h3]
Meet good and evil reindeer, let the bells ring out, watch how scarves are made from magical wool and knitting needles, and much more. Collect colourful stockings for completing quests and exchange them for a Christmas Gift Box.
[h3]Happy New Year… Literally![/h3]
Collect golden letters (H, A, P, Y) and white letters (N, E, W, Y, A, R) that are dropped by monsters. Once you have enough to spell the words HAPPY NEW YEAR, you can exchange them for a Happy New Year Box and/or a Happy New Year Golden Box. If fortune’s smiling, you’ll find a Movement Scroll, fancy costumes or a variety of fireworks inside.

Wishing you a wonderful Winter Event!
The NosTale Team
