notes.title: New: The Angler Specialist Card
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/b72757c53689a73979517a04d7cb9f2388cabe46.jpg[/img]

Are you in need of a little downtime away from the sometimes rather hectic NosTale action, but you’re still looking for a little challenge? How about some fishing? Our new [b]Angler Specialist Card[/b] offers you just that:

Relax by the water and reel in a nice fat fish. Discover all there is to know about your catches to date in the Encyclopaedia of Fish and keep on getting better. 
[h2]All Fish Great and Small[/h2]
All sorts of fish in various sizes await you in the waters of NosTale. You can catch a total of 77 fish, some of which are only to be found in certain areas. Fish that you’ve caught will be entered into your Encyclopaedia of Fish. This is where you’ll find an overview of all the fish and the areas in which you’ll find them.

Once you’ve completed your collection, you’ll be the proud owner of a new title: ‘Champion Angler’.
[h2]Angler’s A to Z[/h2]
With our Angler’s A to Z, your next catch is already in the bag:

notes.title: Creepy cool events in NosTale!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/991746e17be71d20c28e6f105886126d536a382d.jpg[/img]

[i]Double, double toil and trouble, hear the fires of Hellord bubble! Witches, devils, ghosts and sprites, walk abroad this eerie night.When monsters lurk on NosVille’s greens, you know it’s time for Halloween![/i]

Get ready: [b]from 21/10 to 4/11[/b] NosVille and Port Alveus will be decked out in eerie Halloween decorations and the mad Professor Macavity, Foxy and Jack O’Lantern will be causing all sorts of creepy mayhem in NosTale! An additional quest, a Halloween costume and a title with powerful effects are also waiting for you!
[h3]Your new Halloween style[/h3]
Give friends and enemies a good scare: during the event period, the Pumpkin Witch/Pumpkin Knight costume will be available in the NosMall – grab it and let the frightful fun begin!
[h3]The Cursed 13[/h3]
Talk to Mary in NosVille to start the quest and earn yourself a new title by completing all three Halloween raids 13 times! The ‘Monstrous’ title gives you a 2% change of triggering ‘Horror’ on your attacks.
[h3]Titles with powerful effects[/h3]
In reward for each of the three Halloween raids there is one of these titles in the raid box:
[list][*]Test Subject: Increases resistance to Bleeding by 1%.[/*][*]Sly Dog: Increases max. MP by 300.[/*][*]Horror: Deals greater damage to low-level undead monsters by 3%.[/*][/list][h3]Mad Professor Macavity[/h3]
The mad genius feline is back! Rally 7 players around you and start the raid. Two of the eight players will be transformed into Professor Macavity and the Test Subject. Let the chase begin![b] Full details on the raid:[/b]
[list][*]Mad Professor Macavity’s Raid Seal drops in Foxy and Jack O’Lantern’s raids.[/*][*]The raid can only be attempted 5 times per day. There are however reset tickets.[/*][*]Exactly 8 players are needed to start the raid.[/*][*]Players who want to play must bring a pet.[/*][*]Professor Macavity can drag the Test Subject to him. Both need to work together to capture enemies.[/*][*]Only the hunted players can open boxes during the raid and receive handy items for the chase.[/*][*]Hunters can freeze opponents for a short time. [/*][*]Before hunted players can leave the raid, they must find a key in one of the boxes.[/*][*]The hunters must prevent the hunted from leaving the raid. For each player caught, the hunters earn a raid box. Players caught leave the raid without a box.[/*][*]If a hunted player leaves the raid successfully, they earn a raid box.[/*][*]White Witch Laurena’s Wand appears if the hunted player with the wand is caught.[/*][/list][h3]Foxy and Her Brood[/h3]
Challenge Foxy and her sneaky brood in the raid! Use Foxy’s Raid Seal to confront her. If you’re successful, you’ll earn her Wonder Chest in reward. With a little luck you may even draw Foxy’s Specialist Partner Card! Foxy is a raid boss with super skills, as well as being a new partner. Tame her and she’ll be your loyal companion forever!

The raid seals can be picked up in daily quests. Plus you can earn more rewards by collecting flasks.
[h3]Jack O’Lantern and His Minions[/h3]
Defeat the evil pumpkin Jack O’Lantern in the raid! He’s supported by his Pumpkin Bushi and Pumpkin Bomb minions. In reward for victory, you can claim a Halloween raid box. Amongst others you can pick up a Glowing Pumpkin Hat and creepy Tarot Cards from the raid box in this event.
[h3]Daily Quests from NosVille NPCs[/h3]
Talk to Eric, Eva Energy, Malcolm Mix and Teoman Topp and pick up handy items in the Trick or Treat Quests! For example, you can get Yellow and Black Pumpkin Sweets, the Halloween Blessing, a Glowing Pumpkin Hat or a Halloween Costume Scroll. Playing the quests will also get you Bags of Sweets which can be exchanged for Jack O’Lantern’s raid seal.
[list][*]Defeating monsters causes them to drop goodies like Yellow and Black Pumpkin Sweets. You can either gobble them down, or exchange them for a Halloween Costume Scroll or a raid seal for Jack O’Lantern.[/*][*]Don your new Glowing Pumpkin Hat! You’ll be sure to set a new trend in the village! You can get the deadly smart headgear from the Halloween Horror Box or the raid box.[/*][*]Halloween Costume Scroll: Transform into 10 different creepy critters which you know from the game. The new costume gives you 4x attack power and 2x defence power.[/*][/list]
Best witches!
The NosTale Team

notes.title: Community Update – Merges and Balancing
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/e3648aefa3a44482ada06d3f3d040c565b0a52ff.jpg[/img]

Hello NosPlayers!

As we enter the final quarter of the year, we wanted to reach out and talk about what’s currently in the pipeline, what plans we have, and what problems lie ahead.

Today’s community update focuses on two main issues – the international server merges and the next balancing patch – and the reasons why neither is quite ready!

Last week we made the difficult decision to push the server merges we’d had pencilled down for November back into next year. We know that many of you will be annoyed to hear this, and we totally understand – in fact, nobody’s more put out by this than we are! Be that as it may, we want to be as open and frank as we can about both the reasons behind this decision, and where we’re going from here.

The aim of the server merges is to pool the smaller communities into a larger one, yet still allow each player to choose the language version they want to play the game in. NosTale currently has 9 completely separate setups and databases across all languages, making this project far more complicated than simply throwing together servers from within the same territory.

We need more time than originally budgeted for to ensure that no accounts slip through our digital fingers, and all the servers can be merged without a hitch. But enough of our excuses! Let’s come to what you really want to know: when are the merges coming? Well, if everything goes according to the current plan, we should be able to get this underway early next year. We don’t have a concrete date yet, but we’ll keep you posted as things progress.

What does all this have to do with the eagerly awaited balancing patch? Don’t worry, we haven’t forgotten about that. One request on a lot of players’ lips is for more and deeper-running changes. While we’ve already taken a number of steps in this direction, the last thing we want to do is release a patch which knocks everything out of kilter – and let’s be honest, that wouldn’t be the first time. So we’ve come up with another solution…

Introducing the Public Experimental Server for Testing Stuff (or PESTS – okay, fine, the name is still WIP)!

That’s right, we want to hear your feedback to any changes we make as directly as we can, so we’re working on setting up a public test server where you can try out all our experimental tweaks and adjustments first hand. It’s important to us that everyone has a fair say, so we didn’t want make this an exclusively English server. Once the international merges are complete, we plan to roll out an international server as a test playground, where everyone can mess around and play with all the toys.

But that’s why the next big balancing patch is directly linked to the server merges.

Fine, so is there anything coming out this year?! Don’t worry, we’ve still got plenty in the pipeline to publish over the next few months. Keep your breath baited and fish around for clues, and you might even find a few hints about the next specialist coming to NosVille.

As ever, we’d like to thank you for being patient, and apologise for these delays. You’re what makes NosTale so amazing even after 13 years, and we cannot thank you enough. Have a great October and see you next update!

The NosTale Team

[h2]NosBazaar Improvements[/h2]
We’ve long felt the NosBazaar could be a bit easier to use, wouldn’t you agree? Well, you’ll be pleased to hear that we’re introducing the following improvements:
[list][*]Hovering over an item will now bring up some handy info, such as whether it is soulbound or whether it has any effects.[/*][*]Use a search filter for your specialist cards and see their perfection level at a glance.[/*][*]A new category has been added to armour for costumes and costume wings. That way you can easily search for costume items for your chosen gender (unisex items are displayed for both). Similarly, we’ve added a category for titles.[/*][*]The equipment search for champion levels has been expanded.[/*][/list][h2]Arena of Glory[/h2]
Looking to get stuck into the action without any messing around? A challenge in which victory and defeat are decided purely based on skill? Then the new PvP arena is right up your street! All you need are your tenacity and fighting skills!
[list][*]No groups are allowed in the Arena of Glory. It’s every man for himself![/*][*]Pets must wait outside. As much as we love our pets and partners, they’re not allowed in the Arena of Glory and will have to wait in the Miniland for your glorious return.[/*][*]An extra challenge – no buffs! There’ll be no one giving you buffs in this arena, a rule you might be familiar with from the Celestial Spire.[/*][*]Riding items and potions are similarly banned from the arena. The only exception to this are items like Fairy Boosters or Tarot Cards.[/*][*]If you use a skill, players will still be able to attack you even in the safe zone for 10 seconds. That’s designed to prevent players dashing back to the safe zone in cowardly hit-and-run attacks.[/*][*]Another 10-second timer starts ticking after leaving the raid via a portal.[/*][/list][h2]Skill Changes[/h2]
We’ve made a few tweaks to some passive buffs to improve class balance.

We’re sure you’re going to love these features and changes. We hope you have fun – not long to wait now until release!

notes.content:

Your heroes can only receive each reward once.

[list][*]20x Small Ruby of Completion[/*][*]20x Small Sapphire of Completion[/*][*]20x Small Obsidian of Completion[/*][*]20x Small Topaz of Completion[/*][/list]

notes.title: Guide: Infinite Celestial Spire Rankings
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/7cc81bcac28e443b957042245ab9cea835762fc3.jpg[/img]

The update’s here, bringing with it a new challenge for you! How good do you think you are? Battle your way up the Infinite Celestial Spire and earn your spot under the best combatants in the [b]new rankings table[/b]. Depending on your final place, you could get your hands on some great rewards.We’ve also [b]reworked the spire’s difficulty and given your inventory an upgrade[/b]. Read up on all the gory details in this guide:
[h1]Rankings[/h1]
[h3]Rules[/h3]
Your ranking is primarily based on the highest level you’ve managed to complete in the Infinite Celestial Spire. The second criterion is then the time you needed to complete the level, and finally your level in the spire (to which your champion level is added).[b]Ranking Details:[/b]
[list][*]There’s a different table for each class[/*][*]You automatically qualify if you complete at least one level of the spire[/*][*]Rankings are reset at 5:00 AM (CEST) on the first day of every month, removing all previous rankings[/*][*]The lists are updated daily at 3:00 AM (CEST)[/*][*]You receive rewards for top places when the ranking lists are reset. Rewards are sent by parcel[/*][/list]
[h3]Ranking Overview[/h3]
You can see the full lists in the Celestial Spire Rankings and Rewards List menus. Simply click on the new buttons Season Reward and Ranking Info to open up the respective window.
[h3]Rewards[/h3]
Rewards depend on your spot in the rankings, with different rewards for 1st place, 2nd/3rd place, 4th–10th place, 11th–20th place and 21st–30th place. Each reward consists of a treasure chest containing a certain amount of gold, fame and Infinity Coins. Check the overview in the game to see a complete list of rewards.
[h3]Celestial Spire Shop Items[/h3]
You can use your Infinity Coins to purchase the following items in the Celestial Spire:
[list][*]Golden Celestial Spire Chest[/*][*]Spirit King Gloves (Replica)[/*][*]Ancient Beast Gloves (Replica)[/*][*]Ancient Beast Shoes (Replica)[/*][*]Spirit King Shoes (Replica)[/*][/list][h1]Inventory Update[/h1]
After the update you’ll find a new button in the inventory for sorting your items. Simply click the button to activate it. Please note that you cannot use the sorting feature while trading.
[h1]Difficulty Adjustment[/h1]
Too difficult? We’ve gone and reduced the [b]overall difficulty of the spire[/b], and updated some of the levels for a smoother gaming experience. There’s now nothing stopping you from conquering the Infinite Celestial Spire – show ‘em who’s boss!

Wow, are you still reading this? Well you couldn’t be better prepared for the new competition in the Infinite Celestial Spire. Go get ‘em! Have fun!
The NosTale Team

notes.title: Summer Event Part 2
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/5cea85507007a121f9c78a9f152d71be8b392e93.jpg[/img]

Ears up, adventurer! Our summer event series continues with part 2: [b]between 29th July (11:00 AM) and 19th August (9:00 AM CEST)[/b] you’ll have to play it by ear against a wily band of bunnies:

[h3]Give Lola’s Lopears a Boxing![/h3]

Look out, here comes Lucy’s evil sister: Lola Lopears! Confront her in the raid – but keep your wits about you when her army of little bunnies comes hopping out of the burrow. Lola also plants a giant carrot in the ground which you must destroy as quickly as possible. Each member of your raid team needs Lola Lopears’ Raid Seal before you can start. If you manage to swing the battle in your favour, with a bit of luck you might find [b]Lucy Lopears’ Specialist Partner Card[/b] in the raid box. Equipped with the fire element, Lucy Lopears will be your loyal, powerful partner.

[h3]What Else?[/h3]

The second part of our summer event packs a punch, with plenty of other missions requiring your attention.
In reward for your efforts, you can pick up [b]the new title ‘Lopears’[/b] giving you 2% hit rate and 2% concentration, the cute [b]Bunny Hairband[/b], and a whole raft of other rewards.

Have fun!
The NosTale Team

Our brand-new [b]update Act 7 Part 2 is now live![/b] In ‘Conquer the Celestial Spire’ you’ll find tons of great new features for your favourite game. Look forward to the following:

We’re proud to present the first part of our two summer events: [b]from 13th July to 29th July (11:00 AM CEST)[/b] you have the chance to teach the wicked Captain Pete O’Peng and his crew a lesson in the Pirate Raid! Pillage the raid box and snap up the [b]Navy Costume or Navy Bushi, partner Leona, one of the four Pirate Bushtails or the new ‘Arrrrr’ title[/b].

Catch you there!

notes.title: Guide: Infinite Celestial Spire
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/95eb85259a3ea7160f328fbfe72357885c888204.jpg[/img]

Hello adventurers, 

As announced in our news about the highlights of [b]Act 7 Part 2[/b], you’ll have a new and exciting challenge to face in the Infinite Celestial Spire. And we’ve summarised all the important details for you here.

[h3]What Is It?[/h3]

You enter the Infinite Celestial Spire and take on dangerous monsters that attack in waves on several levels. Your task is to defend the totem against the attackers. You’ll be supported in your efforts by powerful groups of pets and partners. This game mode is suitable for single players and PvE lovers. 

[h3]NosMates[/h3]

The special thing about this feature is that you can take 5 groups consisting of 4 NosMates each into the Celestial Spire with you. Your companions will lend you active support in your battles – and you’re going to need it! If certain NosMates are part of the same group, they can give you teamwork buffs.

You can summon your NosMates during battle if you need reinforcements. Simply click on the icons 1 to 5 or press the SHIFT + 1 to 5 keys.

[h3]Infinite Celestial Spire[/h3]

[b]The entry conditions for the Infinite Celestial Spire are:[/b]

[list]
[*] You must have completed the new main quest.
[*] You mustn’t currently be part of a party.
[*] The Celestial Spire Key item is required.
[/list]

If you meet all the conditions, speak to the gatekeeper in the village of Moritius. Before entering the Spire, you will be shown a new menu. Here you can put together your groups of NosMates to accompany you in battle.

[h3]The New Game Mode[/h3]

[b]These are the rules:[/b]

[list]
[*] All buffs are removed when you enter the Spire.
[*] Consumables cannot be used.
[*] You can change specialist cards, fairies and gear during the battles.
[*] NosMates only receive 50% damage in the Spire.
[*] Your friends cannot teleport to you inside the Spire.
[/list]

[b]Winning and losing:[/b]

[list]
[*] There is at least one totem on each level, which you have to defend for a certain amount of time against the waves of monsters. You can position your NosMate groups around the totem to help you with this.
[*] You have to survive, of course. But it’s also important to protect the totem until the end of each level! If just one of the totems is destroyed, you will fail your mission. You can repeat the lost level with a Celestial Spire Key.
[*] If you survive the level and the totems haven’t been destroyed, you will complete the level.
[*] You can reset all completed levels using the Celestial Spire Reset Ticket so that you can play them again. However, you will only receive the normal and random rewards when playing them again.
[/list]

[b]The monsters and the totem:[/b]

The totem gets stronger with each level – as do the monsters. They only have one thing on their minds: to destroy the totem! When they appear, they will rush straight for it. Only once you or your NosMates attack the monsters will they turn their aggression towards you and your companions.

But monsters wouldn’t be monsters if there weren’t any deviants: some of them won’t take their eyes off the totem even when you hit them, while others will show greater hostility towards you and your little NosMate army. So be on your guard!

[h3]The Rewards[/h3]

Let’s finally turn our attention to the rewards that are in store for your efforts! There are three of them, depending on how you complete the Infinite Celestial Spire:

[list]
[*] Normal reward: Gold and reputation
[*] Random reward: various random rewards such as the Infinity Coin (a new currency), Celestial Spire Key, Raid Seal etc.
[*] Bonus: only available for the first completion in each month. You’ll receive rewards like the Infinity Coin, Celestial Spire Key, Raid Seal, materials, consumables etc.
[/list]

[h3]The Celestial Spire Shop[/h3]

In the new Celestial Spire Shop, you can get everything you need for your battles in the Infinite Celestial Spire and more. You can spend your Infinity Coins on useful items here too.


So, those were all the important details. If you have actually read this far, you are now well-prepared for your new adventure in the Infinite Celestial Spire. Let’s go! Your NosMates are waiting impatiently for you.

Have fun!
The NosTale Team

notes.title: It’s Almost Here!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/3722f8197065bd8b0367670e35588907cccc6106.jpg[/img]

Hello adventurers, 

Surely you’ve heard that NosTale’s [b]brand new update[/b] is ready to launch. It will start off in a few days, so once again we have put together all the features of the update into this compact summary for you. You can find information about which events we have planned further below:
[h2]New Contents[/h2][h3]Infinite Celestial Spire[/h3]
In the Infinite Celestial Spire you defend the totem on four levels from increasingly powerful enemies. But don't worry – you can take 5 groups consisting of 4 NosMates each into the battle for support. This is gonna be fun!
[h3]Pets[/h3]
Aside from looking cool, they can also help get you out of a jam – we’re talking about our 6 new pets! Each one has its own skill. Which pet will you choose first?
[h3]Raid[/h3]
The nasty Lord Paimon is waiting for you in the new raid. We got a look at him for you, and he really is a bad dude. He’s also a master of magic and summoning – so watch out for him!
[h3]Runes and Tattoos[/h3]
How about a new tattoo? The Corrupt Shadow Tattoo Pattern looks amazing and shows everyone you mean business. Plus the maximum level for runes has been increased by 6.
[h3]Quests[/h3]
A heap of exciting quests and tasks are waiting for you in the new update including 5 new Time-Space missions!
[h2]Summer Event Part 1[/h2]
To go along with the summer update, we will present to you the first part of our two summer events: [b]from 08/07 to 29/7[/b] you have the chance to teach the wicked Captain Pete O’Peng and his crew a lesson in the Pirate Raid! Pillage the raid box and snap up the [b]Navy Costume or Navy Bushi, partner Leona, one of the four Pirate Bushtails or the new ‘Arrrrr’ title[/b] amongst many other items.

notes.title: Community Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/e3648aefa3a44482ada06d3f3d040c565b0a52ff.jpg[/img]

Hey NosPlayers!

In March of this year we shared the first Community Update with you celebrating how far we had gotten as well as sharing an outlook on things we were working on.
As we are now heading into the second half of the year, it’s time to look back – as well as forward.

2020 has certainly been a turbulent year, forcing all of us here at Gameforge into home office, where we have now been for the better part of 3 months.
Nonetheless, we were able to achieve many of our goals bringing you important updates for the future of the game like our new client or the national merges. How are you merged people feeling in your new homes?

Of course, we have to admit that not everything on our list will be completed in this first half of 2020.
With all our efforts focused on delivering Act 7.2 to you as soon and flawlessly as possible, the new specialist or international merges will have to wait until after that. We apologize for this delay.
Worry not though – we haven’t forgotten! They’re being carried over at the top of our new list.

And while we’re on the topic, let’s get into it! (Since we are planning the 7.2 release for next month, it’s no longer on this list)
Things we will be working on in the second half of the year include:
[list]
[*] Community Merges for EN/CZ/RU/TR/South America
[*] Changes to EXP in Quest Progression
[*] New Specialist System
[*] SP Balancing
[*] New Wings, Costumes and Miniland Decorations
[*] Several QoL features
[*] Bugfixes and other improvements
[/list]

Like last time, there will also be seasonal and boost events starting with a summery event rather soon.
So grab your straw hats, buckle up and join us for the ride!

With sincere thanks for your patience,
The NosTale Team

[i]Note: This list is still not in chronological order. Due to the continual progress in individual areas, dates are subject to change.[/i]

notes.title: Server Merge!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/e51d4512a76f4ef06810b03b45221c0c49daee86.jpg[/img]

In order to improve your gaming experience in NosTale, we will seize the moment and merge together some of our language servers. You will be able to have fun on the newly merged servers and enjoy full raids and events – and of course get to welcome new family members!

The following servers will be merged:
* DE6 Zenas + DE2 Fortuna = Fortuna
* ES5 EU-Phoenix + ES1 EU-Infinity = EU-Infinity
* FR6 Univers + FR2 Galaxie= Galaxie
* PL5 Radikun + PL1 Feniks = Feniks

No changes will be made to any servers not mentioned.

[b]Any questions?[/b]

What will happen to my characters and family? Will my friends list be deleted? We answer all these and many more questions in our FAQ!

Have fun on the new servers!
The NosTale Team 

[h1]Server Merge FAQ [/h1]
In order to improve your gaming experience in NosTale, we will seize the moment and merge together some of our language servers. You’ll find all the details to these merges in this FAQ.

[h3]Which servers are being merged?[/h3]
The following servers will be merged:
* ES5 + ES1 = ES1 (on April 28th)
* DE6 + DE2 = DE2 (on April 29th)
* FR6 + FR2 = FR2 (on April 29th)
* PL5 + PL1 = PL1 (on April 29th)
No changes have been made to any servers not mentioned.

[h3]How was it decided which servers to merge together?[/h3]
We conducted extensive analysis of the servers and are merging them in such a way that we can ensure a balanced population and activity levels on all servers after the merge.

[h3]What happens if I have characters on multiple servers which are being transferred onto the same one?[/h3]
You have a total of four character slots available. If you have more characters than that, the four highest-ranking characters will be transferred to the target server. The remaining characters will not be lost, however, only deactivated. On the website you’ll be able to activate/deactivate your characters as you wish. 
Please note that you only have one active slot for Martial Artists. 
There are multiple situations which can arise and will be solved as follows (the Swordsman, Archer and Mage classes are referred to here as ‘original’ classes):
[b]Situation 1[/b]: Three original classes and no Martial Artists
Three slots will be occupied by your original class characters, and the fourth slot remains empty until you create another character.
[b]Situation 2[/b]: Four original class characters and no Martial Artists
All four slots will be occupied by your characters. 
[b]Situation 3[/b]: More than three original class characters and no Martial Artists
If you don’t have any Martial Artists, all four slots will be occupied by your highest-ranking characters. Your remaining characters will be deactivated but can be reactivated via the website.
[b]Situation 4[/b]: More than four original class characters and at least one Martial Artist
Three slots will be occupied by your highest-ranking original class characters. The fourth will be occupied by your highest-ranking Martial Artist. Your remaining characters will be deactivated but can be reactivated via the website.
[b]Situation 5[/b]: Less than three original class characters and at least one Martial Artist
The slots will be occupied by your original class characters, the remaining slots remain empty until you create more original class characters. The fourth will be occupied by your highest-ranking Martial Artist. Your remaining Martial Artists will be deactivated but can be reactivated via the website.

[h3]How do I activate/deactivate my characters?[/h3]
Follow these simple steps to activate/deactivate a character:
*Log into the website at nostale.gameforge.com, by clicking on "Settings" in the Launcher.
*You can also use the character activation on the website if you play the game via Steam. Simply ask the support team to link your Steam account to your website account, if it is not already linked.
* Check your character list on the website. You’ll find them in the settings.
* If you have more than four characters and would like to play with one of your deactivated characters, select an active character and click on the character you’d like to play with. The two will be swapped.
* Please note that you only have one active slot for Martial Artists. 
You can change your active characters on the website at any time.

[h3]What happens to families?[/h3]
Active families will be transferred to the relevant target server. Only families whose members have been inactive for the last 180 days, or families with fewer than 4 members and a family level below 4 will be deleted.

[h3]What happens to the family warehouse?[/h3]
Items from the family warehouse will be sent to the Family Head by parcel. 

[h3]What happens when two or more characters have the same name?[/h3]
The first criteria for choosing who keeps the name is whichever character was online in the last 90 days. The others will be renamed.
If multiple characters were online in the last 90 days, then the character which is (at least) 10 levels higher than the others keeps the name.
Should there be a tie even after taking both of these criteria into account, then the older character (according to creation date) will keep their name.
If your character is forced to change, you will be presented with a window allowing you to change their name after selecting the character following the merge.

[h3]What happens when two or more families have the same name?[/h3]
If multiple families have the same name on the target server, then the older family gets to keep it. Newer families are automatically renamed as follows: ‘merge_number’. Please contact the Support team  to change the family name manually.

[h3]What happens to items in the warehouse?[/h3]
Your items in the warehouse will be sent by parcel to your highest-level character.

[h3]What happens to items in the NosMall which aren’t claimed?[/h3]
The unclaimed items from the NosMall will be sent by parcel to your highest-level active character. 

[h3]What happens to active auctions in the NosBazaar?[/h3]
All active offers in the NosBazaar will be cancelled before the merge and then sent to the respective characters by parcel.

[h3]What happens to friends lists and spouses?[/h3]
As far as possible, friends lists and spouses will be merged on the target servers.

[h3]Will the rankings be reset?[/h3]
No, all player ranks on the target servers will be newly calculated and adjusted.

[h3]What happens to the blacklist?[/h3]
The blacklist will be deleted during the merge.

[h3]My character/account is deleted. Will the data be transferred anyway?[/h3]
Yes, even deleted characters/accounts will be transferred. If you wish to restore your data, this is still possible. 

[h3]Do I have to delete or select the characters to be activated after the transfer before the server merge?[/h3]
No, your characters will be activated automatically.

[h3]What happens to my Gold and the items in my inventory?[/h3]
Both your Gold and the items in your inventory will be transferred to the target server.

[h3]Do I need to reinstall the game after the server merge?[/h3]
No, you can launch the game just the same as before.

[h3]Do my login details remain unchanged?[/h3]
Yes, you can log in as usual with your credentials. If you have more than 4 characters in total, the four highest-ranking characters will be transferred to the target server. The remaining characters will not be lost, however, only deactivated. On the website you’ll be able to activate/deactivate your characters as you wish. 

If you have any further questions, our Support team  will be happy to help. 
Have fun on the new servers!
The NosTale Team

Situation 5: Less than three original class characters and at least one Martial Artist
The slots will be occupied by your original class characters, the remaining slots remain empty until you create more original class characters. The fourth will be occupied by your highest-ranking Martial Artist. Your remaining Martial Artists will be deactivated but can be reactivated via the website.
Follow these simple steps to activate/deactivate a character:
Log into the website at nostale.gameforge.com, by clicking on "Settings" in the Launcher.
You can also use the character activation on the website if you play the game via Steam. Simply ask the support team to link your Steam account to your website account, if it is not already linked.
Check your character list on the website. You’ll find them in the settings.

If you have more than four characters and would like to play with one of your deactivated characters, select an active character and click on the character you’d like to play with. The two will be swapped.
Please note that you only have one active slot for Martial Artists.
You can change your active characters on the website at any time.

Active families will be transferred to the relevant target server. Only families whose members have been inactive for the last 180 days, or families with fewer than 4 members and a family level below 4 will be deleted.
Items from the family warehouse will be sent to the Family Head by parcel.
The first criteria for choosing who keeps the name is whichever character was online in the last 90 days. The others will be renamed.
If multiple characters were online in the last 90 days, then the character which is (at least) 10 levels higher than the others keeps the name.
Should there be a tie even after taking both of these criteria into account, then the older character (according to creation date) will keep their name.
If your character is forced to change, you will be presented with a window allowing you to change their name after selecting the character following the merge.

If multiple families have the same name on the target server, then the older family gets to keep it. Newer families are automatically renamed as follows: ‘merge_number’. Please contact the Support team to change the family name manually.
Your items in the warehouse will be sent by parcel to your highest-level character.
The unclaimed items from the NosMall will be sent by parcel to your highest-level active character.
All active offers in the NosBazaar will be cancelled before the merge and then sent to the respective characters by parcel.
As far as possible, friends lists and spouses will be merged on the target servers.
No, all player ranks on the target servers will be newly calculated and adjusted.
The blacklist will be deleted during the merge.
Yes, even deleted characters/accounts will be transferred. If you wish to restore your data, this is still possible.
No, your characters will be activated automatically.
Both your Gold and the items in your inventory will be transferred to the target server.
No, you can launch the game just the same as before.

Yes, you can log in as usual with your credentials. If you have more than 4 characters in total, the four highest-ranking characters will be transferred to the target server. The remaining characters will not be lost, however, only deactivated. On the website you’ll be able to activate/deactivate your characters as you wish.

notes.title: New Game Client for NosTale
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/431861591e7724964684630a320a255a9802b57f.jpg[/img]

[b]Coming soon to NosTale – we’re switching our client to a new multilingual version.[/b] Learn the most important details about the new game client below.

[h3]Changes[/h3]
Instead of having nine different game clients, one for each language, NosTale’s adventurers can all launch their favourite game from the same common client!

This multilingual version will include all NosTale languages. While it makes for a slightly larger download, this is outweighed by the benefits it brings.

[h3]Benefits[/h3]
Players who play multiple language versions now only need one game client. Gone are the days of having to update each individual version separately: simply switch between game languages in the Gameforge Client or the Steam settings.

But that’s not all! We’re working on even [b]more improvements[/b]:

Introducing a multilingual game client is only the first step. In future it will be possible to play on all servers in all languages with the new client – with the same account!

We also want to make it possible to merge the different versions into an international server. The client should also make it possible to play international events.

As you can see, we’ve got a lot up our sleeves and we can’t wait to roll out the next updates. As ever, we’ll keep you posted on the latest developments in our news.

Want to find out more about the new game client? Learn more in our FAQ !

The NosTale Team
[h1]FAQ: Multilingual Client[/h1]
Here you can learn more about the multilingual client. 

[h3]Why is NosTale getting a multilingual client?[/h3]
The multilingual client is the first step towards international server merges. 

[h3]What will happen to my accounts and characters?[/h3]
Don’t worry, nothing will change about your accounts and characters.

[h3]Can I use the multilingual client to play on a different server than my chosen language (e.g. on a Polish server in English)?[/h3]
In future we certainly plan to make it possible to play on other servers than your chosen language, however this isn’t possible at the moment. The language chosen in the Gameforge Client determines which servers you can join. For example, if your Gameforge Client is set to English, you can only play on UK/US servers.More details regarding these changes will be announced once we’re closer to releasing them. 

[h3]Do I need to select the server and language every time I log in?[/h3]
No, there will be no change here. The language chosen and saved in the Gameforge Client still determines which server you play on.

[h3]How much space does the multilingual game client require?[/h3]
The installation size will increase from 4.8 GB to around 5.8 GB, however the download is smaller as the files are compressed during transfer.

notes.title: [10/2–26/2] Love is in the Air: NosTale Valentine Events
notes.content:
[img]https://secure-asset-delivery.gameforge.com/partnersite_live_product/81854f0b-0698-4507-bcae-59b909e2f1f0/cd7974ef-393e-4c51-afe6-401f843b14492020-01-16_NT_Valentine_Event_2020_Graphics_TNT_Newsheader_895x300.jpg[/img]

Is there someone special you’ve always wanted to confess your love to? Now’s the perfect time. There are lots of loveydovey events and promotions waiting for you during the Valentine’s period!

Event period: [b]10/2 til 26/2/2020[/b]


[b]Event: Amora Needs Cupid’s Arrows[/b]
[list]
[*]Help Amora spread the love in NosVille! To do that she’ll need some arrows.
[*]Talk to Amora once you reach at least level 50. She’ll explain what she needs to make them. Collect the components and bring them to her!
[*]You’ll get the Wedding Costume Specialist Card (one per character) as a thank you.
[/list]

[b]Event: Share the Love![/b]
[list]
[*]Hunt monsters and collect Chocolate, Gift Boxes, and Ribbons.
[*]Exchange them for a Valentine’s Day Gift from Eva Energy. Then you’ll have the chance to share your love!
[*]If your friend accepts your gift, you’ll get a Valentine’s Day Blessing that grants you extra energy and strength. This temporarily increases your attack and defence power.
[*]1-3 Gifts: Small Valentine’s Day Blessing
[*]4-9 Gifts: Valentine’s Day Blessing
[*]10+ Gifts: Big Valentine’s Day Blessing
[*]Now remember, not everyone will want to accept your gifts – but stay strong!
[*]Don’t be shy, share your love! You can give someone a present up to 3 times each day.
[/list]

[b]Event: Amora’s Missing Wings[/b]

Love can be a double-edged sword. The tragic story of [i]Wingless Amora[/i] and her true love will pull at your heartstrings. But you’ll soon feel all warm and cuddly again once you get your new ranged partner as a quest reward: [b]Wingless Amora[/b] (one per character).


[b]Discount Sale: Weddings at Bargain Prices[/b]

Make your dreams come true and pick up a Wedding Box at a 20% discount.

Just remember not to take marriage lightly – divorce can be a painful experience. To remind you of this, the Separation Letter now costs 20% more.
This offer will end once the Valentine’s event is over. Don’t forget – you can also get Amora’s Specialist Partner Card in the shop.



With lots of love,
The NosTale Team

notes.title: Event: Frosty Surprises in Sealed Vessels
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/72a15542554055dcdc666be3056f6c92d36b5d72.jpg[/img]

Many moons ago, terrible creatures were banished into the mysterious Sealed Vessels which are circulating around the world of NosTale. Surrounded by a magical aura, only [b]parties of experienced adventurers[/b] should dare open them.

The brave – or the foolish – who nevertheless rise to the challenge to liberate and defeat the evil creature inside one of these Sealed Vessels have a chance of earning a treasure chest containing fantastic items! With a pinch of good fortune, the monsters of winter could drop the [b]Small Ice Witch[/b] pet, a [b]Ice Witch Costume Set[/b], [b]Ice Witch Costume Wings[/b] or the exclusive [b]Liberator[/b] title which gives you +5% damage to monsters inside Sealed Vessels.

[b]Event period:[/b] From 15th January 2020 (from 11 AM CET) until 29th January 2020 (11 AM CET).
[h1]Here’s How[/h1][list][*]Pick up a Sealed Vessel from the NosMall, NosWheel or NosBazaar.[/*][*]Rally your friends/family together and steel yourselves for a tough fight.[/*][*]Open the Sealed Vessel summoning one of 20 monsters.[/*][*]The higher the monster’s level, the greater the chance of collecting a treasure chest.[/*][/list]
The [b]Ice Witch Costume Set[/b] and [b]Ice Witch Costume Wings[/b] offer the following effects:
[list][*]The Ice Witch Hat increases HP and MP by 200 each. Water resistance increases by 5%.[/*][*]The Ice Witch Costume and Ice Witch Costume Wings each grant 10% more damage to monsters from Sealed Vessels and 5% more damage to monsters in [u]Glacernon[/u].[/*][*]The Ice Witch Costume increases water resistance by 25% and the water element by +10%.[/*][*]When wearing the complete costume set, you have a 10% chance that your HP will regenerate by 10% when you suffer damage (of at least 1% of your HP).[/*][/list][h1]Things to Know[/h1][list][*]The Sealed Vessels can be opened on any map, with the exceptions of those detailed below.[/*][*]Sealed Vessels cannot be opened in the capitals (NosVille, Port Alveus, Olorun Village) or at Sunset Cliff.[/*][*]Only 11 Sealed Vessels can be active simultaneously on the following maps: NosVille Meadows, Mine Plains, Sunny Meadows, Fernon Outpost, Western Mine (all maps), Northern Mine (all maps), Fernon Temple (all maps) and Fernon’s Hideout (all maps).[/*][*]The event will be repeated in future with another unique reward.[/*][/list]
The following items may drop after defeating the monster:
[list][*]1x Small Ice Witch[/*][*]1x Ice Witch Costume Set[/*][*]1x Ice Witch Costume Wings[/*][*]1x [u]Liberator[/u] title[/*][*]2x Wings of Friendship[/*][*]1x Tarot Card Game[/*][*]5x Fairy Experience Potion[/*][*]20x Perfume[/*][*]20x Huge Recovery Potion[/*][*]10x Cylloan Spring Water[/*][*]40x Seed of Power[/*][*]10x Guardian Angel’s Blessing[/*][*]1x Special Pet Food[/*][*]1x Guardian Lucifer’s Specialist Partner Card[/*][*]1x Sheriff Chloe’s Specialist Partner Card[/*][*]1x Archdaemon Amon’s Specialist Partner Card[/*][/list]
Enjoy the monster hunt!The NosTale Team

notes.title: Event: Sleigh Ride in the Winter Eve Weeks
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/499b1ac9d9c6d7efc71a3866c108caaa673d4d76.jpg[/img]

Silent night, holy night… not in NosTale! The wild cats are back once more, trying to take over in our Winter Event. What’s more, you have the special chance to create a reindeer-drawn sleigh – this sleek ride would make even Santa Claus turn green with envy, though at this festive time of year he can’t keep a merry smile off of his face at seeing you ride it.

Look forward to these highlights between 09 December 2019 and 09 January 2020:

[b]Magic Sleigh with Red-nosed Reindeer[/b]
The NPC Santa Claus has something very special in store for you. In exchange for a Red-nosed Reindeer Bead (available from quests and the Winter Event raids listed below) and a Magic Sleigh (available in the NosMall), Santa Claus will create a super-fast Magic Sleigh with Red-nosed Reindeer for you.

[b]Specialist Partners[/b]
With Maru’s Specialist Partner Card you can transform Tom and Kliff into the Millennial Tiger.
With the second Specialist Partner Card ‘Maru in Mother’s Fur’ you can transform Tom and Kliff into a tiger disguised as the siblings’ caring mother.
The partner has three razor-sharp skills: Hi-yah!, Spin Up and Tiger Power

[b]Raid against Maru the Millennial Tiger[/b]
Challenge Maru and his followers in the raid! Simply use Maru’s Raid Seal to take him on. If you’re successful, you’ll be rewarded with his special Tiger Chest, possibly containing the ‘Doppelgänger’ title amongst other things.

Note: You can neither make yourself invisible, nor summon miniatures as Jajamaru in this raid.  

[b]Daily Quests[/b]
* Searching for the Siblings’ Mother
* Save the Siblings
* Need Sesame Oil

You can earn Maru’s Raid Seal and Brass Coins as your reward for completing the daily quests.

[b]Event Quest[/b]
Talk to the Wanderer NPC to exchange Brass Coins for the Wanderer’s Chest and the great items hidden inside.

[b]Red Bean Rice Cakes and Sesame Oil[/b]
Collect Red Bean Rice Cakes and Sesame Oil by hunting monsters, then exchange the items for a reward or use them yourself. The cakes restore you and your NosMate’s HP and MP, while the Sesame Oil is useful in the raid.

[b]Snowman Raid[/b]
Once you’ve completed the quest and mastered the Time-Space, you can get your revenge on the Snow Monster in the Vikings’ name. Grab your friends and bring it the heat! In reward you’ll earn a Raid Box containing awesome specialist partner cards, the ‘Sleepy Head’ title and other wintry event items.

[b]Daily Quests from Six NPCs in NosVille[/b]
Meet good and evil reindeer, let the bells ring out, watch how scarves are made from magical wool and knitting needles and much more. Collect colourful stockings for completing quests and exchange them for a Christmas Gift Box.

[b]Happy New Year… Literally![/b]
Collect golden letters (H, A, P, Y) and white letters (N, E, W, Y, A, R) that are dropped by monsters. Once you have enough to spell the words HAPPY NEW YEAR, you can exchange them for a Happy New Year Box and/or a Happy New Year Golden Box. If fortune’s smiling, you’ll find a Movement Scroll, fancy costumes or a variety of fireworks inside.

Wishing you a wonderful Winter Event!
The NosTale Team

notes.title: Guide: Tattoo System
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/45ba5d6da0b4d05ef7f13e9f99f84c5e2117cb2b.jpg[/img]

This update will get under your skin! In NosTale Act 7, you can visit Churisgo on Moritius and have her give you a magical tattoo. You’ll feel the extra power boost immediately!

Tattooing has a long tradition on the island of Moritius. The orcs pay homage to the god of wild animals with their skin art, who in turn bestows special blessings on the bearer of the tattoos in the form of special abilities. Churisgo is a true master of this traditional art.

[b]You can choose between tattoos from these 4 categories:[/b]
* Bear Loa
* Lion Loa
* Eagle Loa
* Snake Loa

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/6e9b78d1281a7ff264a5f636b2275df05cb44934.jpg[/img]

[b]How it works:[/b]
*    Visit NPC Churisgo in the village on the island of Moritius.
*    Talk to the orc Churisgo.
*    You require materials with which to craft a tattoo pattern.
*    Use the tattoo pattern to choose one of the tattoo categories.
*    You’ll receive a random tattoo which grants you a passive ability. There are 8 different tattoos in each category.
*    Your character can have up to two tattoos. These must be from different categories, however.
*    You can also ask Churisgo to touch up an existing tattoo and strengthen the ability it provides. As this is a difficult procedure, the result may be successful, unsuccessful or a major failure. Failure results in the strength of the effect dropping by 1.
*    Each tattoo can be strengthened up to 9 times.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/0eaf6ddb3f18d132806797076907c10ef58389a6.jpg[/img]

Please note: Materials are required for each step up to a complete tattoo (creating the pattern, adding the tattoo and strengthening it).
If you prefer to remove a tattoo or want to protect it from failure when strengthening it, you can buy special items in the NosMall.

May the orc gods smile upon you!
The NosTale Team

notes.title: Guide: Runes
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/703e2ff8e9eaaedbc9ecf4005c1aa6baa2704490.jpg[/img]

The inhabitants of Moritius Island use the mysterious and powerful runes to make their weapons stronger.

As you are helping the orcs on the island, rune master Martas is happy to carve these magical runes into your weapons too.

How it works:
[list]
[*] Visit NPC Martas on the new region, Moritius Island.
[*] He'll carve runes into your weapon in exchange for money and materials.
[*] You can carve up to 15 runes into your weapon (any weapon of level 80 or above).
[*] The more runes you try to add, the higher the chance that the process will fail.
[*] Each rune will have a different effect. If you get the same effect more than once, the effect is amplified.
[*] For every 3 runes you carve, there is a chance for a rune power to be applied to your weapon instead of an effect.
[*] Just like rune effects, rune powers can stack when you get the same power more than once.

[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/3ff772a4266d6532344b520da77a45a10fd40891.jpg[/img]

Resources in the NosMall

So you’re not happy with the effects you got and want to remove all your runes? Or you want to repair a ruined rune?

Why not take a look in the NosMall? You’ll find plenty of things there to help make you a happy rune user.

Have fun upgrading your weapon!
The NosTale Team

tags.feature: The inhabitants of Moritius Island use the mysterious and powerful runes to make their weapons stronger.
As you are helping the orcs on the island, rune master Martas is happy to carve these magical runes into your weapons too.
Visit NPC Martas on the new region, Moritius Island.
He'll carve runes into your weapon in exchange for money and materials.
You can carve up to 15 runes into your weapon (any weapon of level 80 or above).
The more runes you try to add, the higher the chance that the process will fail.

There are 13 rune effects, and 10 rune powers.
So you’re not happy with the effects you got and want to remove all your runes? Or you want to repair a ruined rune?
Why not take a look in the NosMall? You’ll find plenty of things there to help make you a happy rune user.
Have fun upgrading your weapon!

notes.content:

Mysterious Sealed Vessels are circulating around the world of NosTale. Surrounded by a magical aura, only parties of experienced adventurers should dare open them, as these otherwise unremarkable vessels contain the most wicked of creatures, banished by wise mages.
The brave – or the foolish – who nevertheless rise to the challenge to liberate and defeat the evil creature inside one of these Sealed Vessels have a chance of being rewarded with a treasure chest. These contain fantastic items from the NosMall, and with a pinch of good fortune, maybe even a[b] Mini Fire Devil[/b] and the exclusive ‘Liberator’ title which grants you +5% damage against monsters from Sealed Vessels.

[b]Event period:[/b] From 20th November (from 11 AM CET) until 4th December (11 AM CET).

[b]Here’s How[/b]
[list]
[*] Pick up a Sealed Vessel from the NosMall, NosWheel or NosBazaar.
[*] Rally your friends/family together and steel yourselves for a tough fight.
[*] Open the Sealed Vessel summoning one of 20 monsters.
[*] The higher the monster’s level, the greater the chance of collecting a treasure chest. These contain fantastic items from the NosMall, and with a pinch of good fortune, maybe even a Mini Fire Devil and the exclusive ‘Liberator’ title which grants you +5% damage against monsters from Sealed Vessels.

[*] Only 11 Sealed Vessels can be active simultaneously on the following maps: NosVille Meadows, Mine Plains, Sunny Meadows, Fernon Outpost, Western Mine (all maps), Northern Mine (all maps), Fernon Temple (all maps) and Fernon’s Hideout (all maps).
[*] The event will be repeated in future with another unique reward.
[/list]
In addition to the treasure chest, the following items may drop after defeating the monster:

[list]

notes.title: The Witching Hour in NosTale!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30481962/a509ffd737e063983c9a7fb6143b8e0ff60d63e7.jpg[/img]

[i]Double, double toil and trouble, hear the fires of Hellord bubble!
Witches, devils, ghosts and sprites, walk abroad this eerie night.
When monsters lurk on NosVille’s greens, you know it’s time for Halloween![/i]
​
Get ready ‘twixt [b]24th October and 13th November[/b] when NosTale will be visited by the crazy Professor Macavity, Foxy and her fiendish brood, plus Jack O’Lantern and his minions! 
​
In reward for each of the three Halloween raids there is one of these new **titles with amazing effects** in the raid box:
[list]
[*] Test Subject
    [*] Effect: Increases resistance to Bleeding by 1%.
[*]Sly Dog
    [*] Effect: Increases max. MP by 300.
[*] Horror
    [*] Effect: Increases damage to low-level undead monsters by 3%.
[/list]
​
[b]Mad Professor Macavity[/b]
​
The mad genius feline is back! Rally 7 players around you and start the raid. Two of the eight players will be transformed into Professor Macavity and the Test Subject, and the chase can begin!

[i]Full details on the raid:[/i]
* Mad Professor Macavity’s Raid Seal drops in Foxy and Jack O’Lantern’s raids.
* The raid can only be attempted 5 times per day. There are however reset tickets.
* Exactly 8 players are needed to start the raid.
* Players who want to play must bring a pet.
* Professor Macavity can drag the Test Subject to him. Both need to work together to capture enemies.
* Only the hunted players can open boxes during the raid and receive handy items for the chase.
* Hunters can freeze opponents for a short time. 
* Before hunted players can leave the raid, they must find a key in one of the boxes.
* The hunters must prevent the hunted from leaving the raid. For each player caught, the hunters earn a raid box. Players caught leave the raid without a box.
* If a hunted player leaves the raid successfully, they earn a raid box.
* White Witch Laurena’s Wand appears if the hunted player with the wand is caught.
​
[b]Foxy and Her Brood[/b]
​
Challenge Foxy and her sneaky brood in the raid! Use Foxy’s Raid Seal to confront her. If you’re successful, you’ll earn her Wonder Chest, which with a bit of good fortune might contain Foxy’s Specialist Partner Card.
Foxy is a raid boss with super skills, as well as being a new partner. Tame her and she’ll be your loyal companion forever!
​
The raid seals can be picked up in daily quests. Plus you can earn more rewards by collecting flasks.
​
[b]Jack O’Lantern and His Minions[/b]
​
Defeat the evil pumpkin Jack O’Lantern in the raid! He’s supported by his Pumpkin Bushi and Pumpkin Bomb minions. In reward for victory, you can claim a Halloween raid box.
Amongst others you can pick up a Glowing Pumpkin Hat and creepy Tarot Cards from the raid box in this event.
​
[b]Daily Quests from NosVille NPCs[/b]
Talk to with Eric, Eva Energy, Malcolm Mix and Teoman Topp and pick up handy items in the Trick or Treat Quests! For example, you can get Yellow and Black Pumpkin Sweets, the Halloween Blessing, a Glowing Pumpkin Hat or a Halloween Costume Scroll. Playing the quests will also get you Bags of Sweets which can be exchanged for Jack O’Lantern’s raid seal.
* Defeating monsters causes them to drop goodies like Yellow and Black Pumpkin Sweets. You can either gobble them down, or exchange them for a Halloween Costume Scroll or a raid seal for Jack O’Lantern.
* Don your new Glowing Pumpkin Hat and set a new trend in the village! You can get the deadly smart headgear from the Halloween Horror Box or the raid box.
* Halloween Costume Scroll: Transform into 10 different creepy critters which you know from the game. The new costume gives you 4x attack power and 2x defence power.
​
Best witches!
The NosTale Team

notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30481962/c2f9c9411b530931ba7b117d5348ddaae27917be.jpg[/img]

Transform your melee partner into an angel of the flames! With a little luck on your side you have a chance to win the [b][i]One-Winged Perti[/i] Specialist Partner Card[/b] on the NosWheel from 3rd July. This gives you access to the skills Flame Attack, Fiery Breath and Flaming Armour.

Perti is the daughter of the goddess Erenia. When Erenia turned to the darkness, Petri joined the revolt. She was defeated and hidden in the world of the humans. In order to obtain more power, she joined forces with an enchanted sword called Defensio. But this sword slowly took more and more control over her body. In desperation, she cut one of her wings off to rescue herself, and since then she has been known as One-Winged Perti.

While Perti is accompanying you, this specialist partner card gives you the effect One-Winged Perti’s Aura, which increases your Champion experience points by up to 20% and gives you a 30% chance to reduce damage from all attacks by 5%.

Skills:
[list][*]Flame Attack – Chance to cause Cursed Flame which reduces opponent’s MP and causes continual HP damage[/*][*]Fiery Breath – Chance to cause Blazing Armour which damages the enemy and causes increasingly powerful effects[/*][*]Flaming Armour – Increases fire resistance and defences[/*][/list]
Please note that the specialist partner card can only be traded with a Specialist Partner Card Holder.

Of course there are tons of other great items to be won on the NosWheel!

notes.title: [3/7–31/7/2019] A Summer of Fun with Captain Pete O’Peng and Lola Lopears!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30481962/2762bbe59c1ff7619313980440e19c6f09c669be.jpg[/img]

This year’s summer event is here! Your favourite villains are back centre stage. Are you going to take on the fearsome pirate Captain Pete O’Peng? Or would you prefer to give the mischievous Lola Lopears a tug on the lugholes? You can take them both to task and pick up great event items until 31st July.

[b]More Dangerous Than Ever: Captain Pete O’Peng![/b]

Yo-ho-ho, Captain Pete O’Peng is back! After voyaging the seven seas, he’s returned… and he’s badder than ever before! He’ll be causing mischief again this summer and he reckons you won’t stand a chance against him this time. What do you say to that? Show that rascally freebooter what you’re made of!
[list][*]Eliminate the wicked [b]Captain Pete O’Peng[/b] and his crew in the Pirate Raid! Pillage the raid box and snap up the [b]Navy Costume or Navy Bushi, partner Leona or one of the four Pirate Bushtails[/b] amongst many other items.[/*][*]Slip on the elegant [b]Navy Costume[/b]! The Captain’s Hat provides a 2% chance of inflicting Strong Freeze on your opponent. The costume provides a 5% chance of reducing all attack damage by 80%. Both items of clothing increase your water resistance by 2%.[/*][/list]
[b]Give Lola Lopears a Tug on the Lugholes![/b]

It’s Lucy’s evil sister: Lola Lopears! Confront her in the raid – but keep your wits about you when her army of little bunnies comes hopping out of the burrow. Lola also plants a giant carrot in the ground which you must destroy as quickly as possible. Each member of your raid team needs Lola Lopears’ Raid Seal before you can start. If you manage to swing the battle in your favour, with a bit of luck you might find Lucy Lopears’ Specialist Partner Card in the raid box. Equipped with the fire element, Lucy Lopears will be your loyal, powerful partner.

[b]Event Quests[/b]

A host of challenging quests will demand your utmost skill. You’ll be rewarded with Ginseng Leaves and Carrots, and these handy items will help you by regenerating HP and MP.

[b]Daily Quests[/b]

Ginseng Digger and Raphael’s Story
As a reward for the daily quests, you’ll find the Tortoise Present and Lola Lopears’ Raid Seal.

The NosTale Team

Grab a Dragon Knight Costume, a Magic Bone Dragon or one of the other fantastic surprises from the [b]Dragon Knight Random Box[/b]! Available in the NosMall until 1st July.

The contents of the Dragon Knight Random Box perfectly kit you out for combat against dragons and other monsters. Your box may even contain the mighty Dragon Knight Costume, a suit fashioned from the bones of the strongest dragons. Use a Speed Booster and you’ll be teleported to a random location on the map.

• Dragon Knight Costume (Permanent)
• Magic Bone Drake Chest
• 15x Gourmet Pet Food
• 6x Ancelloan’s Blessing
• 120x Huge Recovery Potion
• 1x Magic Speed Booster (7 Days)
• 8x Fairy Booster
• 5x Tarot Card Game

The item will be delivered to you unpacked.

Good luck and have fun!
The NosTale Team

[b]The brand-new Fire Devil Costume Wings smoulder in a shimmering red.[/b] You can now wear these wings even without having a specialist card equipped.

[b]Features:[/b]
[list]
[*]10% more damage to monsters in Sealed Vessels
[*]5% more damage to monsters in the Land of Death
[/list]
If fortune smiles on you, you may find the Fire Devil Costume Wings in one of the mysterious Sealed Vessels that are circulating around the world of NosTale. Surrounded by a magical aura, only parties of experienced adventurers should dare open them, as these otherwise unremarkable vessels contain the most wicked of creatures, banished by wise mages.
The brave – or the foolish – who nevertheless rise to the challenge and defeat the evil creature inside one of these Sealed Vessels have a chance of being rewarded with a treasure chest containing fantastic items from the NosMall.

[b]Event period:[/b] From 12th April (from 11 AM CEST) until 3rd May (at 11 AM CEST)

[b]How it works:[/b]
[list]
[*]Pick up a Sealed Vessel from the NosMall, NosWheel or NosBazaar.

notes.title: [10/4–4/6] Challenge of the Week – Are You Marriage Material Yet?
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30481962/1ffed2840ea64637e8e342f9cbbb73b3740ba11f.jpg[/img]

[b]A mysterious fortune-teller is visiting NosVille between 10th April and 4th June.[/b] She’ll help to turn you into proper marriage material, giving you new tasks in 3 different difficulties every week.

When you enter the dim room, a dizzy feeling overcomes you. Your eyes gradually adjust to the weak candlelight, and you spot the source of that overpowering smell of musk, in the dozens of glimmering incense sticks.

What have you let yourself in for? While toying with the idea of simply leaving again, a mysterious voice breaks the silence and interrupts your train of thought.

‘Don’t back out now!’

You swallow hard and edge imperceptibly closer to the fortune teller, who is visiting the world of NosTale until 4th June.

After all, you would like to find out what – and indeed WHO – the future has in store for you.

‘Come a little closer. Closer than that! Shh, shh, no need to say anything. I know all about you! Don’t look so surprised. My name is Madame Esmeralda, a psychic and the saviour of your love life! Now let me see here... hmm... a little rough around the edges, but you’re not a hopeless case. Don’t worry, Esmeralda knows exactly how to make proper marriage material out of you.’

[h1]Madame Esmeralda gestures for you to take a look in her crystal ball and see what the coming weeks hold in store for you:[/h1]
[list]
[*]     Each week you’ll be faced with 2 challenges each with 3 difficulty levels. If you succeed, your Marriage Material rating will increase by 2, 4 or 7 percent in reward, depending on the chosen difficulty level (bronze, silver or gold).
[*]     The challenges themselves will appear shortly before the start [url=http://nostale.comastuff.com/challenge/en/]here: [/url]View challenges
[*]     Once all the ‘Challenges of the Week’ are over, your total will be tallied up. The fantastic prizes, large and small, will be awarded according to how well you’ve proven your worth as Marriage Material.
[/list]

[h1]Prizes? What prizes? As if answering your thoughts, one item after another appears in the crystal ball:[/h1]

>7% Marriage Material --> 3x Fairy Booster (Event)
>14% Marriage Material --> 3x Soulstone Blessing (Event)
>21% Marriage Material --> 3x Ancelloan’s Blessing (Event)
>28% Marriage Material --> 20x Angel’s Feather
>35% Marriage Material --> 20x Full Moon Crystal
>42% Marriage Material --> 5x Yellow Gem (= 50,000 Gold)
>49% Marriage Material --> 5x Green Gem (= 150,000 Gold)
>56% Marriage Material --> 3x Blue Gem (= 300,000 Gold)
>63% Marriage Material --> 3x NosMerchant Medal (1 Day/Event)
>69% Marriage Material --> 3x Adventurer’s Knapsack (10 Days/Event)
>72% Marriage Material --> 3x Partner’s Backpack (10 Days/Event)
>75% Marriage Material --> 5x Small Ruby of Completion
>78% Marriage Material --> 5x Small Sapphire of Completion
>81% Marriage Material --> 5x Small Obsidian of Completion
>84% Marriage Material --> 5x Small Topaz of Completion
>87% Marriage Material --> 1x Wedding Costume Specialist Card
>91% Marriage Material --> 5x Treasure Chest Skeleton Key (Limited)
>98% Marriage Material --> 1x Giant Lump of Gold (= 1 million Gold)

[b]Note: [/b]If you have reach 21% Marriage Material, for example, you’ll receive the prize for 21%, as well as those for 14% and 7%.

While your imagination paints you a picture of a rosy future with your loved one, Madame Esmeralda impatiently taps her foot.

‘So, you got all that?’ Her husky voice tears you out of your daydream. You nod enthusiastically.

‘Fine, then get out of here! And don’t forget you can always find the new weekly challenges [url=http://nostale.comastuff.com/challenge/en/]here[/url].’

Fully invigorated by what you’ve seen, you set off determined to become the very epitome of eligible marriage material.

Have fun!

The NosTale Team

notes.title: The Brand-New Family System
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30481962/31479df3277f8dad72317bc533ee5e6c4f90b129.jpg[/img]

[b]You can now achieve amazing things with your NosTale family.[/b] We’ve given the family system a major overhaul, allowing you to earn epic rewards for fighting together with your kin!

Coming new to NosTale, you’ll find family missions, achievements and rewards, plus a reworked family rankings system.
Read about all the details and which changes and adventures you can look forward to you on your next family outing:

[h1]Family Level[/h1]
The maximum family level will be increased from 10 to 20.

[h1]Family Achievements[/h1]
Completing family missions allows you to unlock achievements for your family and increase your family level.

[h1]Family Missions[/h1]
As your family progresses, you’ll unlock missions for you to complete. Some of these are daily missions, others monthly. For example, you may need to complete a certain raid 5 times, or complete 10 Instant Combats.

[h1]Family Rewards[/h1]
Your family earns rewards for completing missions and achievements. There are four types of reward:


[h1]Family Skills[/h1]
[list]
[*] Increase the XP you earn or unlock benefits for Glacernon (Act 4), amongst other things.
[*] This applies to all family members, but some skills also help all players of your faction.
[*] Applies for one month.
[*] Can be used by Family Head or Family Deputy once per day.
[/list]

[h1]Family Buffs[/h1]
[list][*]These include, for example, increasing attack and defence power by up to 10%, or increasing the effectiveness of food/potions by up to 15%. You can also increase the number of family members (up to 100) or the size of your family warehouse (up to 49 slots).
[*]Applies to all family members.
[*]Permanent effect.
[*]Can be purchased by the Family Head from Family Manager Salim for gold.[/list]

[h1]Family Experience – FXP[/h1]
[list]
[*]By fulfilling daily missions and achievements you receive family experience, labelled as FXP.
[*]These points allow you to improve your family and climb the rankings.
[/list]

[h1]Family Emblems[/h1]

[list][*]The most valuable things for players are the ‘emblems’ which are displayed next to the family name (these are only rewarded to the top-ranked families in the three monthly rankings).
[/list]

[h1]Monthly Rankings[/h1]
There are three different monthly rankings. The top-placed family of each will be rewarded with family emblems and other prizes.

[list][*]Monthly FXP Rankings
Win this ranking by having earned more FXP than any other family.
[*]Monthly Family Rankings (Angels)
Win this ranking by earning more PvP points than any other family in the Angel faction in Glacernon (Act 4).
[*]Monthly Family Rankings (Demons)
Win this ranking by earning more PvP points than any other family in the Demon faction in Glacernon (Act 4).[/list]

[b]Note:[/b] At the moment all top-ranked families receive a debuff designed to prevent them from monopolising the top spot as a result of all their bonus effects and skills. This debuff gets stronger month by month (up to 30% after 3 months).

[h1]Action Points[/h1]

[list][*]Each player can earn ‘action points’ for playing raids and similar activities. In the family info, these indicate which players have been most active. But don’t confuse action points for FXP – only FXP allows you to level up your family.
[*]Members can earn action points for completing Instant Combats, raids, killing family raid bosses and for PvP points in Glacernon (Act 4).
[/list]

So now you’re ready. Rally your family around you and get started!

Have fun!
The NosTale Family

notes.title: Mysterious Treasure Chests – Collect Your Free Daily Key
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30481962/453da5304565962130184617c323a6a95b95bdbd.jpg[/img]

You heave the [b]Normal Treasure Chest [/b]onto the table with a loud thump, producing a fine cloud of dust. Rummaging through your knapsack, you eventually find one of the [b]Treasure Chest Skeleton Keys[/b] which you’ve been able to collect [b]for free every day this week[/b] since reaching level 40.

You blow the remaining dust from the lock, and notice a small scroll of parchment attached to it. The paper crinkles as you unroll it.

You read:
‘So you found this treasure chest and have earned enough experience to receive a Treasure Chest Skeleton Key every day, absolutely free!’
A shiver runs down your spine… how could the author know that? You look behind you, but there’s no one in sight.

‘Oi, pay attention!’

What on earth? You flip and turn the parchment, but can’t see anything unusual.

‘Close your mouth, you look like a trout. I’ll let you into a little secret: [b]I’ve hidden a ton of different Treasure Chests: Normal, Rare and Legendary[/b]. You can collect them by defeating monsters or from raids and Instant Combats.

[h1]All of the Treasure Chests may contain one of the following items in different quantities:[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30481962/901a557941caf8decc59e6ba4b1f122ba5445825.png[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30481962/b47a9d09280a8cb02b446c4b6de4100305adc17d.png[/img]

[list]
[*]     Dancer Set
[*]     Desert Set
[*]     Champion Blessing Amulet (Random)
[*]     Perfume
[*]     Angel Wings
[*]     Sealed Vessel
[*]     Soulstone Blessing
[*]     Gourmet Pet Food
[*]     Fairy Booster
[*]     Fairy Experience Potion
[*]     Huge Recovery Potion
[*]     Tarot Card Game
[*]     Cylloan Spring Water
[/list]

[b]The rarer the Treasure Chest, the better your reward. Apart from collecting the free daily keys from level 40, you can also find them in the NosMall.[/b]

But wait! Not so fast. You only need one Treasure Chest Skeleton Key for the Normal Treasure Chest, but the [b]Rare Treasure Chest features 3 locks, while the Legendary Treasure Chest has 5.[/b]

You’ll need as many keys as there are locks on the chest to open it…’
These are the final words on the scroll.
You shrug your shoulders and your eyes come to rest once more on the Normal Treasure Chest lying on the table.

What will you find inside?
Only you can know the answer.

Good luck!
The NosTale Team

Your colleague in the Brown Detective Set looks down sheepishly and holds up a hand in apology. Rubbing your shoulder, you sigh and wave him off. Clearly he’s not got used to the increased attack power his outfit gives him, on top of the bonus MP and HP.

notes.title: [7/2–27/2/2019] 3 Valentine’s Day Events in NosTale
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30481962/0cce77ed30660c01f64b9ac16b8a9e02f18faf79.jpg[/img]

Is there someone special who you’ve always wanted to tell how much you love them? Then seize your opportunity in the Valentine’s Day Event! Declare your undying love [b]between 7th and 27th February 2019[/b], collect a new partner and transform yourself into cute bunnies and bushtails.

[h1]Event: Love is in the Air[/h1]

Gather up all your courage and give Valentine’s Day gifts to your friends and loved ones.

How it works:
[list]
[*]    Hunt monsters and collect Chocolate, Gift Boxes and Ribbons.
[*]     Exchange the items for a Valentine's Day Gift from Eva Energy, giving you the chance to show your love!
[*]     If your friend accepts the gift, you’ll benefit from extra energy and strength from the Valentine's Day Blessing. This increases your attack and defence power for a certain length of time.
1-3 Gifts: Small Valentine's Day Blessing
4-9 Gifts: Valentine's Day Blessing
10+ Gifts: Big Valentine's Day Blessing
[*]     Remember that your gifts can also be rejected – stay strong!
[*]     Don’t be shy, share your love! You can declare your love up to three times per day.
[/list]

[h1]Event: Amora’s Missing Wings[/h1]

Love can be a double-edged sword. The tragic case of the Wingless Amora and her true love will pull at your heartstrings. But you’ll soon feel all warm and cuddly inside again with the quest reward in the form of a ranged partner: Wingless Amora (available once per character).

Can’t get enough of this super-sweet partner? Then head on over to the NosMall and pick up Amora’s Specialist Partner Card.

[h1]Event: Mimi Needs Help[/h1]

Thieving swine are roaming the lands in NosTale and have played a nasty trick on Mimi Mentor! Return Mimi’s stolen items and earn yourself a New Year's Gift Box.

How it works:
[list]
[*]  Talk to Mimi Mentor.
[*]     Travel around the world of NosTale and defeat monsters. With a bit of luck, one of these pigs will appear which can give you an experience bonus of 10% (excluding Instant Combat, raids, Time-Spaces and Glacernon).
[*]     The thieves won’t defend themselves and can be beat with just 5 blows, but make sure those little good-for-nothings don’t slip through your fingers.
[*]     After each blow, a pig will drop one of the following items:[/list]

Gold
Golden New Year's Carrot
Tasty Carrot Snack
Stolen Gift Bag
Stolen Lucky Charm
[list]
[*]     Return the stolen goods back to Mimi and you’ll earn a New Year's Gift Box.
[*] The New Year's Gift Box may contain the following:
[/list]

    New Year Lucky Pig
    Bushtail Costume Scroll
    March Hare Costume (7 Days)
    March Hare Hat (7 Days)
    Adorable Bunny Costume (7 Days)
    Adorable Bunny Ears (7 Days)
    Golden New Year's Carrot
    Fresh Carrot Juice
    Tasty Carrot Snack

Use the bushtail scroll to transform yourself into a heart-meltingly cute bunny (effect: +30% experience) or one of 7 different bushtails (effect: +10% experience).

Enjoy the season of love!
The NosTale Team

notes.title: Take a Sleigh Ride in the Winter Event Weeks
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30481962/6f234e8d13e68e2dd460922d3826f1f91df85213.jpg[/img]

Silent night, holy night… not in NosTale! The wild cats are back once more, trying to take over in our Winter Event. Plus you have a special chance to create a reindeer-drawn sleigh – this sleek conveyance would make even Santa Claus turn green with envy, though at this festive time of year he can’t help but laugh to see you ride it.

[b]Look forward to these highlights between 13th December 2018 and 16th January 2019:[/b]

[h1]Magic Sleigh with Red-nosed Reindeer[/h1]

The NPC Santa Claus has something very special in store for you. In exchange for a Red-nosed Reindeer Bead (available from quests and the Winter Event raids listed below) and a Magic Sleigh (available on the NosWheel), Santa Claus will create a super-fast Magic Sleigh with Red-nosed Reindeer for you.

[b]Specialist Partners[/b]
With Maru’s Specialist Partner Card you can transform Tom and Kliff into the Millennial Tiger.

With the second Specialist Partner Card ‘Maru in Mother’s Fur’ you can transform Tom and Kliff into a tiger disguised as the siblings’ caring mother.
The partner has three razor-sharp skills: Hi-yah!, Spin Up and Tiger Power

[h1]Raid against Maru the Millennial Tiger[/h1]

Challenge Maru and his followers in the raid! Simply use Maru’s Raid Seal to take him on. If you’re successful, you’ll earn his special Tiger Chest in reward.
Note: You can neither make yourself invisible, nor summon miniatures as Jajamaru in this raid.

[b]Daily Quests[/b]
[list]
[*]     Searching for the Siblings’ Mother
[*]     Save the Siblings
[*]     Need Sesame Oil
[/list]

You can earn Maru’s Raid Seal and Brass Coins as your reward for completing the daily quests.

[b]Event Quest[/b]
Talk to the new Wanderer NPC to exchange Brass Coins for the Wanderer’s Chest and the great items hidden inside.

[b]Red Bean Rice Cakes and Sesame Oil[/b]
Collect Red Bean Rice Cakes and Sesame Oil by hunting monsters, then exchange the items for a reward or use them yourself. The cakes restore you and your NosMate’s HP and MP, while the Sesame Oil is useful in the raid.

[h1]Snowman Raid[/h1]

Once you’ve completed the quest and mastered the Time-Space, you can practise getting your revenge on the snow monster in the Vikings’ name. Grab your friends and bring it the heat! In reward you’ll earn a raid box containing awesome specialist partner cards and other wintry event items.

[b]Daily Quests from Six NPCs in NosVille[/b]
Meet good and evil reindeer, let the bells ring out, watch how scarves are made from magical wool and knitting needles and much more. Collect colourful stockings for completing quests and exchange them for a Christmas Gift Box.

[b]Happy New Year… Literally![/b]
Collect golden letters (H, A, P, Y) and white letters (N, E, W, Y, A, R) dropped by monsters. Once you have enough to spell the words HAPPY NEW YEAR you can exchange them for a Happy New Year Box and/or a Happy New Year Golden Box. If fortune’s smiling you’ll find a Movement Scroll, fancy costumes or a variety of fireworks inside.

Wishing you a wonderful winter event!

The NosTale Team
