notes.title: Halloween at NosTale - the horror portal has opened!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30481962/937884a3527796fadcca264f49b742fb2e4ef35d.jpg[/img]

Lizard's leg and eye of newt, here spirits gather for their loot.

This is the place for witches and ghosts, who lie in wait for their unwilling hosts.

When monsters appear on your NosTale screen, you know that it's time for Halloween!

[b]For everyone who loves scaring themselves silly: NosTale is celebrating Halloween[/b]

Be there when the horror portal opens from 25th of October to the 21th of November 2018 and dark creatures start spreading fear and terror!

[h1][b]Raid:[/b][/h1]
Take on Foxy and her cunning skulk of foxes in the raid! Use Foxy's Raid Seal to challenge her. If you succeed, you'll be rewarded with Foxy's Wonder Chest, which with a little luck might contain Foxy's Specialist Partner Card.

Tip: In the raid you can neither make yourself invisible, nor summon miniatures as Jajamaru.

[b]Quests:[/b]

[b]Daily:[/b]
[list]	
	[*]Fresh Liver Please![/*]Hunt monsters on general maps and gather fresh livers.

	[*]Fox Hunt[/*]Hunt Foxes and Dusi-Foxes!

	[*]Someone Who Knows the Truth[/*]Meet Mr Parks' Third Son. He knows the truth, and nothing but the truth!

	[*]Foxy's Verdict[/*]Complete Foxy's Raid. Foxy's Raid Seal awaits as reward for the daily quests.
[/list]

[b]During the complete event period:[/b]
[list][*]Lost Preparations[/*]
[*]Collect blue, yellow and red flasks![/*]
Blue Flask: Removes the slowdown caused by Foxy's skill.

Yellow Flask: Restores your HP to 100%.

[*]What's in the Red Flask?[/*]
1, 2 or 3... use the Red Flask against Foxy. It causes fire element damage and is very effective against the nine-tailed fox.

As a reward you'll earned a Halloween Wonder Chest containing amazing event items. Enjoy the surprises![/list]

[b]Snacks:[/b] Bean Rice Cakes and Giant Rice Cakes - Restore HP and MP for you and your NosMate.

[b]NPC:[/b] 

[b]Foxy[/b] - Foxy is both a raid boss with super skills and a new partner. Tame her and she'll follow you everywhere!

[b]Mr Parks' First, Second and Third Sons[/b] - All three will help you through the quest, each in their own way.

[b]Maps:[/b] Sinister Path, Horrorholme and Fox's Den - Enter the unknown!


[h1][b]Challenge Jack O'Lantern and his henchmen in a raid![/b][/h1]
[list]	
	[*]Defeat the cruel giant pumpkin Jack O'Lantern in a raid! He's got himself some help in the form of his followers, renegade Pumpkin Bushis and Pumpkin Bombs. As a reward you can get a Halloween Raid Box.[/*]	[*]Secure the Glowing Pumpkin Hat and the new Spooky Tarot Cards from the Halloween Raid Box.[/*][/list]

[b]New Halloween event features: three Spooky Tarot Cards with ghostly effects:[/b]
[list]	
	[*]Spooky Tarot Card [Ghost]: with the spooky ghost tarot card, you move as swiftly as a ghost. Your movement speed is therefore increased and avoiding attacks is increased by 100 %. The duration of use is 3 hours. You need level 1 for this.[/*]	[*]Spooky Tarot Card [Dracula]: the spooky Dracula tarot card, you become a blood sucker. There's 3 % chance of it creating the 'Blood-sucking Dracula' effect. The duration of use is 3 hours. Your need level 1 for this.[/*]	[*]Spooky Tarot Card [Scarecrow]: this spooky tarot card calls upon your dark powers. Your element of darkness will be increased by 200 and your resistance against the light element is increased by 5%. The duration of use is 3 hours. Your need level 1 for this.[/*][/list]

[b]Trick or Treat for everyone - in the daily quests from the NPCs in NosVille:[/b]

Meet Eric, Mary, Eva Energy, Malcolm Mix and Teoman Topp and grab useful items in the 'Trick or Treat' quests! This includes yellow and black Pumpkin Sweets, the Halloween Blessing, a Glowing Pumpkin Hat or a Halloween Costume Scroll. You will also receive Bags of Sweets for completing the quests which you can swap for Jack O'Lantern's Seal.

[b]Reach for treats and put on a costume![/b]
	[list]		
		[*]Sweets such as yellow and black pumpkin sweets are dropped when you eliminate monsters. You can have them as a snack, or swap them for a Halloween Costume Scroll or a raid seal for Jack O'Lantern.[/*]		[*]Put on the new Glowing Pumpkin Hat! It's the latest fashion trend in the village! Your NosTale Team

notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30481962/4a15f20897586aa312dbf3c3e63bff52c24bc1bc.jpg[/img]

Hello!

You think bunnies only hop around at Easter? Not in NosTale! This year's summer event is all about bunnies, carrots and a rather shady tortoise. Confront the clever little Lola Lopears in the raid and pick up some great event items. While you're at it, pick up the Specialist Partner Card for Lucy Lopears!

[h1]SUMMER HIGHLIGHTS FROM 16/08/2018 TO 05/09/2018[/h1]

[b]Lucy Lopears' Specialist Partner Card[/b]

Pick up the new Specialist Partner Card with the fire element. Lucy Lopears will be your loyal, powerful partner.

[b]Raid:[/b]

You could call her Lucy's evil sister: Lola Lopears! Confront her in the raid – but keep your wits about you when you face her little army of bunnies, and the bunny burrows the long-ears come hopping out of. Lola also plants a giant carrot in the ground which you must destroy as quickly as possible. Each member of your raid team needs Lola Lopears' Raid Seal before you can start. If you manage to swing the battle in your favour, with a bit of luck you might find the new partner in the raid box.

[b]Event Quests:[/b]

A host of challenging quests will demand your utmost skills. You'll be rewarded with Ginseng Leaves and Carrots, and these handy items will help you by regenerating HP and MP.

Daily Quests: Ginseng Digger and Raphael's Story

As a reward for the daily quests, you'll find the Tortoise Present and Lola Lopears' Raid Seal.

[b]Monsters:[/b]

• Lola's Bed Bunnies and Lola's Master Bunnies: Lola Lopears' followers.
• Raphael the Tortoise: NPC in Port Alveus who provides you with (partly) useful information.


[h1]
Whilst the bunny invasion is going in NosVille, the pirates will again be paying a visit to Port Alveus...
[/h1]

Yo-ho - Captain Pete O‘ Peng is back! After a long journey over the seven seas I have returned - more dangerous than ever before! You've got no chance this time! I'm going to make sea dragon food out of you! Harharhar! This is going to be great fun. And then I'll enjoy ruling over your seas - with a bottle of rum! You can't beat me, you'd need a whole army! So come on, try taking me on, I'll wait for you here!
	[list]		
		[*]Eliminate the malevolent[b] Captain Pete O'Peng[/b] and his crew in the pirate raid! Pillage the raidbox and with a bit of luck, grab the brand-new [b]Navy Costume or Navy Bushi, partner Leona or one of the four pirate bushis[/b] amongst other included items.[/*]		[*]Put on the [b]elegant Navy Costume[/b]! Both pieces of clothing increase resistance against water by 2%.[/*][/list]

Hide in a rum barrel, let it hail cannon fire or fire a musket. You can not only get these specialisations from a raidbox, but also hunt them from Captain Jack Panon whilst gambling. But be careful, he's smart and may nab your wager.[/*]	[*]In the [b]daily quests at Captain Jack Panon's[/b] he'll also reward you with the Navy Costume or Hat (limited time), Aqua Bushi, Aqua Bushi Costume or Hat (limited time) or the Pirate SP Upgrade Scroll, amongst other things.[/*]	[*]With the [b]Pirate SP Upgrade Scroll[/b] you improve your Specialist Card, without using up the normal upgrade items. You only need the Upgrade Scroll.[/*]	[*]Get into a summer groove, get Ice Cubes and snack on a yummy watermelon. notes.title: New Class: The Martial Artist
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30481962/ee4a79ea028eac5d4a6f492d90ea53adcfb3e6b1.jpg[/img]

For the first time ever, a new class is coming to NosTale! The Martial Artist is all about channelling energy through his feet and fists, making short shrift of his foes with astounding agility and outstanding technique.

[b]How to start your martial arts career:[/b]
[list]	
	[*]If you already have a Swordsman, Mage or Archer at level 80, you can create a Martial Artist immediately from the character selection screen (one per server). This character starts at level 81 with the main quests from Act 4.[/*]	[*]The Martial Artist has all basic skills available from the beginning and uses gauntlets as their primary weapon. The new class cannot use all of the existing accessories and costumes.[/*]	[*]The new character class starts with eight class points (CP) out of a maximum of 200, as well as a one-off starter pack containing a bundle of individual items.[/*]	[*]If you delete your Martial Artist character, you can only create a new one again after 30 days.[/*]	[*]Not fought your way to level 80 yet? No problem! You’ll reach the necessary level in no time with a permanent experience buff, which can even be combined with other experience buffs.[/*][/list]

[b]Plus look forward to the following:[/b]
[list]	
	[*]Unlock the fire in your Martial Artist with the first specialist card: Draconic Fist. It provides the ability to switch between two stances and execute powerful flame attacks.[/*]	[*]A number of changes have been made in the shop to adjust the selection to the new character class.[/*]	[*]Pull the strings with the new Puppet Master’s Dress (only for female characters). Meanwhile, male characters can look forward to the Puppet Master’s Bear Costume.[/*][/list]

Launch the game today and unleash those fists of fury!
The NosTale Team

notes.title: [28/3/2018] Your Changes in the Latest Update!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30481962/5e0e7239c38e17cbce3c320745a45e9e4a40317c.jpg[/img]

On 28th March 2018 we’ll be releasing a patch which was only possible thanks to your feedback! We’ve implemented many of your changes and suggestions to make NosTale even easier to play.

[b]These are the changes you requested which have now been implemented in the game:[/b]

- You can now only write messages only hitting the character limit. Try to type more characters than that and they will not appear.
- There is now a 5 second cooldown between sending repeated party, friendship, family and trade requests.
-  As soon as you’re invited to join a family, the remaining time to join will be displayed (if set).
- The maximum limit for a stack is now 999.
- A button labelled ‘Continuous Production’ has been added for crafting items. This allows production to continue automatically until there are insufficient materials in your inventory.
- The levelsof raid members has been removed to make names more visible. If you want to see their levels, you can still simply hover over the character’s picture.
- The costume inventory has been expanded to 60 slots.
- An additional character slot has been added, however this is not yet usable.
- Buffs and healing no longer interrupt other players’ transformations.
- Fafnir’s Fried Dinner no longer requires confirmation before use.
- Using items from the NosMall now requires confirmation to reduce the chance of them being used by mistake.
- The production window no longer disappears after an item has been crafted.

[b]We’ve also made some changes to the interface:[/b]

- The raid interface for Acts 4 and 6 has been scaled down.
- The skill bars have been moved and the experience bars now appear at the bottom of the screen.
- It is now possible to drag equipment into the skill bar and use it from there.
- The skill bar can be locked which prevents skills or equipment being removed accidentally.
- Individual elements can now be moved to suit your needs. This feature can be activated and deactivated. It is currently not possible to lock the position of the UI elements, but we’re working on implementing this as well.
- The skill bar now has more slots, changing the key bindings as follows:

        Top row: numbers 1 to 0
        Second row: CTRL+1 to CTRL+0
        Third row: ALT+1 to ALT+0
        Partner skills are now bound to the keys Q, W, E and R.
        The user interface can be activated/deactivated with the shortcut CTRL+X.
        The graphics resolution can be changed with the shortcuts SHIFT+F1 through SHIFT+F7.


We look forward to hearing more excellent ideas and feedback from you, and will endeavour to implement them as best we can.

The NosTale Team

notes.title: [28/03-18/04/2018] Enjoy the devilishly good Easter event!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30481962/faaeee8e7877bd0ab5e2f20976267ed3de6de7ad.jpg[/img]

Hello NosPlayers!

Hunting for eggs and scoffing down chocolate bunnies was yesteryear. In NosTale we're really turning up the heat with this Easter event. Hell has broken loose and the imps are on the move. Show Hongbi and Cheongbi what you're made of in the raid, and pick up a Specialist Partner Card while you're at it!

[b]EASTER DELIGHTS WAITING FOR YOU 28/03-18/04/2018:[/b]

[b]Raid:[/b]
Confront the imps Hongbi and Cheongbi. They'll put up a real fight, summoning little clones of themselves to help. Deal with these pesky demons and earn yourself the Specialist Partner Cards from the raid box.

[b]Quests:[/b]
Hungbu and Nolbu's Strange Seeds
These seed grains have some real surprises in store for you... both good and bad, so keep your wits about you!
- Creepy Imps: Drive these imps back through the gates of hell!
- Injured Swallow: Find a cure and help this little bird back onto its feet.

[b]Snacks:[/b]
- Red Bean Soup: This meal gives imps a real bellyache. Put this fluid weapon to good use against them in the raid.
- Cure: Gradually restores both HP and MP by 5,000.

[b]NPCs:[/b]
- Hungbu and Nolbu: Once upon a time they were amiable brothers. But then one became stinking rich and was poisoned by greed. The other remained kind-hearted and good-natured. Both of them are offering you a seed which will produce something when you plant it... but just what that is, you'll have to find out for yourselves.

[b]NosVille[/b] is preparing for the festival of bunnies and eggs with some wonderful decorations.

[b]Raid:[/b] Make sure that the mean Chicken Queen clucks her last cluck! But beware of the Chicken King, who protects his hen and of the chicks that leave the nest. When you complete the raid for the first time, you will receive the Mysterious Egg once per account. You can also gain an egg from a raidbox.

[b]Mysterious Egg:[/b] Click on the egg in your Miniland and it will become your companion. Take it with you into battle and feed it with growth fruit, then soon your new NosMate or your new mount will come out of the egg. With Evolution Fruit, collectable from a raidbox, your pet will grow further.

[b]Hatching pets:[/b] young Bouncing Jelly, Jumpy Chicky, Flare

[b]Flare, Blaze + Inferno:[/b] These special and fiery foxes will support you.
- Flare provides you with one Easter box every day if it supports you at least for one hour.
- Blaze has a 10% chance of inflicting a blackout on enemies.
- Inferno increases your resistance to fire and summons between one and three Mini-Inferno as support in battle.

If you lovingly provide a hatched NosMate with Evolution Fruit, it will develop into a strong pet. Note: you can only feed them with fruit in the Miniland.

[b]Development levels of pets[/b] - from the lowest to the highest level:
- Young Bouncing Jelly -> Bouncing Jelly -> Young Hopping Jelly -> Hopping Jelly -> Seraphim
- Jumpy Chicky -> Grumbly Chicky -> Chick Norris
- Flare -> Blaze -> Inferno

If you still have pets (Jellys and Chickys) from the previous year's events, you can develop these too.

[b]Hatching mounts:[/b] The eggs are not mysterious for no reason – if you are lucky, Marco Pollo, the Spanish riding cockerel will hatch. You don't need to develop this guy when you get him – simply hop on and scamper away. His movement speed throughout the complete Act 1 region is 20. With an additional speedbooster, you'll be on your way faster.

[b]Daily quests:[/b] join in on the daily quests from Mimi Mentor, Calvin Coach, Slugg, Eva Energy and Malcolm Mix.
- Gather yellow and red Easter Eggs! Take the yellow ones to Slugg, the red ones to Eva Energy – and of course there will be a reward! In this way, you will also get to the golden Easter Egg. If you have five of them, you can exchange them with Mimi Mentor for an Easter box.
- Defeat monsters to get to the Chocolate Rabbits. You need 30 of them to receive the Chicken Queen Seal, and in doing so, take on the battle against the foul fowl.


Wishing you barrels of fun!
The NosTale Team

Hello NosPlayers!

Hunting for eggs and scoffing down chocolate bunnies was yesteryear. In NosTale we're really turning up the heat with this Easter event. Hell has broken loose and the imps are on the move. Show Hongbi and Cheongbi what you're made of in the raid, and pick up a Specialist Partner Card while you're at it!

[b]EASTER DELIGHTS WAITING FOR YOU 28/03-18/04/2018:[/b]

[b]Raid:[/b]
Confront the imps Hongbi and Cheongbi. They'll put up a real fight, summoning little clones of themselves to help. Deal with these pesky demons and earn yourself the Specialist Partner Cards from the raid box.

[b]Quests:[/b]
Hungbu and Nolbu's Strange Seeds
These seed grains have some real surprises in store for you... both good and bad, so keep your wits about you!
- Creepy Imps: Drive these imps back through the gates of hell!
- Injured Swallow: Find a cure and help this little bird back onto its feet.

[b]Snacks:[/b]
- Red Bean Soup: This meal gives imps a real bellyache. Put this fluid weapon to good use against them in the raid.
- Cure: Gradually restores both HP and MP by 5,000.

[b]NPCs:[/b]
- Hungbu and Nolbu: Once upon a time they were amiable brothers. But then one became stinking rich and was poisoned by greed. The other remained kind-hearted and good-natured. Both of them are offering you a seed which will produce something when you plant it... but just what that is, you'll have to find out for yourselves.

[b]NosVille[/b] is preparing for the festival of bunnies and eggs with some wonderful decorations.

[b]Raid:[/b] Make sure that the mean Chicken Queen clucks her last cluck! But beware of the Chicken King, who protects his hen and of the chicks that leave the nest. When you complete the raid for the first time, you will receive the Mysterious Egg once per account. You can also gain an egg from a raidbox.

[b]Mysterious Egg:[/b] Click on the egg in your Miniland and it will become your companion. Take it with you into battle and feed it with growth fruit, then soon your new NosMate or your new mount will come out of the egg. With Evolution Fruit, collectable from a raidbox, your pet will grow further.

[b]Hatching pets:[/b] young Bouncing Jelly, Jumpy Chicky, Flare

[b]Flare, Blaze + Inferno:[/b] These special and fiery foxes will support you.
- Flare provides you with one Easter box every day if it supports you at least for one hour.
- Blaze has a 10% chance of inflicting a blackout on enemies.
- Inferno increases your resistance to fire and summons between one and three Mini-Inferno as support in battle.

If you lovingly provide a hatched NosMate with Evolution Fruit, it will develop into a strong pet. Note: you can only feed them with fruit in the Miniland.

[b]Development levels of pets[/b] - from the lowest to the highest level:
- Young Bouncing Jelly -> Bouncing Jelly -> Young Hopping Jelly -> Hopping Jelly -> Seraphim
- Jumpy Chicky -> Grumbly Chicky -> Chick Norris
- Flare -> Blaze -> Inferno

If you still have pets (Jellys and Chickys) from the previous year's events, you can develop these too.

[b]Hatching mounts:[/b] The eggs are not mysterious for no reason – if you are lucky, Marco Pollo, the Spanish riding cockerel will hatch. You don't need to develop this guy when you get him – simply hop on and scamper away. His movement speed throughout the complete Act 1 region is 20. With an additional speedbooster, you'll be on your way faster.

[b]Daily quests:[/b] join in on the daily quests from Mimi Mentor, Calvin Coach, Slugg, Eva Energy and Malcolm Mix.
- Gather yellow and red Easter Eggs! Take the yellow ones to Slugg, the red ones to Eva Energy – and of course there will be a reward! In this way, you will also get to the golden Easter Egg. If you have five of them, you can exchange them with Mimi Mentor for an Easter box.
- Defeat monsters to get to the Chocolate Rabbits. You need 30 of them to receive the Chicken Queen Seal, and in doing so, take on the battle against the foul fowl.


Wishing you barrels of fun!
The NosTale Team

notes.title: [7/2-28/2/2018] Cute Bunnies and Awesome Gifts in the Lunar New Year Event
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30481962/c77142d82c54afb11414417af402ea6375d4071c.jpg[/img]

A thieving bunny will be running riot between 7/2 and 28/2/2018! Retrieve the stolen goods from him and return them to Mimi Mentor to receive some awesome items.

[b]Here’s how the event works:[/b]

- The Bunny Thief will randomly appear when you defeat monsters on regular maps.
- The difference between the enemies’ level and your own should not be more than 10.
- You’ll have to be quick to catch the Bunny Thief before he hops away. You can strike him 5 times before he disappears. Each blow will cause him to drop cool items or gold.
- If you bring 5 Stolen Gift Bags (Event) and 5 Stolen Lucky Charms (Event) to Mimi Mentor, she’ll give you a New Year's Gift Box (Event) in return.
- All event items disappear at the end of the event.

[b]You can get the following items from the New Year’s Gift Box:[/b]

- Bushtail Costume Scroll (Event)
a) You transform into one of multiple different bushis and earn 10% more experience.
b) If you’re really lucky, you’ll turn into a Cute Bunny, giving you a 30% experience bonus.
c) The experience bonuses last for 30 minutes.
- Cute Bunny (Pet)
- March Hare Costume (7 Days)
- March Hare Hat (7 Days)
- Adorable Bunny Costume (7 Days)
- Adorable Bunny Ears (7 Days)
- Golden New Year's Carrot (Event)
- Fresh Carrot Juice (Event)
- Tasty Carrot Snack (Event)

Have fun on the rabbit hunt!
The NosTale Team

notes.title: [7/2-28/2/2018] Valentine’s Day Event in NosTale – Share the Love!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30481962/51b2e6dd24a6da66580e663183ea2572116ab4d6.jpg[/img]

Is there someone special who you’ve always wanted to tell how much you love them? Then seize your opportunity in the Valentine’s Day Event! From 7/2 to 28/2/2018 you’ll have a chance to show that special someone how much they mean to you – the season for lovers and good friends has arrived! Show people how much you like them with a gift!

[b]Show your true feelings in the Valentine’s Day Event and look forward to these highlights:[/b]

- Hunt monsters and collect Chocolate, Gift Boxes and Ribbons.
- Exchange the items for a Valentine's Day Gift from Eva Energy, giving you the chance to show your love!
- If your friend accepts the gift, you’ll benefit from extra energy and strength from the Valentine's Day Blessing. This increases your attack and defence power for a certain length of time.
- 1-3 Gifts: Small Valentine's Day Blessing
- 4-9 Gifts: Valentine's Day Blessing
- 10+ Gifts: Big Valentine's Day Blessing
- Remember that your gifts can also be rejected – stay strong!
- Don’t be shy, share your love! You can declare your love up to three times per day.

Give your loved ones a treat with the wonderful gifts for Valentine’s Day!

[b]Have you been dreaming of a beautiful wedding?[/b]

Then let your dreams come true and pick up a Wedding Box at a 20% discount.
Just remember that marriage shouldn’t be taken lightly, and separating again can be a painful experience, which is why the Separation Letter now costs 20% more.

This offer lasts for the duration of the Valentine’s Day Event.

The NosTale Team

notes.title: Razor-Sharp Winter Event and New Banking System
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30481962/d36ff512ac63ef790089e09556c71744021b0590.jpg[/img]

Silent night, holy night… not in NosTale! The wild cats are back once more, trying to take over in our winter event. Maru the Millennial Tiger has returned and is lying in ambush for the residents of NosVille. Show him who’s boss in the raid!
Plus there’s a brand-new banking system for you to enjoy!

Your money is in good hands at the Cuarry Bank. Keep track of your finances by picking up a Cuarry Bank Savings Book and Debit Card.

Look forward to these highlights between 13th December 2017 and 10th January 2018:


[b]Specialist Partners[/b]
With Maru’s Specialist Partner Card you can transform Tom and Kliff into the Millennial Tiger.

With the second Specialist Partner Card ‘Maru in Mother’s Fur’ you can transform Tom and Kliff into a tiger disguised as the siblings’ caring mother.
The partner has three razor-sharp skills: Hi-yah!, Spin Up and Tiger Power


[b]Raid against Maru the Millennial Tiger[/b]
Challenge Maru and his followers in the raid! Simply use Maru’s Raid Seal to take him on. If you’re successful, you’ll earn his special Tiger Chest in reward.
Note: You can neither make yourself invisible, nor summon miniatures as Jajamaru in this raid.


[b]Daily Quests[/b]
- Searching for the Siblings' Mother
- Save the Siblings
- Need Sesame Oil

You can earn Maru's Raid Seal and Brass Coins as your reward for completing the daily quests.


[b]Event Quest[/b]
Talk to the new Wanderer NPC to exchange Brass Coins for the Wanderer's Chest and the great items hidden inside.

[b]Red Bean Rice Cakes and Sesame Oil[/b]
Collect Red Bean Rice Cakes and Sesame Oil by hunting monsters, then exchange the items for a reward or use them yourself. The cakes restore you and your NosMate’s HP and MP, while the Sesame Oil is useful in the raid.


[b]Snowman Raid[/b]
Once you’ve completed the quest and mastered the Time-Space, you can practise getting your revenge on the snow monster in the Vikings’ name. Grab your friends and bring the heat to the wicked snowman! In reward you’ll earn a raid box containing awesome specialist partner cards and other wintry event items.

- Daily quests from six NPCs in NosVille: Meet good and evil reindeer, let the bells ring out, watch scarves made magical wool and knitting needles and much more. Collect colourful stockings for completing quests and exchange them for a Christmas Gift Box.

- Collect golden letters (H, A, P, Y) and white letters (N, E, W, Y, A, R) dropped by monsters. Once you have enough to spell the words HAPPY NEW YEAR you can exchange them for a Happy New Year Box and/or a Happy New Year Golden Box. If fortune’s smiling you’ll find a Movement Scroll, fancy costumes or a variety of fireworks inside.


Write your very own Christmas fairytale and show that tiger who’s wearing the stripes.

Wishing you a wonderful winter event!

The NosTale Team

notes.title: [11/10–25/10/2017] 10 Years of NosTale – Anniversary Event
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30481962/85ba38b6923f4bb103ac7b6c97b1e8372a988c96.png[/img]

Ten years ago, NosTale opens its digital doors in Europe, giving countless brave adventurers the chance to battle their way through the exciting world of NosTale! 

In honour of this grand occasion, we’ve put together a special anniversary event for you.

Here’s how it works:
- Defeat various monsters to collect the event letters ‘N’, ‘O’, ‘S’, ‘10’, ‘Y’, ‘E’, ‘A’ and ‘R’.
- These letters can be exchanged for the following:
-> A medal with beneficial effects (once per account)
-> Basic specialist points
-> A buff which temporarily increases HP & MP
- The letters also serve as recovery items.

[b]We’d like to send a big thank-you to everyone who has played NosTale over the years! Both new players and veterans alike, we’re glad that you’re a part of the NosTale family and wish you plenty more years of gaming fun![/b]

The NosTale Team
